# Introduction

Script for evaluation of ClustoCell's Performance in grouping cells into celltype-relevant clusters.

# Function Defintion

We first define some helper functions.

```{r}

# Personalized Theme function

styled_theme <- function(
  style = c("academic", "minimal", "modern", "dark", "classic", "void"),
  border_mode = c("default", "all", "none"),
  title_align = c("center", "left", "right"),
  legends_to_drop = NULL,
  axes_title_drop = FALSE,
  legend_position = c("default", "top", "bottom", "left", "right", "inside"),
  axis_title_face = c("regular", "bold"),
  x_axis_text_angle = 45,
  x_axis_text_y = -0.3,
  remove_margin = c("none", "bottom", "all", "top", "left", "right")
) {
  style <- match.arg(style)
  border_mode <- match.arg(border_mode)
  title_align <- match.arg(title_align)
  legend_position <- match.arg(legend_position)
  axis_title_face <- match.arg(axis_title_face)
  remove_margin <- match.arg(remove_margin)

  base_font <- "Helvetica"
  align_map <- c(left = 0, center = 0.5, right = 1)
  hjust_val <- align_map[title_align]
  thin_size <- 0.3  

  # Decide axis title face
  axis_face_val <- ifelse(axis_title_face == "bold", "bold", "plain")

  # Base theme selection
  if (style == "void") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),  
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "academic") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = hjust_val, color = "grey30"),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 1, color = "grey40"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val, size = 13),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "minimal") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        legend.position = "none",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic")
      )
  } else if (style == "modern") {
    theme_out <- theme_light(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey80", linetype = "dashed", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "dark") {
    theme_out <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "black", color = NA),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey30", size = thin_size),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, color = "white", hjust = hjust_val),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey80", hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "white", face = axis_face_val),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        legend.key = element_blank(),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "white"),
        legend.title = element_text(color = "white", face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "white", size = thin_size)
      )
  } else if (style == "classic") {
    theme_out <- theme_classic(base_size = 13, base_family = base_font) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = hjust_val),
        axis.title = element_text(face = axis_face_val),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(face = "italic"),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black", size = thin_size)
      )
  }

  # Apply border mode
  if (border_mode == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = thin_size))
  } else if (border_mode == "none") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(panel.border = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank())
  }

  # Drop axes titles if requested
  if (axes_title_drop) {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank())
  }

  # Override x-axis text angle and vertical position
  theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = x_axis_text_angle,
      vjust = 1,
      hjust = 1,
      margin = margin(t = x_axis_text_y)
    )
  )

  # Handle margin removal
  if (remove_margin == "all") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "top") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "bottom") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(b = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "left") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(l = 0))
  } else if (remove_margin == "right") {
    theme_out <- theme_out + theme(plot.margin = margin(r = 0))
  }
  # if "none", do nothing

  # Legend positioning override
  if (legend_position != "default") {
    if (legend_position == "inside") {
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = c(0.98, 0.98),
        legend.justification = c("right", "top"),
        legend.direction = "vertical"
      )
    } else {
      horiz <- legend_position %in% c("top", "bottom")
      theme_out <- theme_out + theme(
        legend.position = legend_position,
        legend.direction = if (horiz) "horizontal" else "vertical"
      )
    }
  }

  # Return theme + guides if needed
  if (!is.null(legends_to_drop)) {
    drop_list <- lapply(legends_to_drop, function(x) "none")
    names(drop_list) <- legends_to_drop
    return(list(theme_out, guides(.list = drop_list)))
  } else {
    return(theme_out)
  }
}

# Label plot
label_plt <- function(label = "Label", size = 1) {
  ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    # Draw a single vertical bar
    geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = "lightgrey", color = "black") +
    # Add vertical text (angle=90)
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0.5, label = label, size = size,
             angle = 90, size = 6, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5) +
    # Remove all extra space
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_void(base_size = 14) +             # no axes, ticks, labels
    theme(
        plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),      # remove outside margins
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),         # remove panel padding
        plot.background = element_blank(),     # no background
        panel.background = element_blank()
    )
}

# Benchmarking speed

run_with_bench <- function(fun, memlog = "memlog.out") {
  # fun: a function with no arguments, OR an expression wrapped in a function
  # memlog: file to store Rprofmem output
  
  # Start memory profiling
  Rprofmem(memlog)
  
  # Measure time + capture result
  timing <- system.time({
    result_obj <- fun()
  })
  
  # Stop memory profiling
  Rprofmem(NULL)
  
  # Read memory log
  mem_lines <- readLines(memlog, warn = FALSE)
  
  # Extract numeric byte counts
  mem_bytes <- suppressWarnings(
    sum(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", mem_lines)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # Return everything in a clean object
  return(list(
    result = result_obj,
    time   = timing,
    mem_bytes = mem_bytes
  ))
}

# Min-Max Normalize function
min_max_norm <- function(x) {
  min_val <- min(x)
  max_val <- max(x)
  if (max_val > min_val) {
    return((x - min_val) / (max_val - min_val))
  } else {
    return(rep(0, length(x)))
  }
}

# Create a custom formatter for bolding only Avg.[Score] in the heatmap plots
bold_labeller <- function(x) {
  sapply(x, function(val) {
    if (val == "Median Score") {
      # Bold using plotmath
      return(expression(bold("Median Score")))
    } else {
      # Normal label, but still parsed for superscripts etc
      return(val)
    }
  })
}

# Pielou's evenness: how balanced the abundances of cell types are
pielou_evenness <- function(labels) {
    
    # Number of classes
    unique_classes <- function(labels) {
        length(unique(labels))
    }
    
    # Entropy
    entropy <- function(labels) {
        p <- table(labels) / length(labels)
        -sum(p * log(p))
    }
    
    # Pielou's evenness
    entropy(labels)/log(unique_classes(labels))
}
```

A function for converting count df to sparse matrix

```{r}

library(Rcpp)
library(RcppArmadillo)

Rcpp::sourceCpp(code = '
#define ARMA_64BIT_WORD 1
#include <RcppArmadillo.h>
// [[Rcpp::depends(RcppArmadillo)]]

// [[Rcpp::export]]
Rcpp::S4 denseToSparse(Rcpp::DataFrame& df) {  // Pass by reference to allow in-place modification
  int nrows = df.nrows();
  int ncols = df.size();

  arma::sp_mat sparse(nrows, ncols);

  for (int col = 0; col < ncols; ++col) {
    arma::vec this_col = Rcpp::as<arma::vec>(df[col]);  // Wrap without copying
    sparse.col(col) = this_col;  // Assigns only non-zeros to sparse
    df[col] = R_NilValue;  // Free the column memory progressively
  }

  return Rcpp::wrap(sparse);  // Returns as dgCMatrix S4 object
}
')
```

# Data preparation

## PBMC3K

```{r}

library(patchwork)
library(scplotter)

# SeuratData::InstallData("pbmc3k")
pbmc <- SeuratData::LoadData("pbmc3k")

pbmc_bench_seurat_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, assay = "RNA", normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, verbose = F)
    pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = F)
    pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc), verbose = F)
    pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc), verbose = F)
    pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10, verbose = F)
    pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, verbose = F)
    pbmc
  }
)

pbmc <- pbmc_bench_seurat_out$result
pbmc_bench_seurat_out$result <- NULL

pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

pbmc_bench_ClustoCell_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    clustoCell(data = pbmc, high_quantile = 0.25, low_quantile = 0.25, subset_to_HVG = F,
               identify_subclusters = F,
               verbose = F,
               seed = 121)
  }
)

pbmc_ClustoCell <- pbmc_bench_ClustoCell_out$result
pbmc_bench_ClustoCell_out$result <- NULL
pbmc <- addClustoData(obj = pbmc, clustoCell = pbmc_ClustoCell, major_cluster_name = "ClustoCell", sub_cluster_name = "SubClustoCell")

#____________________________________

pbmc$manual_annot <- pbmc$seurat_annotations

pbmc@meta.data <- pbmc@meta.data %>%
```

## PBMC10k

```{r}
pbmc10k@meta.data <- pbmc10k@meta.data %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(major_manual_cellTypes = case_when(
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("CD4 Naive", "CD4 TCM", "CD4 TEM", "Treg") ~ "CD4 T",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Plasma", "Intermediate B", "Memory B", "Naive B") ~ "B",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("CD8 Naive", "CD8 TEM_1", "CD8 TEM_2","MAIT", "NK") ~ "CL",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("CD14 Mono", "CD16 Mono", "cDC", "pDC") ~ "MNP",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("gdT") ~ "γδ T",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Platelet") ~ "PLT",
    .default = manual_annot
  ))

pbmc10k$major_manual_cellTypes <- factor(pbmc10k$major_manual_cellTypes, levels = c("CD4 T", "B", "CL", "MNP", "γδ T", "HSPC"))

pbmc10k_bench_seurat_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    pbmc10k <- NormalizeData(pbmc10k, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, verbose = F)
    pbmc10k <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc10k, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = F)
    pbmc10k <- ScaleData(pbmc10k, features = VariableFeatures(pbmc10k), verbose = F)
    pbmc10k <- RunPCA(pbmc10k, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc10k), verbose = F)
    pbmc10k <- FindNeighbors(pbmc10k, dims = 1:12, verbose = F)
    pbmc10k <- FindClusters(pbmc10k, verbose = F)
    pbmc10k
  }
)

pbmc10k <- pbmc10k_bench_seurat_out$result
pbmc10k_bench_seurat_out$result <- NULL

# Run non-linear dimensional reduction (UMAP/tSNE)
pbmc10k <- RunUMAP(pbmc10k, dims = 1:12)

# Find the clusters via ClustoCell
pbmc10k_bench_ClustoCell_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    clustoCell(data = pbmc10k, high_quantile = 0.25, low_quantile = 0.25, subset_to_HVG = F,
               identify_subclusters = F,
               verbose = F,
               seed = 121)
  }
)

pbmc10k_ClustoCell <- pbmc10k_bench_ClustoCell_out$result
pbmc10k_bench_ClustoCell_out$result <- NULL
pbmc10k <- addClustoData(obj = pbmc10k, clustoCell = pbmc10k_ClustoCell, major_cluster_name = "ClustoCell", sub_cluster_name = "SubClustoCell")

  "CD4 TCM" = c(
```

## Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor

Data was downloaded from https://explore.data.humancellatlas.org/projects/a27dd619-25ad-46a0-ae0c-5c4940a1139b
https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE153643
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33654293/

```{r}

library(zellkonverter)

liver_tumor_adj <- readH5AD("../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/GSM4648565_liver_raw_counts.h5ad")
liver_tumor_adj_count <- liver_tumor_adj@assays@data$X %>% t()
liver_tumor_adj_meta <- fread("../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/GSM4648565_liver_celltypes.csv.gz", header = F)
colnames(liver_tumor_adj_meta) <- c("Cell", "Celltype")

all(liver_tumor_adj_meta$Cell %in% colnames(liver_tumor_adj_count)) # TRUE
liver_tumor_adj_count <- liver_tumor_adj_count[,liver_tumor_adj_meta$Cell]
all(liver_tumor_adj_meta$Cell == colnames(liver_tumor_adj_count)) # TRUE

liver_tumor_adj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = liver_tumor_adj_count, meta.data = liver_tumor_adj_meta)
liver_tumor_adj$manual_annot <- liver_tumor_adj$Celltype
liver_tumor_adj$major_manual_annot <- sapply(liver_tumor_adj$manual_annot, function(i) unlist(str_split(i, " "))[1])

liver_tumor_adj@meta.data <- liver_tumor_adj@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(minor_manual_annot1 = case_when(
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Epithelial (Cholangiocyte)") ~ "Cholangiocyte",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Epithelial (Hepatocyte)") ~ "Hepatocyte",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Immune (Lymphocyte)") ~ "Lymphocyte",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Immune (Macrophage)") ~ "Myeloid",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Immune (Myeloid)") ~ "Myeloid",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Stromal (Endothelial)") ~ "Endothelial",
    as.character(manual_annot) %in% c("Stromal (SMC)") ~ "SMC",
    .default = manual_annot
  ))

liver_tumor_adj_bench_seurat_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    liver_tumor_adj <- NormalizeData(liver_tumor_adj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000, verbose = F)
    liver_tumor_adj <- FindVariableFeatures(liver_tumor_adj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = F)
    liver_tumor_adj <- ScaleData(liver_tumor_adj, features = VariableFeatures(liver_tumor_adj), verbose = F)
    liver_tumor_adj <- RunPCA(liver_tumor_adj, features = VariableFeatures(object = liver_tumor_adj), verbose = F)
    liver_tumor_adj <- FindNeighbors(liver_tumor_adj, dims = 1:20, verbose = F)
    liver_tumor_adj <- FindClusters(liver_tumor_adj, verbose = F)
    liver_tumor_adj
  }
)

liver_tumor_adj <- liver_tumor_adj_bench_seurat_out$result
liver_tumor_adj_bench_seurat_out$result <- NULL

# Run non-linear dimensional reduction
liver_tumor_adj <- RunUMAP(liver_tumor_adj, dims = 1:20)

qs2::qs_save(object = liver_tumor_adj, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/liver_tumor_adj_for_clustering_bench.qs2")

# Find the clusters via ClustoCell
liver_tumor_adj_bench_ClustoCell_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    clustoCell(data = liver_tumor_adj, high_quantile = 0.25, low_quantile = 0.25, subset_to_HVG = F,
               identify_subclusters = F,
               verbose = F,
               seed = 121)
  }
)

liver_tumor_adj_ClustoCell <- liver_tumor_adj_bench_ClustoCell_out$result
liver_tumor_adj_bench_ClustoCell_out$result <- NULL
liver_tumor_adj <- addClustoData(obj = liver_tumor_adj, clustoCell = liver_tumor_adj_ClustoCell, major_cluster_name = "ClustoCell", sub_cluster_name = "SubClustoCell")

qs2::qs_save(object = liver_tumor_adj, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/liver_tumor_adj_for_clustering_bench.qs2")

qs2::qs_save(object = liver_tumor_adj_ClustoCell, 
             file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/liver_tumor_adj_ClustoCell.qs2")

# liver_tumor_adj_ClustoCell <- qs2::qs_read("../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/liver_tumor_adj_ClustoCell.qs2")

liver_tumor_adj <- qs2::qs_read("../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Healthy liver tissue adjacent to tumor/liver_tumor_adj_for_clustering_bench.qs2")

liver_tumor_adj_signature <- list(
  
  # -------------------------
  # LYMPHOCYTES (T, B, NK)
  # -------------------------
  "Lymphocyte" = c(
    # pan-lymphoid
    "CD3D", "CD3E", "CD2",          # T-lineage
    "CD79A", "MS4A1",               # B-lineage
    "NKG7", "GNLY", "KLRD1", "TRAC" # NK/T cytotoxic programs
```

## Basal Cell Carcinoma

The data was downloaded from https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE123813
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/31359002/

```{r}

bcc_count <- fread("../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Basal-Squamous Cell Carcinoma/GSE123813_bcc_scRNA_counts.txt.gz")
bcc_count <- bcc_count %>% column_to_rownames("V1")

bcc_metadata <- fread("../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Basal-Squamous Cell Carcinoma/GSE123813_bcc_all_metadata.txt.gz")
all(bcc_metadata$cell.id %in% colnames(bcc_count)) # TRUE

nrow(bcc_metadata)
ncol(bcc_count)

bcc_count <- bcc_count[,bcc_metadata$cell.id]
all(colnames(bcc_count) == bcc_metadata$cell.id) # TRUE

#________________________

bcc_so <- CreateSeuratObject(bcc_count, meta.data = bcc_metadata, min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
rm(bcc_count)

bcc_so@meta.data <- cbind(bcc_so@meta.data, bcc_metadata[bcc_metadata$cell.id %in% colnames(bcc_so),])

bcc_so <- NormalizeData(bcc_so, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
bcc_so <- FindVariableFeatures(bcc_so, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

set.seed(121) 
bcc_so <- SketchData(
  object = bcc_so,
  assay = "RNA",
  ncells = 20000,
  method = "Uniform",
  sketched.assay = "sketch", 
  verbose = F
)

DefaultAssay(bcc_so) <- "sketch"
bcc_so <- FindVariableFeatures(bcc_so, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
bcc_so <- ScaleData(bcc_so, features = VariableFeatures(bcc_so))
bcc_so <- RunPCA(bcc_so, features = VariableFeatures(object = bcc_so))

qs2::qs_save(object = bcc_so, file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/Basal-Squamous Cell Carcinoma/bcc_so_for_clustering_bench.qs2")

bcc_so_bench_seurat_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    bcc_so <- FindNeighbors(bcc_so, assay = "sketch", dims = 1:20, verbose = F)
    bcc_so <- FindClusters(bcc_so, verbose = F)
    
    bcc_so <- ProjectData(
      object = bcc_so,
      assay = "RNA",
      full.reduction = "pca.full",
      sketched.assay = "sketch",
      sketched.reduction = "pca", 
      dims = 1:20,
      refdata = c(seurat_clusters = "seurat_clusters") , 
      verbose = F
    )
    bcc_so
  }
)

bcc_so <- bcc_so_bench_seurat_out$result
bcc_so_bench_seurat_out$result <- NULL

#_________________

bcc_so_bench_ClustoCell_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    bcc_so_ClustoCell <- clustoCell(data = bcc_so, 
                                             identify_subclusters = F, 
                                             sketch = T, sketch_ncells = 20000,
                                             high_quantile = 0.25, low_quantile = 0.25, 
                                             subset_to_HVG = F, seed = 121, verbose = F)
    
    bcc_so <- addClustoData(obj = bcc_so, clustoCell = bcc_so_ClustoCell, major_cluster_name = "ClustoCell", 
                                     add_sub_clusters = FALSE)
    
    list(bcc_so_ClustoCell = bcc_so_ClustoCell,
         bcc_so = bcc_so)
  }
)

bcc_so_ClustoCell <- bcc_so_bench_ClustoCell_out$result$bcc_so_ClustoCell
```

## LUAD Cell Atlas

The data was downloaded from https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE131907

```{python}

import gzip

input_file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/GSE131907/GSE131907_Lung_Cancer_raw_UMI_matrix.txt.gz"
output_file = "../../../Benchmarking/Test Datasets/GSE131907/GSE131907_Lung_Cancer_sparse.mtx"
triplet_file = "temp_triplets.txt"

nnz = 0
row_i = 0

with gzip.open(input_file, 'rt') as f, open(triplet_file, 'w') as trip_f:
    header = f.readline().strip().split('\t')
    ncols = len(header) - 1  # Exclude gene column
    
    for line in f:
        parts = line.strip().split('\t')
        if len(parts) != ncols + 1:
            continue
        row_i += 1
        for col_j in range(1, len(parts)):
            v = parts[col_j]
            if v != '0':
                val = int(v)  # Use int for UMI counts; switch to float if needed
                if val != 0:  # Safety check
                    trip_f.write(f"{row_i} {col_j} {val}\n")
                    nnz += 1
        if row_i % 100 == 0:
            print(f"Processed {row_i} rows, found {nnz:,} non-zeros so far.")

# Assemble final .mtx
with open(output_file, 'w') as mtx_f:
    mtx_f.write("%%MatrixMarket matrix coordinate real general\n")  # Or 'integer' if all ints
    mtx_f.write(f"{row_i} {ncols} {nnz}\n")
    with open(triplet_file, 'r') as trip_f:
        mtx_f.write(trip_f.read())

# Clean up temp file
import os
os.remove(triplet_file)

print(f"Wrote sparse matrix to {output_file} with {nnz:,} non-zero entries.")

```

#### Part 1

```{r}

# ==============================================================================
# 01_3CA_h5ad_to_seurat.R
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Converts all 3CA h5ad files to Seurat RDS objects.
#
# For each study:
#   1. Reads h5ad → SingleCellExperiment via zellkonverter
#   2. Picks the best assay (counts > logcounts > data > X)
#   3. Detects data type using layername + multi-signal value inspection
#   4. Transfers ALL obs columns into Seurat metadata
#   5. Identifies annotation columns: cell_type (primary) > cell_subtype
#      (secondary if present) > authors_cell_type (fallback primary)
#   6. Stores all provenance in seurat@misc[["pipeline_info"]]
#   7. Saves as <dataset>.rds — skips if already exists (safe to re-run)
#
# Output log: results/3CA_h5ad_to_seurat_log.tsv
#
# Usage:
#   Rscript 01_3CA_h5ad_to_seurat.R
#
# Requirements:
#   BiocManager::install("zellkonverter")
#   install.packages(c("Seurat", "SeuratObject", "Matrix"))
#
# Author:
#   Natalia Pretel
#
# Date:
#.  June 2026
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(zellkonverter)
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(Matrix)
})

# ── CONFIGURE PATHS ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
H5AD_DIR <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/data/3CA/3ca_original"
OUT_DIR  <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/data/3CA/3CA_seurat"
LOG_DIR  <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/results"
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ANNOT_PRIORITY <- c("cell_type", "cell_subtype", "authors_cell_type")

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(LOG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# HELPERS
# ==============================================================================

# ── Pick best assay from SCE ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
pick_assay <- function(sce) {
  available <- assayNames(sce)
  cat("    Available assays:", paste(available, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  for (candidate in c("counts", "logcounts", "data", "X")) {
    if (candidate %in% available) return(candidate)
  }
  return(available[1])
}

# ── Robust data type detection ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Combines 5 independent numerical signals + assay name prior:
#
# Signal 1 — assay name prior:
#   "counts"            → raw_counts
#   "logcounts/lognorm" → log_normalized
#   "data", "X", other  → unknown
#
# Signal 2 — integer check (tolerance-based to handle float32 precision):
#   all(|val - round(val)| < 1e-6) → consistent with raw_counts
#
# Signal 3 — sparsity ratio (% zeros over total matrix elements):
#   > 70%  → consistent with raw_counts (typical scRNA-seq: 60-95%)
#   40-70% → ambiguous
#   < 40%  → consistent with normalized data
#
# Signal 4 — maximum non-zero value (biologically informed thresholds):
#   max < 20            → log_normalized  (log1p(10000) ≈ 9.2; log1p(TPM) ≤ ~14)
#   20 ≤ max < 50       → ambiguous (could be log1p(TPM high) or small counts)
#   max ≥ 50            → raw_counts or tpm_cpm
#
# Signal 5 — median of non-zero values:
#   median < 5          → log_normalized  (log1p scale centers low)
#   5 ≤ median < 50     → ambiguous
#   median ≥ 50         → raw_counts or tpm_cpm
#
# Signal 6 — SCE uns metadata: presence of "log1p" key confirms normalization
#
# Final decision: majority vote across signals, with name prior as tiebreaker.
# Confidence: high (≥4 signals agree), medium (3 agree), low (<3 or conflict)
#
# Returns list(data_type, layer_used, confidence, note, signal_summary)
detect_data_type <- function(mat, assay_name, sce = NULL) {

  votes <- character(0)   # accumulate votes from each signal
  notes <- character(0)   # human-readable per-signal notes

  # ── Signal 1: assay name prior ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  name_lower <- tolower(assay_name)
  name_prior <- switch(name_lower,
    "counts"        = "raw_counts",
    "logcounts"     = "log_normalized",
    "lognormcounts" = "log_normalized",
    "lognorm"       = "log_normalized",
    NA_character_   # data / X / anything else → abstain
  )
  if (!is.na(name_prior)) {
    votes <- c(votes, name_prior)
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S1(name='%s'→%s)", assay_name, name_prior))
  } else {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S1(name='%s'→abstain)", assay_name))
  }

  # ── Signal 6: SCE uns metadata — check for log1p key ────────────────────────
  # Do this early so it can inform other thresholds
  has_log1p_key <- FALSE
  if (!is.null(sce)) {
    uns <- metadata(sce)
    if (!is.null(uns[["log1p"]]) || "log1p" %in% names(uns)) {
      has_log1p_key <- TRUE
      votes <- c(votes, "log_normalized")
      notes <- c(notes, "S6(uns$log1p key found→log_normalized)")
    } else {
      notes <- c(notes, "S6(no log1p key in uns)")
    }
  }

  # ── Extract matrix statistics ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  n_total <- as.numeric(nrow(mat)) * as.numeric(ncol(mat))

  if (inherits(mat, "sparseMatrix")) {
    nzvals    <- mat@x
    n_nonzero <- length(nzvals)
    sparsity  <- 1 - (n_nonzero / n_total)
    if (n_nonzero == 0) {
      return(list(data_type = "raw_counts", layer_used = "counts",
                  confidence = "low",
                  note = "Matrix is all zeros — cannot detect data type",
                  signal_summary = "all-zero matrix"))
    }
    sampled <- sample(nzvals, min(n_nonzero, 5000))
  } else {
    all_vals  <- as.vector(mat)
    all_vals  <- all_vals[!is.na(all_vals)]
    n_nonzero <- sum(all_vals != 0)
    sparsity  <- 1 - (n_nonzero / n_total)
    nzvals    <- all_vals[all_vals != 0]
    sampled   <- sample(nzvals, min(length(nzvals), 5000))
  }

  val_max    <- max(sampled)
  val_min    <- min(sampled)
  val_median <- median(sampled)

  # ── Signal 2: tolerance-based integer check ──────────────────────────────────
  # Use tolerance of 1e-6 to handle float32 rounding artifacts
  # e.g. 1.0000001 should be treated as integer
  all_integer <- all(abs(sampled - round(sampled)) < 1e-6)
  has_negative <- val_min < 0

  if (has_negative) {
    votes <- c(votes, "scaled")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S2(has_negative=TRUE, min=%.3f→scaled)", val_min))
  } else if (all_integer) {
    votes <- c(votes, "raw_counts")
    notes <- c(notes, "S2(all_integer=TRUE→raw_counts)")
  } else {
    # Non-integer: consistent with normalized data (log or TPM)
    votes <- c(votes, "normalized")   # generic; signals 4+5 will distinguish
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S2(all_integer=FALSE, min=%.4f→normalized)", val_min))
  }

  # ── Signal 3: sparsity ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  sparsity_pct <- round(sparsity * 100, 1)
  if (sparsity > 0.70) {
    votes <- c(votes, "raw_counts")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S3(sparsity=%.1f%%>70%%→raw_counts)", sparsity_pct))
  } else if (sparsity < 0.40) {
    votes <- c(votes, "normalized")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S3(sparsity=%.1f%%<40%%→normalized)", sparsity_pct))
  } else {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S3(sparsity=%.1f%%→ambiguous, abstain)", sparsity_pct))
  }

  # ── Signal 4: max value ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Biologically informed thresholds:
  #   log1p(10,000)  ≈ 9.2   (typical UMI max after normalization to 10k)
  #   log1p(1e6)     ≈ 13.8  (TPM upper bound after log1p)
  #   Anything < 20 is safely log scale; ≥ 50 is safely counts or raw TPM
  if (val_max < 20) {
    votes <- c(votes, "log_normalized")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S4(max=%.2f<20→log_normalized)", val_max))
  } else if (val_max < 50) {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S4(max=%.2f 20-50→ambiguous, abstain)", val_max))
  } else {
    votes <- c(votes, "raw_counts_or_tpm")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S4(max=%.2f≥50→raw_counts_or_tpm)", val_max))
  }

  # ── Signal 5: median of non-zero values ─────────────────────────────────────
  # log1p-normalized data typically has median non-zero ~1-4
  # raw counts typically have median non-zero ~1-3 too (but max is huge)
  # TPM raw: median non-zero can be hundreds to thousands
  # So median alone is not decisive — use it to distinguish tpm_cpm from log
  if (val_median < 10 && val_max < 20) {
    votes <- c(votes, "log_normalized")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S5(median=%.2f<10 & max<20→log_normalized)", val_median))
  } else if (val_median >= 10 && !all_integer) {
    votes <- c(votes, "tpm_cpm")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S5(median=%.2f≥10, non-integer→tpm_cpm)", val_median))
  } else {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S5(median=%.2f→ambiguous, abstain)", val_median))
  }

  # ── Final decision: majority vote ────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Collapse "normalized" and "raw_counts_or_tpm" generic votes
  # into the more specific categories using available evidence
  resolve_generic <- function(v) {
    if (v == "normalized") {
      # Distinguish log vs tpm by max value
      if (val_max < 20) return("log_normalized")
      else              return("tpm_cpm")
    }
    if (v == "raw_counts_or_tpm") {
      # Distinguish by integer check
      if (all_integer) return("raw_counts")
      else             return("tpm_cpm")
    }
    return(v)
  }

  resolved_votes <- sapply(votes, resolve_generic)

  if ("scaled" %in% resolved_votes) {
    final_type <- "scaled"
    confidence <- "high"
  } else {
    vote_table <- sort(table(resolved_votes), decreasing = TRUE)
    top_vote   <- names(vote_table)[1]
    top_count  <- vote_table[1]
    total_votes <- length(resolved_votes)

    final_type <- top_vote
    if (top_count >= 4 || (total_votes >= 2 && top_count == total_votes)) {
      confidence <- "high"
    } else if (top_count >= 3) {
      confidence <- "medium"
    } else {
      confidence <- "low"
    }
  }

  layer_used     <- if (final_type == "raw_counts") "counts" else "data"
  signal_summary <- paste(notes, collapse = " | ")

  list(data_type      = final_type,
       layer_used     = layer_used,
       confidence     = confidence,
       note           = signal_summary,
       sparsity_pct   = sparsity_pct,
       val_max        = round(val_max, 3),
       val_median_nz  = round(val_median, 3),
       all_integer    = all_integer)
}

# ── Pick primary annotation column ───────────────────────────────────────────
pick_annot_col <- function(meta_cols, priority = ANNOT_PRIORITY) {
  for (col in priority) {
    if (col %in% meta_cols) return(col)
  }
  return(NA_character_)
}

# ==============================================================================
# MAIN LOOP
# ==============================================================================

h5ad_files <- sort(list.files(H5AD_DIR, pattern = "\\.h5ad$", full.names = TRUE))
cat(sprintf("Found %d h5ad files in %s\n\n", length(h5ad_files), H5AD_DIR))

log_records <- list()

for (fpath in h5ad_files) {

  fname   <- basename(fpath)
  dataset <- sub("\\.h5ad$", "", fname)
  out_rds <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(dataset, ".rds"))

  cat(sprintf("── %s ──\n", dataset))

  # Skip if already processed
  if (file.exists(out_rds)) {
    cat("   [SKIP] RDS already exists.\n\n")
    log_records[[dataset]] <- data.frame(
      dataset             = dataset,
      status              = "skipped",
      n_cells             = NA, n_genes        = NA,
      data_type           = NA, layer_used     = NA,
      dt_confidence       = NA, sparsity_pct   = NA,
      val_max             = NA, val_median_nz  = NA,
      all_integer         = NA,
      annot_col_primary   = NA, annot_col_secondary = NA,
      all_obs_cols        = NA, error          = NA,
      stringsAsFactors    = FALSE
    )
    next
  }

  tryCatch({

    # 1. Read h5ad → SCE
    cat("   Reading h5ad...\n")
    sce     <- readH5AD(fpath, use_hdf5 = FALSE, reader = "R")
    n_cells <- ncol(sce)
    n_genes <- nrow(sce)
    cat(sprintf("   %s cells | %s genes\n",
                format(n_cells, big.mark = ","),
                format(n_genes, big.mark = ",")))

    # 2. Pick assay + detect data type (pass sce for uns metadata check)
    assay_name <- pick_assay(sce)
    mat        <- assay(sce, assay_name)
    if (!inherits(mat, "dgCMatrix")) mat <- as(mat, "dgCMatrix")

    dt <- detect_data_type(mat, assay_name, sce = sce)
    cat(sprintf("   Assay        : %s\n",      assay_name))
    cat(sprintf("   Data type    : %s  (confidence: %s)\n", dt$data_type, dt$confidence))
    cat(sprintf("   Layer slot   : %s\n",      dt$layer_used))
    cat(sprintf("   Sparsity     : %.1f%%\n",  dt$sparsity_pct))
    cat(sprintf("   Max value    : %.3f\n",    dt$val_max))
    cat(sprintf("   Median (nz)  : %.3f\n",    dt$val_median_nz))
    cat(sprintf("   All integer  : %s\n",      dt$all_integer))
    cat(sprintf("   Signals      : %s\n",      dt$note))

    # 3. Build Seurat object
    cat("   Building Seurat object...\n")
    seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, assay = "RNA", project = dataset)

    if (dt$layer_used == "data") {
      seurat_obj <- SetAssayData(seurat_obj, layer = "data",   new.data = mat)
      empty_mat  <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
        i = integer(0), j = integer(0),
        dims     = c(n_genes, n_cells),
        dimnames = dimnames(mat)
      )
      seurat_obj <- SetAssayData(seurat_obj, layer = "counts", new.data = empty_mat)
    }

    # 4. Transfer all obs metadata
    obs_df   <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
    obs_cols <- colnames(obs_df)
    for (col in obs_cols) seurat_obj[[col]] <- obs_df[[col]]

    # 5. Identify annotation columns
    annot_primary   <- pick_annot_col(obs_cols)
    annot_secondary <- NA_character_

    if (!is.na(annot_primary) && annot_primary == "cell_type" &&
        "cell_subtype" %in% obs_cols) {
      annot_secondary <- "cell_subtype"
    }

    if (is.na(annot_primary)) {
      warning(sprintf("[WARN] No annotation column found. Obs cols: %s",
                      paste(obs_cols, collapse = ", ")))
      cat("   [WARN] No annotation column found!\n")
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("   Primary annot   : %s  (%d unique)\n",
                  annot_primary,
                  length(unique(seurat_obj[[annot_primary, drop = TRUE]]))))
      if (!is.na(annot_secondary)) {
        cat(sprintf("   Secondary annot : %s  (%d unique)\n",
                    annot_secondary,
                    length(unique(seurat_obj[[annot_secondary, drop = TRUE]]))))
      }
    }

    # 6. Store full provenance in misc slot
    seurat_obj@misc[["pipeline_info"]] <- list(
      dataset             = dataset,
      source              = "3CA",
      data_type           = dt$data_type,
      layer_used          = dt$layer_used,
      dt_confidence       = dt$confidence,
      dt_signals          = dt$note,
      sparsity_pct        = dt$sparsity_pct,
      val_max             = dt$val_max,
      val_median_nz       = dt$val_median_nz,
      all_integer         = dt$all_integer,
      annot_col_primary   = annot_primary,
      annot_col_secondary = annot_secondary,
      all_obs_cols        = obs_cols
    )

    # 7. Save
    cat(sprintf("   Saving → %s\n", out_rds))
    saveRDS(seurat_obj, file = out_rds)
    cat("   [DONE]\n\n")

    log_records[[dataset]] <- data.frame(
      dataset             = dataset,
      status              = "success",
      n_cells             = n_cells,
      n_genes             = n_genes,
      data_type           = dt$data_type,
      layer_used          = dt$layer_used,
      dt_confidence       = dt$confidence,
      sparsity_pct        = dt$sparsity_pct,
      val_max             = dt$val_max,
      val_median_nz       = dt$val_median_nz,
      all_integer         = dt$all_integer,
      annot_col_primary   = ifelse(is.na(annot_primary),   "NONE_FOUND", annot_primary),
      annot_col_secondary = ifelse(is.na(annot_secondary), "",           annot_secondary),
      all_obs_cols        = paste(obs_cols, collapse = " | "),
      error               = NA,
      stringsAsFactors    = FALSE
    )

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("   [ERROR] %s\n\n", conditionMessage(e)))
    log_records[[dataset]] <<- data.frame(
      dataset             = dataset,
      status              = "error",
      n_cells             = NA, n_genes        = NA,
      data_type           = NA, layer_used     = NA,
      dt_confidence       = NA, sparsity_pct   = NA,
      val_max             = NA, val_median_nz  = NA,
      all_integer         = NA,
      annot_col_primary   = NA, annot_col_secondary = NA,
      all_obs_cols        = NA,
      error               = conditionMessage(e),
      stringsAsFactors    = FALSE
    )
  })
}

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE LOG + SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

log_df   <- do.call(rbind, log_records)
log_path <- file.path(LOG_DIR, "3CA_h5ad_to_seurat_log.tsv")
write.table(log_df, log_path, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\nLog saved → %s\n", log_path))

cat("\n── Run summary ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total   : %d\n", nrow(log_df)))
cat(sprintf("  Success : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "success", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Skipped : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "skipped", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Errors  : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "error",   na.rm = TRUE)))

low_conf <- log_df[!is.na(log_df$dt_confidence) &
                     log_df$dt_confidence == "low", "dataset"]
if (length(low_conf) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\n  [WARN] Low-confidence data type detection (%d studies):\n", length(low_conf)))
  cat(paste0("    - ", low_conf, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}

no_annot <- log_df[!is.na(log_df$annot_col_primary) &
                     log_df$annot_col_primary == "NONE_FOUND", "dataset"]
if (length(no_annot) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\n  [WARN] No annotation column found (%d studies):\n", length(no_annot)))
  cat(paste0("    - ", no_annot, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}

cat("\nDone.\n")

```

```{r}

# ==============================================================================
# 01b_fix_Bassez2021_from_original.R
# ==============================================================================
# Rebuilds Breast_Bassez2021 directly from the original authors' data
# (BIOKEY cohort1 + cohort2, GEO supplementary files) instead of 3CA's
# re-packaged version. 3CA's Breast_Bassez2021 produced abnormally low
# concordance (33% major) despite a plausible cell count -- consistent with
# a metadata/expression misalignment during 3CA's own repackaging, not a
# cell-count-collision bug like Gao2021. Rebuilding from the untouched
# author files (mtx + genes + barcodes + BIOKEY metadata, matched 1:1 by
# barcode) sidesteps whatever 3CA did entirely.
#
# Source: /Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/clustocell_2/data/Original_Bassez2021
#   cohort1/2_expression.mtx, cohort1/2_genes.tsv, cohort1/2_barcodes.tsv
#   187x-BIOKEY_metaData_cohortN_web.csv (Cell, patient_id, timepoint,
#     expansion, BC_type, cellType, cohort)
#
# Barcodes already carry a globally-unique patient/timepoint prefix
# (e.g. "BIOKEY_13_Pre_AAACCTGCAACAACCT-1") -- no collision risk merging
# the two cohorts, unlike TISCH2/Gao2021's bare-barcode problem.
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(Matrix)
})

SRC_DIR <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/clustocell_2/data/Original_Bassez2021"
OUT_RDS <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/clustocell_2/data/3CA/3CA_seurat/Breast_Bassez2021.rds"

load_cohort <- function(cohort_label, mtx_name, genes_name, barcodes_name, meta_name) {
  cat(sprintf("\n── %s ──\n", cohort_label))

  mat <- readMM(file.path(SRC_DIR, mtx_name))
  genes    <- readLines(file.path(SRC_DIR, genes_name))
  barcodes <- readLines(file.path(SRC_DIR, barcodes_name))
  rownames(mat) <- make.unique(genes)
  colnames(mat) <- barcodes
  mat <- as(mat, "CsparseMatrix")
  cat(sprintf("  Matrix: %s genes x %s cells\n",
              format(nrow(mat), big.mark = ","), format(ncol(mat), big.mark = ",")))

  meta <- read.csv(file.path(SRC_DIR, meta_name), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("  Metadata: %s rows\n", format(nrow(meta), big.mark = ",")))

  common <- intersect(colnames(mat), meta$Cell)
  cat(sprintf("  Matched %s / %s cells to metadata\n",
              format(length(common), big.mark = ","), format(ncol(mat), big.mark = ",")))
  if (length(common) != ncol(mat)) {
    stop(sprintf("%s: not all cells matched metadata (%d / %d)",
                 cohort_label, length(common), ncol(mat)))
  }

  mat  <- mat[, common, drop = FALSE]
  meta <- meta[match(common, meta$Cell), ]
  rownames(meta) <- common

  list(mat = mat, meta = meta)
}

c1 <- load_cohort("Cohort 1", "cohort1_expression.mtx", "cohort1_genes.tsv",
                   "cohort1_barcodes.tsv", "1872-BIOKEY_metaData_cohort1_web.csv")
c2 <- load_cohort("Cohort 2", "cohort2_expression.mtx", "cohort2_genes.tsv",
                   "cohort2_barcodes.tsv", "1871-BIOKEY_metaData_cohort2_web.csv")

cat("\n── Merging cohorts (outer join on genes) ──\n")
all_genes <- union(rownames(c1$mat), rownames(c2$mat))
cat(sprintf("  Cohort 1 genes: %s | Cohort 2 genes: %s | Union: %s\n",
            format(length(rownames(c1$mat)), big.mark = ","),
            format(length(rownames(c2$mat)), big.mark = ","),
            format(length(all_genes), big.mark = ",")))

pad_genes <- function(mat, all_genes) {
  missing <- setdiff(all_genes, rownames(mat))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    pad <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = length(missing), ncol = ncol(mat), sparse = TRUE,
                          dimnames = list(missing, colnames(mat)))
    mat <- rbind(mat, pad)
  }
  mat[all_genes, , drop = FALSE]
}
mat1 <- pad_genes(c1$mat, all_genes)
mat2 <- pad_genes(c2$mat, all_genes)
mat  <- cbind(mat1, mat2)
meta <- rbind(c1$meta, c2$meta)
cat(sprintf("  Merged: %s genes x %s cells (zero cells dropped, zero collisions -- barcodes already globally unique)\n",
            format(nrow(mat), big.mark = ","), format(ncol(mat), big.mark = ",")))

stopifnot(ncol(mat) == nrow(c1$meta) + nrow(c2$meta))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(mat), rownames(meta)))

cat("\n── Building Seurat object ──\n")
so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, project = "Breast_Bassez2021",
                         min.cells = 0, min.features = 0)

for (col in colnames(meta)) {
  if (col == "Cell") next
  so[[col]] <- meta[[col]]
}

cat(sprintf("  cellType distribution:\n"))
print(table(so$cellType))

so@misc[["pipeline_info"]] <- list(
  dataset             = "Breast_Bassez2021",
  source              = "3CA",
  data_type           = "raw_counts",
  layer_used          = "counts",
  log1p               = TRUE,
  dt_confidence       = "high",
  dt_signals          = "hardcoded: original author-provided integer UMI counts (GEO supplementary), no detection needed",
  annot_col_primary   = "cellType",
  annot_col_secondary = "BC_type",
  all_obs_cols        = colnames(meta)
)

cat(sprintf("\nSaving -> %s\n", OUT_RDS))
saveRDS(so, OUT_RDS)
cat(sprintf("Done: %d cells x %d genes\n", ncol(so), nrow(so)))

```

```{python}

"""
01b_fix_Gao2021_from_raw.py
============================
Rebuilds Breast_Gao2021 from its raw 3CA files (Cells_Group1/2.csv,
Exp_data_UMIcounts_Group1/2.mtx, Genes_Group1/2.txt, Samples.csv), fixing a
cell-loss bug present in the existing 3ca_original/Breast_Gao2021.h5ad.

Root cause (same class of bug as the TISCH2 barcode-collision issue):
the dev script that originally merged Group1+Group2 (merge_subgroups.py)
treated the raw `cell_name` column (a bare 10x barcode, e.g. "AAACCTG...",
with NO sample prefix) as a unique cell identifier and dropped any cell
whose cell_name string also appeared in the other group -- even though
Group1 and Group2 contain cells from different samples (DCIS1, ATC1, ...)
that can coincidentally share the same barcode string (they're drawn from
the same fixed 10x whitelist). This silently dropped 41 real cells
(29,992 raw -> 29,951 in the existing h5ad).

Fix: never deduplicate on the bare cell_name across groups. Namespace each
cell's obs_name with its group key before merging, so no cell is ever
dropped for an accidental string collision. This mirrors the TISCH2 fix
(prefer the fuller, disambiguating identifier over a bare barcode).
"""
import anndata as ad
import pandas as pd
import scipy.io
import os

STUDY_DIR = "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/3CA_Database/data/Breast/Gao2021"
OUT_H5AD  = "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/clustocell_2/data/3CA/_gao2021_fix_input/Breast_Gao2021.h5ad"

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT_H5AD), exist_ok=True)


def load_group(group_key, mtx_name, cells_name, genes_name):
    mtx_path   = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, mtx_name)
    cells_path = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, cells_name)
    genes_path = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, genes_name)

    mat = scipy.io.mmread(mtx_path).T.tocsr()

    cells = pd.read_csv(cells_path, index_col=0, low_memory=False)
    cells.index = cells.index.astype(str)
    for col in cells.columns:
        if cells[col].dtype == object:
            cells[col] = cells[col].fillna("NA").astype(str)

    genes = pd.read_csv(genes_path, header=None, names=["gene_name"])
    genes.index = genes["gene_name"].astype(str)
    genes = genes.drop(columns=["gene_name"])

    assert mat.shape[0] == len(cells), f"{group_key}: matrix {mat.shape[0]} vs Cells.csv {len(cells)}"
    assert mat.shape[1] == len(genes), f"{group_key}: matrix {mat.shape[1]} vs Genes.txt {len(genes)}"

    adata = ad.AnnData(X=mat, obs=cells, var=genes)
    adata.var_names_make_unique()

    # FIX: namespace obs_names by group BEFORE any merge/concat step, so a
    # bare-barcode collision between groups can never cause a cell to be
    # treated as a duplicate and dropped.
    adata.obs["cell_name"] = adata.obs_names
    adata.obs_names = [f"{group_key}_{c}" for c in adata.obs_names]
    adata.obs["group"] = group_key
    print(f"  {group_key}: {adata.n_obs:,} cells x {adata.n_vars:,} genes (namespaced, none dropped)")
    return adata


print("Loading Group1...")
a1 = load_group("Group1", "Exp_data_UMIcounts_Group1.mtx", "Cells_Group1.csv", "Genes_Group1.txt")
print("Loading Group2...")
a2 = load_group("Group2", "exp_data_UMIcounts_Group2.mtx", "Cells_Group2.csv", "Genes_Group2.txt")

print(f"\nMerging (outer join on genes, {a1.n_vars} vs {a2.n_vars} genes)...")
merged = ad.concat([a1, a2], join="outer", label="group_batch", keys=["Group1", "Group2"], merge="same")
print(f"Merged: {merged.n_obs:,} cells x {merged.n_vars:,} genes (expected 29,992 cells, zero dropped)")

# Merge Samples.csv, same logic as the original dev scripts (merge on 'sample')
samples_path = os.path.join(STUDY_DIR, "Samples.csv")
if os.path.exists(samples_path):
    samples = pd.read_csv(samples_path, low_memory=False)
    for col in samples.columns:
        if samples[col].dtype == object:
            samples[col] = samples[col].fillna("NA").astype(str)
    if "sample" in merged.obs.columns and "sample" in samples.columns:
        merged.obs["sample"] = merged.obs["sample"].astype(str)
        samples["sample"] = samples["sample"].astype(str)
        samples_cols = ["sample"] + [c for c in samples.columns if c not in merged.obs.columns and c != "sample"]
        idx = merged.obs.index
        merged.obs = merged.obs.merge(samples[samples_cols], on="sample", how="left")
        merged.obs.index = idx
        print(f"Merged Samples.csv on 'sample' -- added {len(samples_cols) - 1} columns")

merged.obs["study_id"]    = "Gao2021"
merged.obs["cancer_type"] = "Breast"
merged.obs["source"]      = "3CA"
merged.obs["count_type"]  = "raw_counts"

for col in merged.obs.columns:
    if merged.obs[col].dtype == object:
        merged.obs[col] = merged.obs[col].fillna("NA").astype(str)

merged.uns["count_type"] = "raw_counts"
merged.uns["mtx_file"]   = "Exp_data_UMIcounts_Group1.mtx + exp_data_UMIcounts_Group2.mtx (fixed merge)"

merged.write_h5ad(OUT_H5AD)
print(f"\nSaved -> {OUT_H5AD}")
print(f"Final: {merged.n_obs:,} cells x {merged.n_vars:,} genes")

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 01c_fix_Ligorio2019_from_original.R
# ==============================================================================
# Rebuilds Other_Models_Ligorio2019 from the original GEO submission
# (GSE113616) instead of 3CA's version. 3CA's copy of this study had NO
# usable cell-type annotation column at all (flagged "no annotation column
# found" during the original 01_3CA_h5ad_to_seurat.R conversion) -- our
# concordance pipeline's regex fallback then latched onto "cell_cycle_phase"
# as the closest-matching column name, which is not a cell-type label at
# all, producing a meaningless concordance score.
#
# The original GEO SOFT metadata (GSE113616_family.soft.gz) has a proper
# per-sample "cell type:" characteristic distinguishing true single cells
# from pooled "population control" samples (bulk RNA-seq from ~100 cells,
# NOT single-cell data): 92 single CAF cells + 4 CAF population controls =
# 96 CAF samples; 90 single PDAC cells + 3 PDAC population controls = 93
# PDAC samples. The population controls are excluded here -- they are not
# single cells and would violate every assumption of a single-cell
# clustering pipeline.
#
# Source: /Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/clustocell_2/data/Original_Ligorio2019/Ligorio2019
#   GSE113616_cntCAF.csv.gz, GSE113616_cntPdac.csv.gz (gene x cell count matrices)
#   GSE113616_family.soft.gz (per-sample GEO metadata)
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(Matrix)
})

SRC_DIR  <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/clustocell_2/data/Original_Ligorio2019/Ligorio2019"
META_TSV <- "/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ramyarmolania-Documents-STAMP-Nature-Marker-Analysis/225574d0-5919-4d17-9ced-924bd6678ecd/scratchpad/ligorio_sample_meta.tsv"
OUT_RDS  <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/clustocell_2/data/3CA/3CA_seurat/Other_Models_Ligorio2019.rds"

norm_name <- function(x) tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", x))

meta <- read.delim(META_TSV, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
meta$norm_title <- norm_name(meta$title)
cat(sprintf("Parsed %d GEO sample records\n", nrow(meta)))

load_matrix <- function(csv_gz) {
  df  <- read.csv(csv_gz, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
  m   <- as.matrix(df)
  # The raw GEO download has one truncated trailing row per file (fewer
  # fields than columns -- read.csv NA-pads short rows rather than erroring).
  # Drop any gene row containing NA rather than guessing at the missing
  # values; this is a single gene out of tens of thousands, negligible.
  bad <- rowSums(is.na(m)) > 0
  if (any(bad)) {
    cat(sprintf("  [WARN] Dropping %d gene row(s) with missing values (truncated in source file): %s\n",
                sum(bad), paste(rownames(m)[bad], collapse = ", ")))
    m <- m[!bad, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  as(m, "CsparseMatrix")
}

cat("\nLoading CAF matrix...\n")
mat_caf <- load_matrix(file.path(SRC_DIR, "GSE113616_cntCAF.csv.gz"))
cat(sprintf("  %s genes x %s cells\n", format(nrow(mat_caf), big.mark=","), format(ncol(mat_caf), big.mark=",")))

cat("Loading PDAC matrix...\n")
mat_pdac <- load_matrix(file.path(SRC_DIR, "GSE113616_cntPdac.csv.gz"))
cat(sprintf("  %s genes x %s cells\n", format(nrow(mat_pdac), big.mark=","), format(ncol(mat_pdac), big.mark=",")))

# Match each matrix's columns to GEO sample metadata via normalized title
match_meta <- function(mat) {
  idx <- match(norm_name(colnames(mat)), meta$norm_title)
  stopifnot(!any(is.na(idx)))
  meta[idx, ]
}
meta_caf  <- match_meta(mat_caf)
meta_pdac <- match_meta(mat_pdac)
cat(sprintf("\nMatched %d / %d CAF columns, %d / %d PDAC columns to GEO metadata\n",
            sum(!is.na(match(norm_name(colnames(mat_caf)),  meta$norm_title))), ncol(mat_caf),
            sum(!is.na(match(norm_name(colnames(mat_pdac)), meta$norm_title))), ncol(mat_pdac)))

# Exclude pooled "population control" samples -- not single cells
keep_caf  <- !grepl("^100 CAF cells$",  meta_caf$cell_type_raw)
keep_pdac <- !grepl("^100 PDAC cells$", meta_pdac$cell_type_raw)
cat(sprintf("Excluding %d CAF population-control samples, %d PDAC population-control samples\n",
            sum(!keep_caf), sum(!keep_pdac)))

mat_caf   <- mat_caf[, keep_caf, drop = FALSE]
meta_caf  <- meta_caf[keep_caf, ]
mat_pdac  <- mat_pdac[, keep_pdac, drop = FALSE]
meta_pdac <- meta_pdac[keep_pdac, ]

cat(sprintf("Kept: %d single CAF cells, %d single PDAC cells (%d total)\n",
            ncol(mat_caf), ncol(mat_pdac), ncol(mat_caf) + ncol(mat_pdac)))

# Cell IDs are unique already (distinct sample titles), but namespace by
# cell type defensively before merging, matching this project's convention
# of never relying on bare identifiers being unique across groups.
colnames(mat_caf)  <- paste0("CAF_",  colnames(mat_caf))
colnames(mat_pdac) <- paste0("PDAC_", colnames(mat_pdac))
rownames(meta_caf)  <- colnames(mat_caf)
rownames(meta_pdac) <- colnames(mat_pdac)

cat("\nMerging (outer join on genes)...\n")
all_genes <- union(rownames(mat_caf), rownames(mat_pdac))
pad_genes <- function(mat, all_genes) {
  missing <- setdiff(all_genes, rownames(mat))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    pad <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = length(missing), ncol = ncol(mat), sparse = TRUE,
                          dimnames = list(missing, colnames(mat)))
    mat <- rbind(mat, pad)
  }
  mat[all_genes, , drop = FALSE]
}
mat  <- cbind(pad_genes(mat_caf, all_genes), pad_genes(mat_pdac, all_genes))
meta <- rbind(meta_caf, meta_pdac)
cat(sprintf("Merged: %s genes x %s cells\n", format(nrow(mat), big.mark=","), format(ncol(mat), big.mark=",")))

stopifnot(identical(colnames(mat), rownames(meta)))

cat("\nBuilding Seurat object...\n")
so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, project = "Other_Models_Ligorio2019",
                         min.cells = 0, min.features = 0)

so$cellType          <- sub("^single ", "", sub(" cell$", "", meta$cell_type_raw))  # "CAF" / "PDAC"
so$culture_condition <- meta$culture_condition
so$geo_sample_title  <- meta$title
so$geo_accession     <- meta$gsm

cat("cellType distribution:\n")
print(table(so$cellType))
cat("culture_condition distribution:\n")
print(table(so$culture_condition))

so@misc[["pipeline_info"]] <- list(
  dataset             = "Other_Models_Ligorio2019",
  source              = "3CA",
  data_type           = "raw_counts",
  layer_used          = "counts",
  log1p               = TRUE,
  dt_confidence       = "high",
  dt_signals          = "hardcoded: original GEO (GSE113616) integer read counts, no detection needed",
  annot_col_primary   = "cellType",
  annot_col_secondary = "culture_condition",
  all_obs_cols        = colnames(so@meta.data)
)

cat(sprintf("\nSaving -> %s\n", OUT_RDS))
saveRDS(so, OUT_RDS)
cat(sprintf("Done: %d cells x %d genes\n", ncol(so), nrow(so)))

```
