```{python}

"""
02_pancancer_h5ad_to_seurat.py
===============================
Extracts individual datasets from the PanCancer combined h5ad file
and saves each one as a Seurat RDS file.

Each dataset is extracted one at a time using backed mode to avoid
loading the full 4.1M cell matrix into RAM. The matrix is converted
to Matrix Market format (.mtx) in Python, then read into R natively
— avoiding all reticulate sparse matrix conversion issues.

Data type detection uses 6 independent signals (same logic as
01_3CA_h5ad_to_seurat.R):
  S1 — layer/assay name prior
  S2 — tolerance-based integer check (handles float32 rounding)
  S3 — sparsity ratio (% zeros)
  S4 — max non-zero value (biologically informed thresholds)
  S5 — median non-zero value
  S6 — presence of log1p key in uns metadata

Additionally it supports a --cancer_type filter to split a single
cohort (cohortName) into separate Seurat objects per cancerType.
This is needed for cohorts like "PanCancer_E-MTAB-8107" (datasetID
T_D31) that bundle multiple cancer types (BRCA, CRC, OV) into one
cohort, which is finer-grained than how TISCH2/3CA register studies.

Usage:
    # All datasets (no splitting):
    python3 02_pancancer_h5ad_to_seurat.py

    # Single dataset for testing:
    python3 02_pancancer_h5ad_to_seurat.py --dataset NET_GSE140312

    # Single dataset, split to one cancer type:
    python3 02_pancancer_h5ad_to_seurat.py --dataset PanCancer_E-MTAB-8107 --cancer_type BRCA

Output:
    /Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/data/Nature_Pancancer/Nature_Pancancer_seurat/
    /Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/results/02_pancancer_h5ad_to_seurat_log.tsv

Author:
    Natalia Pretel Pretel

Date:
    June 2026
"""

# Import required libraries
import os
import gc
import argparse
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import anndata as ad
import scipy.sparse as sp
import scipy.io as sio
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

# Configuration of the required paths and parameters
H5AD_PATH = Path("/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/data/Nature_Pancancer/Nature_Pancancer_Original/PanCancer_igt_s9_fine_counts.h5ad")
OUT_DIR   = Path("/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/data/Nature_Pancancer/Nature_Pancancer_seurat")
LOG_DIR   = Path("/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/results")


# STEP 0: Define helper functions

def detect_data_type(X_sparse, uns: dict) -> dict:
    """
    Classify expression matrix using 6 independent signals + majority vote.

    Parameters
    ----------
    X_sparse : scipy sparse matrix (cells x genes, CSR/CSC)
    uns      : adata.uns dict (for log1p key check)

    Returns
    -------
    dict with keys: data_type, layer_used, confidence, note,
                    sparsity_pct, val_max, val_median_nz, all_integer
    """
    votes = []
    notes = []

    # Signal 1: assay name — PanCancer h5ad stores data in X
    # X is ambiguous -> abstain from name prior
    notes.append("S1(name='X'->abstain)")

    # Signal 6: uns log1p key
    # Do before value inspection so we can weight accordingly
    has_log1p = "log1p" in uns
    if has_log1p:
        votes.append("log_normalized")
        notes.append("S6(uns['log1p'] found->log_normalized)")
    else:
        notes.append("S6(no log1p key in uns)")

    # Extract non-zero values
    if not sp.issparse(X_sparse):
        X_sparse = sp.csr_matrix(X_sparse)

    nz_vals   = X_sparse.data  # all stored non-zero values
    n_total   = X_sparse.shape[0] * X_sparse.shape[1]
    n_nonzero = len(nz_vals)
    sparsity  = 1.0 - (n_nonzero / n_total) if n_total > 0 else 1.0

    if n_nonzero == 0:
        return {
            "data_type": "raw_counts", "layer_used": "counts",
            "confidence": "low",
            "note": "Matrix is all zeros — cannot detect data type",
            "sparsity_pct": 100.0, "val_max": 0,
            "val_median_nz": 0, "all_integer": True
        }

    # Sample up to 5000 non-zero values
    rng     = np.random.default_rng(42)
    sampled = rng.choice(nz_vals, size=min(len(nz_vals), 5000), replace=False)

    val_max       = float(np.max(sampled))
    val_min       = float(np.min(sampled))
    val_median_nz = float(np.median(sampled))
    sparsity_pct  = round(sparsity * 100, 1)

    # Signal 2: tolerance-based integer check
    # Tolerance of 1e-6 handles float32 rounding artifacts (e.g. 1.0000001)
    has_negative = val_min < 0
    all_integer  = bool(np.all(np.abs(sampled - np.round(sampled)) < 1e-6))

    if has_negative:
        votes.append("scaled")
        notes.append(f"S2(has_negative=True, min={val_min:.3f}->scaled)")
    elif all_integer:
        votes.append("raw_counts")
        notes.append("S2(all_integer=True->raw_counts)")
    else:
        votes.append("normalized")
        notes.append(f"S2(all_integer=False, min={val_min:.4f}->normalized)")

    # Signal 3: sparsity
    if sparsity > 0.70:
        votes.append("raw_counts")
        notes.append(f"S3(sparsity={sparsity_pct}%>70%->raw_counts)")
    elif sparsity < 0.40:
        votes.append("normalized")
        notes.append(f"S3(sparsity={sparsity_pct}%<40%->normalized)")
    else:
        notes.append(f"S3(sparsity={sparsity_pct}%->ambiguous, abstain)")

    # Signal 4: max value (biologically informed thresholds)
    # log1p(10,000) ~ 9.2  | log1p(1e6/TPM) ~ 13.8  -> safely log if max < 20
    # max >= 50 -> safely raw counts or raw TPM/CPM
    if val_max < 20:
        votes.append("log_normalized")
        notes.append(f"S4(max={val_max:.2f}<20->log_normalized)")
    elif val_max < 50:
        notes.append(f"S4(max={val_max:.2f} 20-50->ambiguous, abstain)")
    else:
        votes.append("raw_counts_or_tpm")
        notes.append(f"S4(max={val_max:.2f}>=50->raw_counts_or_tpm)")

    # Signal 5: median of non-zero values
    if val_median_nz < 10 and val_max < 20:
        votes.append("log_normalized")
        notes.append(f"S5(median={val_median_nz:.2f}<10 & max<20->log_normalized)")
    elif val_median_nz >= 10 and not all_integer:
        votes.append("tpm_cpm")
        notes.append(f"S5(median={val_median_nz:.2f}>=10, non-integer->tpm_cpm)")
    else:
        notes.append(f"S5(median={val_median_nz:.2f}->ambiguous, abstain)")

    # Resolve generic votes then majority vote
    def resolve(v):
        if v == "normalized":
            return "log_normalized" if val_max < 20 else "tpm_cpm"
        if v == "raw_counts_or_tpm":
            return "raw_counts" if all_integer else "tpm_cpm"
        return v

    if "scaled" in votes:
        final_type = "scaled"
        confidence = "high"
    else:
        resolved    = [resolve(v) for v in votes]
        from collections import Counter
        counts      = Counter(resolved)
        top_type, top_count = counts.most_common(1)[0]
        final_type  = top_type
        total_votes = len(resolved)
        if top_count >= 4 or (total_votes >= 2 and top_count == total_votes):
            confidence = "high"
        elif top_count >= 3:
            confidence = "medium"
        else:
            confidence = "low"

    layer_used = "counts" if final_type == "raw_counts" else "data"

    return {
        "data_type":     final_type,
        "layer_used":    layer_used,
        "confidence":    confidence,
        "note":          " | ".join(notes),
        "sparsity_pct":  sparsity_pct,
        "val_max":       round(val_max, 3),
        "val_median_nz": round(val_median_nz, 3),
        "all_integer":   all_integer,
    }


def extract_and_save(h5ad_path: Path, dataset_name: str, out_dir: Path, cancer_type: str = None) -> dict:
    """
    Extract a single dataset (optionally filtered to one cancer type) from the
    h5ad file and save as a Seurat RDS.

    Parameters
    ----------
    dataset_name : cohortName value to filter on (e.g. "PanCancer_E-MTAB-8107")
    cancer_type  : optional cancerType value to further filter within the cohort
                   (e.g. "BRCA", "CRC", "OV"). When provided, the output filename
                   and internal Seurat object name get a "_{cancer_type}" suffix.
    """

    # When splitting by cancer type, suffix the output name so each split
    # gets its own RDS file and is identifiable downstream as its own "study"
    suffix    = f"_{cancer_type}" if cancer_type else ""
    full_name = f"{dataset_name}{suffix}"

    out_path = out_dir / f"{full_name}.rds"
    tmp_dir  = out_dir / f".tmp_{full_name}"

    print(f"\n{'─'*60}")
    print(f"  Dataset : {full_name}")
    if cancer_type:
        print(f"  (cohort '{dataset_name}' filtered to cancerType == '{cancer_type}')")

    if out_path.exists():
        print(f"  [SKIP] RDS already exists.")
        return {"dataset": full_name, "status": "skipped",
                "n_cells": None, "data_type": None, "layer_used": None,
                "dt_confidence": None, "sparsity_pct": None,
                "val_max": None, "val_median_nz": None,
                "all_integer": None, "dt_note": None, "error": None}

    try:
        # Step 1: Get cell indices + obs metadata
        print(f" Step 1: Reading cell indices...")
        adata_backed = ad.read_h5ad(h5ad_path, backed='r')
        mask = adata_backed.obs['cohortName'] == dataset_name

        if cancer_type:
            mask = mask & (adata_backed.obs['cancerType'] == cancer_type)

        n_cells = int(mask.sum())

        if n_cells == 0:
            label = f"cohortName '{dataset_name}'" + (f" & cancerType '{cancer_type}'" if cancer_type else "")
            print(f"  Skip: {label} not found in file.")
            adata_backed.file.close()
            return {"dataset": full_name, "status": "not_found",
                    "n_cells": 0, "data_type": None, "layer_used": None,
                    "dt_confidence": None, "sparsity_pct": None,
                    "val_max": None, "val_median_nz": None,
                    "all_integer": None, "dt_note": None, "error": None}

        print(f"          {n_cells:,} cells")
        cell_idx  = np.where(mask)[0]
        obs_df    = adata_backed.obs[mask].copy()
        var_names = list(adata_backed.var_names)
        uns       = dict(adata_backed.uns)     # capture uns for log1p check
        adata_backed.file.close()
        del adata_backed
        gc.collect()

        # Step 2: Extract expression matrix
        print(f" Step 2: Extracting expression matrix...")
        adata_backed = ad.read_h5ad(h5ad_path, backed='r')
        X = adata_backed.X[cell_idx, :]
        if not sp.issparse(X):
            X = sp.csr_matrix(X)
        else:
            X = X.tocsr()
        adata_backed.file.close()
        del adata_backed
        gc.collect()

        # Step 3: Detect data type (6-signal)
        print(f" Step 3: Detecting data type...")
        dt = detect_data_type(X, uns)
        print(f"          Data type    : {dt['data_type']}  (confidence: {dt['confidence']})")
        print(f"          Layer slot   : {dt['layer_used']}")
        print(f"          Sparsity     : {dt['sparsity_pct']}%")
        print(f"          Max value    : {dt['val_max']}")
        print(f"          Median (nz)  : {dt['val_median_nz']}")
        print(f"          All integer  : {dt['all_integer']}")
        print(f"          Signals      : {dt['note']}")

        # Transpose to genes x cells for R convention
        X_t = X.T.tocsc()
        del X
        gc.collect()

        # Step 4: Save MTX + metadata
        print(f" Step 4: Saving MTX files...")
        tmp_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        mtx_path      = tmp_dir / "matrix.mtx"
        barcodes_path = tmp_dir / "barcodes.tsv"
        features_path = tmp_dir / "features.tsv"
        meta_path     = tmp_dir / "metadata.tsv"

        sio.mmwrite(str(mtx_path), X_t)
        pd.Series(list(obs_df.index)).to_csv(barcodes_path, index=False, header=False)
        pd.Series(var_names).to_csv(features_path, index=False, header=False)
        obs_df.to_csv(meta_path, sep='\t')

        del X_t, obs_df
        gc.collect()

        # Step 5: Build Seurat object in R
        print(f" Step 5: Building Seurat RDS in R...")

        # Pass data type decision to R so it places matrix in correct slot
        layer_used = dt['layer_used']
        data_type  = dt['data_type']

        r_script = f"""
suppressPackageStartupMessages({{
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(Matrix)
}})

# Read MTX (genes x cells)
mat      <- readMM("{mtx_path}")
barcodes <- readLines("{barcodes_path}")
features <- readLines("{features_path}")
rownames(mat) <- make.unique(features)
colnames(mat) <- barcodes
mat <- as(mat, "dgCMatrix")
cat("    Matrix:", nrow(mat), "genes x", ncol(mat), "cells\\n")

# Create Seurat object
so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, project = "{full_name}",
                         min.cells = 0, min.features = 0)

# Place matrix in the correct slot based on detected data type
data_type  <- "{data_type}"
layer_used <- "{layer_used}"
cat("    Data type  :", data_type, "\\n")
cat("    Layer slot :", layer_used, "\\n")

if (layer_used == "data") {{
  so <- SetAssayData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = "data", new.data = mat)
  # Clear counts slot so it is not misread downstream
  empty <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(i = integer(0), j = integer(0),
             dims = c(nrow(mat), ncol(mat)), dimnames = dimnames(mat))
  so <- SetAssayData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts", new.data = empty)
}}

# Add ALL metadata columns
meta <- read.table("{meta_path}", sep="\\t", header=TRUE,
                   row.names=1, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
# Align rows to Seurat cell order
meta <- meta[colnames(so), , drop=FALSE]
for (col in colnames(meta)) {{
  so[[col]] <- meta[[col]]
}}

# Store provenance in misc slot
so@misc[["pipeline_info"]] <- list(
  dataset             = "{full_name}",
  source_cohort       = "{dataset_name}",
  cancer_type_filter  = "{cancer_type if cancer_type else ''}",
  source              = "PanCancer",
  data_type           = data_type,
  layer_used          = layer_used,
  dt_confidence       = "{dt['confidence']}",
  dt_signals          = "{dt['note'].replace('"', "'")}",
  sparsity_pct        = {dt['sparsity_pct']},
  val_max             = {dt['val_max']},
  val_median_nz       = {dt['val_median_nz']},
  all_integer         = {str(dt['all_integer']).upper()},
  annot_col_primary   = "majorCluster",
  annot_col_secondary = "subCluster"
)

# Report annotation columns
all_meta_cols <- colnames(so@meta.data)
annot_cols    <- grep("cluster|major|minor|cell|ann|lineage|subtype",
                      all_meta_cols, value=TRUE, ignore.case=TRUE)
cat("    All meta cols:", paste(all_meta_cols, collapse=", "), "\\n")
cat("    Annotation cols:", paste(annot_cols, collapse=", "), "\\n")

saveRDS(so, "{out_path}")
cat("    Saved ->", "{out_path}", "\\n")
"""
        r_script_path = tmp_dir / "convert.R"
        r_script_path.write_text(r_script)
        ret = os.system(f'Rscript "{r_script_path}"')

        shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)

        if ret == 0 and out_path.exists():
            size_mb = out_path.stat().st_size / 1_048_576
            print(f"  Done ({size_mb:.0f} MB)")
            return {
                "dataset":       full_name,
                "status":        "success",
                "n_cells":       n_cells,
                "data_type":     dt['data_type'],
                "layer_used":    dt['layer_used'],
                "dt_confidence": dt['confidence'],
                "sparsity_pct":  dt['sparsity_pct'],
                "val_max":       dt['val_max'],
                "val_median_nz": dt['val_median_nz'],
                "all_integer":   dt['all_integer'],
                "dt_note":       dt['note'],
                "error":         None,
            }
        else:
            return {"dataset": full_name, "status": "error",
                    "n_cells": n_cells, "data_type": dt['data_type'],
                    "layer_used": dt['layer_used'],
                    "dt_confidence": dt['confidence'],
                    "sparsity_pct": dt['sparsity_pct'],
                    "val_max": dt['val_max'], "val_median_nz": dt['val_median_nz'],
                    "all_integer": dt['all_integer'], "dt_note": dt['note'],
                    "error": "Rscript returned non-zero exit code"}

    except Exception as e:
        shutil.rmtree(tmp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
        print(f"  [ERROR] {e}")
        return {"dataset": full_name, "status": "error",
                "n_cells": None, "data_type": None, "layer_used": None,
                "dt_confidence": None, "sparsity_pct": None,
                "val_max": None, "val_median_nz": None,
                "all_integer": None, "dt_note": None, "error": str(e)}


# STEP 1: Definition of Main Function

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Convert PanCancer h5ad datasets to Seurat RDS files")
    parser.add_argument("--dataset", default=None,
                        help="Single dataset name (cohortName) for testing (default: all)")
    parser.add_argument("--cancer_type", default=None,
                        help="Optional: split the selected dataset further by cancerType "
                             "(e.g. BRCA, CRC, OV). Only valid when --dataset is also given.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.cancer_type and not args.dataset:
        print("[ERROR] --cancer_type requires --dataset to also be specified. Aborting.")
        return

    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # Discover ALL cohorts directly from the h5ad file
    print(f"\nDiscovering all cohorts in h5ad (backed mode)...")
    adata_check = ad.read_h5ad(H5AD_PATH, backed='r')
    available   = sorted(adata_check.obs['cohortName'].unique().tolist())

    # If splitting by cancer type, validate it exists for this cohort
    if args.dataset and args.cancer_type:
        cohort_mask = adata_check.obs['cohortName'] == args.dataset
        types_in_cohort = sorted(adata_check.obs.loc[cohort_mask, 'cancerType'].unique().tolist())
        if args.cancer_type not in types_in_cohort:
            print(f"\n[ERROR] cancerType '{args.cancer_type}' not found in cohort "
                  f"'{args.dataset}'. Available types: {types_in_cohort}. Aborting.")
            adata_check.file.close()
            return

    adata_check.file.close()
    print(f"  {len(available)} cohorts found in file.")
    for d in available:
        print(f"    - {d}")

    # If --dataset passed, process only that one
    # Otherwise process ALL cohorts found in the file
    if args.dataset:
        if args.dataset not in available:
            print(f"\n[ERROR] '{args.dataset}' not found in cohortName. Aborting.")
            return
        datasets = [args.dataset]
    else:
        datasets = available

    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  PanCancer -> Seurat conversion")
    print(f"  Input   : {H5AD_PATH}")
    print(f"  Output  : {OUT_DIR}")
    print(f"  Datasets: {len(datasets)}")
    if args.cancer_type:
        print(f"  Splitting to cancerType: {args.cancer_type}")
    print(f"{'='*60}")

    results = []
    for i, dataset in enumerate(datasets, 1):
        print(f"\n[{i}/{len(datasets)}]", end="")
        results.append(extract_and_save(H5AD_PATH, dataset, OUT_DIR, cancer_type=args.cancer_type))

    # Save log
    df = pd.DataFrame(results)
    log_suffix = f"_{args.dataset}_{args.cancer_type}" if (args.dataset and args.cancer_type) else ""
    log_path = LOG_DIR / f"02_pancancer_h5ad_to_seurat_log{log_suffix}.tsv"
    df.to_csv(log_path, sep='\t', index=False)

    # Summary
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  DONE")
    print(f"  Success  : {(df['status'] == 'success').sum()}")
    print(f"  Skipped  : {(df['status'] == 'skipped').sum()}")
    print(f"  Not found: {(df['status'] == 'not_found').sum()}")
    print(f"  Errors   : {(df['status'] == 'error').sum()}")

    low_conf = df[df['dt_confidence'] == 'low']
    if len(low_conf) > 0:
        print(f"\n  [WARN] Low-confidence data type detection ({len(low_conf)} studies):")
        for _, row in low_conf.iterrows():
            print(f"    - {row['dataset']}")

    errors = df[df['status'] == 'error']
    if len(errors) > 0:
        print(f"\n  [ERROR] Failed datasets ({len(errors)}):")
        for _, row in errors.iterrows():
            print(f"    - {row['dataset']}: {row['error']}")

    print(f"\n  Log saved -> {log_path}")
    print(f"{'='*60}\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

#### Part 3

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# 03_tisch2_h5_to_seurat.R
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Converts TISCH2 per-study expression h5 files + CellMetainfo TSV files
# into Seurat RDS objects ready for ClustoCell analysis.
#
# For each study folder in TISCH_2_Downloads/:
#   1. Reads expression matrix from {DATASET}_expression.h5
#      → SKIPS with status "missing_h5" if not found (not yet downloaded)
#   2. Reads cell annotations from {DATASET}_CellMetainfo_table.tsv
#   3. Matches barcodes between h5 and TSV (handles -1 suffix stripping)
#   4. Detects data type using 6-signal system (same as 01_3CA script)
#   5. Transfers ALL TSV columns into Seurat metadata (cleaned column names)
#   6. Stores provenance in so@misc[["pipeline_info"]]
#   7. Saves as {DATASET}.rds — skips if already exists (safe to re-run)
#
# Annotation column priority (TISCH2 standard):
#   Primary   : "Celltype (major-lineage)"  → stored as Celltype_major_lineage
#   Secondary : "Celltype (minor-lineage)"  → stored as Celltype_minor_lineage
#
# Output log: results/03_tisch2_h5_to_seurat_log.tsv
#
# Usage:
#   Rscript 03_tisch2_h5_to_seurat.R
#   Rscript 03_tisch2_h5_to_seurat.R --dataset T020094_CHOL_GSE142784
#
# Requirements:
#   install.packages(c("Seurat", "hdf5r", "Matrix", "optparse"))
#
# Author:
#   Natalia Pretel
#
# Date:
#   June 2026
# ==============================================================================


suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(hdf5r)
  library(Matrix)
  library(optparse)
})

# Definition of CLI arguments
option_list <- list(
  make_option("--dataset", type = "character", default = NULL,
              help = "Process only this dataset folder name (for testing). Omit for all.")
)
opt <- parse_args(OptionParser(option_list = option_list))

# Configuration of the required pathrs
TISCH_DIR <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/data/TISCH2/TISCH_2_Downloads"
OUT_DIR   <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/data/TISCH2/TISCH2_seurat"
LOG_DIR   <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/results"
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(LOG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# STEP 0: Definition of Helper Functions

# Function to Clean column names for Seurat (no spaces, brackets, special chars) 
clean_colname <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", x)
  x <- gsub("__+", "_", x)
  x <- sub("_$", "", x)
  x
}

# Function to riobustly  6-signal data type detection 
# Mirrors the same logic in 01_3CA_h5ad_to_seurat.R exactly.
# Signals:
#   S1 — assay/layer name prior (h5 files → abstain, no informative name)
#   S2 — tolerance-based integer check (handles float32 rounding artifacts)
#   S3 — sparsity ratio (% zeros over total matrix elements)
#   S4 — max non-zero value (biologically informed thresholds)
#   S5 — median non-zero value
#   S6 — not applicable for h5 (no uns metadata) → abstain
#
# Returns list(data_type, layer_used, confidence, note,
#              sparsity_pct, val_max, val_median_nz, all_integer)
detect_data_type <- function(mat) {

  votes <- character(0)
  notes <- character(0)

  # S1: h5 files have no informative layer name → abstain
  notes <- c(notes, "S1(h5 format→abstain)")

  # S6: no uns metadata in h5 → abstain
  notes <- c(notes, "S6(h5 format→no uns, abstain)")

  # Extract non-zero values
  n_total   <- as.numeric(nrow(mat)) * as.numeric(ncol(mat))
  nzvals    <- mat@x
  n_nonzero <- length(nzvals)
  sparsity  <- 1 - (n_nonzero / n_total)
  sparsity_pct <- round(sparsity * 100, 1)

  if (n_nonzero == 0) {
    return(list(data_type = "raw_counts", layer_used = "counts",
                confidence = "low",
                note = "Matrix is all zeros — cannot detect data type",
                sparsity_pct = 100, val_max = 0,
                val_median_nz = 0, all_integer = TRUE))
  }

  # Sample up to 5000 non-zero values
  set.seed(42)
  sampled      <- sample(nzvals, min(length(nzvals), 5000))
  val_max      <- max(sampled)
  val_min      <- min(sampled)
  val_median   <- median(sampled)
  has_negative <- val_min < 0

  # S2: tolerance-based integer check (1e-6 handles float32 rounding)
  all_integer <- all(abs(sampled - round(sampled)) < 1e-6)

  if (has_negative) {
    votes <- c(votes, "scaled")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S2(has_negative=TRUE, min=%.3f→scaled)", val_min))
  } else if (all_integer) {
    votes <- c(votes, "raw_counts")
    notes <- c(notes, "S2(all_integer=TRUE→raw_counts)")
  } else {
    votes <- c(votes, "normalized")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S2(all_integer=FALSE, min=%.4f→normalized)", val_min))
  }

  # S3: sparsity
  if (sparsity > 0.70) {
    votes <- c(votes, "raw_counts")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S3(sparsity=%.1f%%>70%%→raw_counts)", sparsity_pct))
  } else if (sparsity < 0.40) {
    votes <- c(votes, "normalized")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S3(sparsity=%.1f%%<40%%→normalized)", sparsity_pct))
  } else {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S3(sparsity=%.1f%%→ambiguous, abstain)", sparsity_pct))
  }

  # S4: max value (biologically informed thresholds)
  # log1p(10,000) ≈ 9.2 | log1p(1e6 TPM) ≈ 13.8 → safely log if max < 20
  # max ≥ 50 → safely raw counts or raw TPM/CPM
  if (val_max < 20) {
    votes <- c(votes, "log_normalized")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S4(max=%.2f<20→log_normalized)", val_max))
  } else if (val_max < 50) {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S4(max=%.2f 20-50→ambiguous, abstain)", val_max))
  } else {
    votes <- c(votes, "raw_counts_or_tpm")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S4(max=%.2f≥50→raw_counts_or_tpm)", val_max))
  }

  # S5: median of non-zero values
  if (val_median < 10 && val_max < 20) {
    votes <- c(votes, "log_normalized")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S5(median=%.2f<10 & max<20→log_normalized)", val_median))
  } else if (val_median >= 10 && !all_integer) {
    votes <- c(votes, "tpm_cpm")
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S5(median=%.2f≥10, non-integer→tpm_cpm)", val_median))
  } else {
    notes <- c(notes, sprintf("S5(median=%.2f→ambiguous, abstain)", val_median))
  }

  # Resolve generic votes
  resolve_generic <- function(v) {
    if (v == "normalized")      return(if (val_max < 20) "log_normalized" else "tpm_cpm")
    if (v == "raw_counts_or_tpm") return(if (all_integer) "raw_counts" else "tpm_cpm")
    return(v)
  }
  resolved_votes <- sapply(votes, resolve_generic)

  # Majority vote
  if ("scaled" %in% resolved_votes) {
    final_type <- "scaled"
    confidence <- "high"
  } else {
    vote_table  <- sort(table(resolved_votes), decreasing = TRUE)
    top_vote    <- names(vote_table)[1]
    top_count   <- vote_table[1]
    total_votes <- length(resolved_votes)
    final_type  <- top_vote
    if (top_count >= 4 || (total_votes >= 2 && top_count == total_votes)) {
      confidence <- "high"
    } else if (top_count >= 3) {
      confidence <- "medium"
    } else {
      confidence <- "low"
    }
  }

  layer_used <- if (final_type == "raw_counts") "counts" else "data"

  list(data_type     = final_type,
       layer_used    = layer_used,
       confidence    = confidence,
       note          = paste(notes, collapse = " | "),
       sparsity_pct  = sparsity_pct,
       val_max       = round(val_max, 3),
       val_median_nz = round(val_median, 3),
       all_integer   = all_integer)
}

#  Function to read TISCH2 h5 expression matrix 
read_tisch2_h5 <- function(h5_path) {
  cat("   Reading h5:", basename(h5_path), "\n")
  h5 <- H5File$new(h5_path, mode = "r")
  on.exit(h5$close_all())

  # Read barcodes
  barcodes <- h5[["matrix/barcodes"]]$read()
  if (is.list(barcodes)) barcodes <- unlist(barcodes)
  barcodes <- as.character(barcodes)

  # Read gene names
  gene_names <- h5[["matrix/features/name"]]$read()
  if (is.list(gene_names)) gene_names <- unlist(gene_names)
  gene_names <- make.unique(as.character(gene_names))

  # Read sparse matrix components
  data_vals <- h5[["matrix/data"]]$read()
  indices   <- h5[["matrix/indices"]]$read()
  indptr    <- h5[["matrix/indptr"]]$read()
  shape     <- h5[["matrix/shape"]]$read()   # [n_genes, n_cells]

  # Build CSC sparse matrix (genes x cells)
  mat <- sparseMatrix(
    i        = indices + 1L,        # 0-indexed → 1-indexed
    p        = indptr,
    x        = as.numeric(data_vals),
    dims     = as.integer(shape),
    dimnames = list(gene_names, barcodes)
  )

  cat(sprintf("   %s genes x %s cells\n",
              format(nrow(mat), big.mark = ","),
              format(ncol(mat), big.mark = ",")))
  return(mat)
}

#  Function to read TISCH2 cell metadata TSV 
read_tisch2_meta <- function(tsv_path) {
  cat("   Reading metadata:", basename(tsv_path), "\n")
  meta <- read.table(tsv_path, header = TRUE, sep = "\t",
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

  # Cell column format: "SAMPLE@BARCODE-1" → strip sample prefix
  meta$barcode_raw <- sub("^[^@]+@", "", meta$Cell)
  cat(sprintf("   %s cells in metadata\n", format(nrow(meta), big.mark = ",")))
  return(meta)
}

match_barcodes <- function(mat, meta) {
  h5_barcodes  <- colnames(mat)
  tsv_barcodes <- meta$barcode_raw
  
  # NEW: also strip sample prefix from h5 barcodes if present
  h5_stripped  <- sub("^[^@]+@", "", h5_barcodes)
  
  # Try direct match first
  common <- intersect(h5_barcodes, tsv_barcodes)
  
  # Try with h5 prefix stripped
  if (length(common) == 0) {
    common_stripped <- intersect(h5_stripped, tsv_barcodes)
    if (length(common_stripped) > 0) {
      match_idx          <- match(common_stripped, h5_stripped)
      mat_sub            <- mat[, match_idx, drop = FALSE]
      colnames(mat_sub)  <- h5_stripped[match_idx]
      meta_sub           <- meta[meta$barcode_raw %in% common_stripped, ]
      meta_sub           <- meta_sub[match(colnames(mat_sub), meta_sub$barcode_raw), ]
      rownames(meta_sub) <- colnames(mat_sub)
      cat(sprintf("   Matched %s cells (after stripping sample prefix from h5 barcodes)\n",
                  format(ncol(mat_sub), big.mark = ",")))
      return(list(mat = mat_sub, meta = meta_sub))
    }
  }
  
  # Try stripping numeric suffix from h5 barcodes
  if (length(common) == 0) {
    h5_nosuffix <- sub("-[0-9]+$", "", h5_stripped)
    common_idx  <- which(h5_nosuffix %in% tsv_barcodes)
    if (length(common_idx) > 0) {
      mat_sub           <- mat[, common_idx, drop = FALSE]
      colnames(mat_sub) <- h5_nosuffix[common_idx]
      meta_sub          <- meta[meta$barcode_raw %in% h5_nosuffix[common_idx], ]
      meta_sub          <- meta_sub[match(colnames(mat_sub), meta_sub$barcode_raw), ]
      rownames(meta_sub) <- colnames(mat_sub)
      cat(sprintf("   Matched %s cells (after stripping prefix + suffix)\n",
                  format(ncol(mat_sub), big.mark = ",")))
      return(list(mat = mat_sub, meta = meta_sub))
    }
  }
  
  if (length(common) == 0) {
    warning("No barcodes matched between h5 and metadata TSV!")
    return(list(mat = mat, meta = meta[0, ]))
  }
  
  mat_sub            <- mat[, common, drop = FALSE]
  meta_sub           <- meta[meta$barcode_raw %in% common, ]
  meta_sub           <- meta_sub[match(common, meta_sub$barcode_raw), ]
  rownames(meta_sub) <- common
  cat(sprintf("   Matched %s / %s h5 cells to metadata\n",
              format(length(common), big.mark = ","),
              format(ncol(mat), big.mark = ",")))
  return(list(mat = mat_sub, meta = meta_sub))
}


# STEP 2: Definition of Main Loop

process_dataset <- function(folder_name) {

  dataset_dir <- file.path(TISCH_DIR, folder_name)
  out_path    <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(folder_name, ".rds"))

  cat(sprintf("\n── %s ──\n", folder_name))

  # Skip if already done
  if (file.exists(out_path)) {
    cat("   [SKIP] RDS already exists.\n")
    return(data.frame(dataset = folder_name, status = "skipped",
                      n_cells = NA, n_genes = NA,
                      data_type = NA, layer_used = NA,
                      dt_confidence = NA, sparsity_pct = NA,
                      val_max = NA, val_median_nz = NA,
                      all_integer = NA,
                      annot_col_primary = NA, annot_col_secondary = NA,
                      error = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  # Find h5 and TSV files in the folder
  h5_files  <- list.files(dataset_dir, pattern = "\\.h5$",  full.names = TRUE)
  tsv_files <- list.files(dataset_dir, pattern = "_CellMetainfo_table\\.tsv$",
                          full.names = TRUE)

  # Skip if h5 not downloaded yet
  if (length(h5_files) == 0) {
    cat("   [SKIP] No h5 file found — not yet downloaded.\n")
    return(data.frame(dataset = folder_name, status = "missing_h5",
                      n_cells = NA, n_genes = NA,
                      data_type = NA, layer_used = NA,
                      dt_confidence = NA, sparsity_pct = NA,
                      val_max = NA, val_median_nz = NA,
                      all_integer = NA,
                      annot_col_primary = NA, annot_col_secondary = NA,
                      error = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  if (length(tsv_files) == 0) {
    cat("   [SKIP] No CellMetainfo TSV found.\n")
    return(data.frame(dataset = folder_name, status = "missing_tsv",
                      n_cells = NA, n_genes = NA,
                      data_type = NA, layer_used = NA,
                      dt_confidence = NA, sparsity_pct = NA,
                      val_max = NA, val_median_nz = NA,
                      all_integer = NA,
                      annot_col_primary = NA, annot_col_secondary = NA,
                      error = NA, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }

  tryCatch({

    # 1. Read h5 + metadata
    mat  <- read_tisch2_h5(h5_files[1])
    meta <- read_tisch2_meta(tsv_files[1])

    # 2. Match barcodes
    merged <- match_barcodes(mat, meta)
    mat    <- merged$mat
    meta   <- merged$meta
    rm(merged); gc()

    if (ncol(mat) == 0) stop("No cells remaining after barcode matching")

    # 3. Detect data type (6-signal)
    cat(" Step 3: Detecting data type...\n")
    dt <- detect_data_type(mat)
    cat(sprintf("   Data type    : %s  (confidence: %s)\n", dt$data_type, dt$confidence))
    cat(sprintf("   Layer slot   : %s\n",   dt$layer_used))
    cat(sprintf("   Sparsity     : %.1f%%\n", dt$sparsity_pct))
    cat(sprintf("   Max value    : %.3f\n",   dt$val_max))
    cat(sprintf("   Median (nz)  : %.3f\n",   dt$val_median_nz))
    cat(sprintf("   All integer  : %s\n",     dt$all_integer))
    cat(sprintf("   Signals      : %s\n",     dt$note))

    # 4. Build Seurat object
    cat(" Step 4: Building Seurat object...\n")
    seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
      counts       = mat,
      project      = folder_name,
      min.cells    = 0,
      min.features = 0
    )

    # Move to data slot if not raw counts
    if (dt$layer_used == "data") {
      seurat_obj <- SetAssayData(seurat_obj, layer = "data",   new.data = mat)
      empty_mat  <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
        i = integer(0), j = integer(0),
        dims     = c(nrow(mat), ncol(mat)),
        dimnames = dimnames(mat)
      )
      seurat_obj <- SetAssayData(seurat_obj, layer = "counts", new.data = empty_mat)
    }

    # 5. Transfer ALL metadata columns (clean names)
    all_tsv_cols <- setdiff(colnames(meta), "barcode_raw")
    for (col in all_tsv_cols) {
      clean <- clean_colname(col)
      seurat_obj[[clean]] <- meta[[col]]
    }

    # 6. Identify annotation columns (TISCH2 standard names after cleaning)
    annot_primary   <- "Celltype_major_lineage"
    annot_secondary <- "Celltype_minor_lineage"
    
    # Verify they exist
    meta_cols <- colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
    if (!annot_primary %in% meta_cols) {
      # Try to find it by partial match
      candidate <- grep("major", meta_cols, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
      annot_primary <- if (length(candidate) > 0) candidate[1] else "NONE_FOUND"
    }
    if (!annot_secondary %in% meta_cols) {
      candidate <- grep("minor", meta_cols, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
      annot_secondary <- if (length(candidate) > 0) candidate[1] else ""
    }

    cat(sprintf("   Primary annot   : %s  (%d unique)\n",
                annot_primary,
                length(unique(seurat_obj[[annot_primary, drop = TRUE]]))))
    if (annot_secondary != "") {
      cat(sprintf("   Secondary annot : %s  (%d unique)\n",
                  annot_secondary,
                  length(unique(seurat_obj[[annot_secondary, drop = TRUE]]))))
    }

    # 7. Store provenance in misc slot
    seurat_obj@misc[["pipeline_info"]] <- list(
      dataset             = folder_name,
      source              = "TISCH2",
      data_type           = dt$data_type,
      layer_used          = dt$layer_used,
      dt_confidence       = dt$confidence,
      dt_signals          = dt$note,
      sparsity_pct        = dt$sparsity_pct,
      val_max             = dt$val_max,
      val_median_nz       = dt$val_median_nz,
      all_integer         = dt$all_integer,
      annot_col_primary   = annot_primary,
      annot_col_secondary = annot_secondary,
      all_obs_cols        = meta_cols
    )

    # 8. Save
    cat(sprintf("   Saving → %s\n", out_path))
    saveRDS(seurat_obj, file = out_path)
    cat("   [DONE]\n")

    return(data.frame(
      dataset           = folder_name,
      status            = "success",
      n_cells           = ncol(seurat_obj),
      n_genes           = nrow(seurat_obj),
      data_type         = dt$data_type,
      layer_used        = dt$layer_used,
      dt_confidence     = dt$confidence,
      sparsity_pct      = dt$sparsity_pct,
      val_max           = dt$val_max,
      val_median_nz     = dt$val_median_nz,
      all_integer       = dt$all_integer,
      annot_col_primary = annot_primary,
      annot_col_secondary = annot_secondary,
      error             = NA,
      stringsAsFactors  = FALSE
    ))

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("   [ERROR] %s\n", conditionMessage(e)))
    return(data.frame(
      dataset = folder_name, status = "error",
      n_cells = NA, n_genes = NA,
      data_type = NA, layer_used = NA,
      dt_confidence = NA, sparsity_pct = NA,
      val_max = NA, val_median_nz = NA,
      all_integer = NA,
      annot_col_primary = NA, annot_col_secondary = NA,
      error = conditionMessage(e),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  })
}

# Discover datasets analyzed and processed
if (!is.null(opt$dataset)) {
  datasets <- opt$dataset
} else {
  datasets <- sort(list.dirs(TISCH_DIR, full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE))
  datasets <- datasets[datasets != "" & !grepl("\\.tsv$", datasets)]
}

cat(sprintf("\n%s\n", strrep("═", 60)))
cat("  TISCH2 h5 → Seurat conversion\n")
cat(sprintf("  Input   : %s\n", TISCH_DIR))
cat(sprintf("  Output  : %s\n", OUT_DIR))
cat(sprintf("  Datasets: %d\n", length(datasets)))
cat(sprintf("%s\n", strrep("═", 60)))

# Run the script
log_records <- lapply(datasets, process_dataset)
log_df      <- do.call(rbind, log_records)

# Save log 
log_path <- file.path(LOG_DIR, "03_tisch2_h5_to_seurat_log.tsv")
write.table(log_df, log_path, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

# Summary 
cat(sprintf("\n%s\n", strrep("═", 60)))
cat("  DONE\n")
cat(sprintf("  Success     : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "success",     na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Skipped     : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "skipped",     na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Missing h5  : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "missing_h5",  na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Missing TSV : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "missing_tsv", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Errors      : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "error",       na.rm = TRUE)))

low_conf <- log_df[!is.na(log_df$dt_confidence) &
                     log_df$dt_confidence == "low", "dataset"]
if (length(low_conf) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("\n  [WARN] Low-confidence data type detection (%d):\n", length(low_conf)))
  cat(paste0("    - ", low_conf, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}

cat(sprintf("\n  Log saved → %s\n", log_path))
cat(sprintf("%s\n", strrep("═", 60)))
```

#### Part 4

```{r}

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# ===============================================================================
# 04_run_clustocell_concordance_2.R
# ===============================================================================
# Runs clustoCell on all Seurat objects from the 3CA, PanCancer, and TISCH2
# databases, computes max overlap concordance between clustoCell clusters and
# existing annotations, and saves a summary CSV with one row per dataset.
#
# Concordance metric: max overlap (%)
#   For each cluster, the annotation label with the highest cell count is
#   identified. The sum of those maximums is divided by total cells x 100.
#   A score of 100% means every cluster is perfectly dominated by one label.
#
# Annotation column priority per source:
#   3CA       -> cell_type > cell_subtype > celltype > annotation
#   PanCancer -> majorCluster > subCluster > ann1 > cellType1
#   TISCH2    -> Celltype_major_lineage > Celltype_minor_lineage > Celltype_malignancy
#
# ClustoCell strategy:
#   Large datasets (>100k cells):
#     1. subset_to_HVG=FALSE, sketch=TRUE, ncells=20k
#     2. subset_to_HVG=FALSE, sketch=TRUE, ncells=15k
#     3. subset_to_HVG=FALSE, sketch=TRUE, ncells=10k
#     4. subset_to_HVG=FALSE, sketch=FALSE  (final fallback)
#   Smaller datasets:
#     1. subset_to_HVG=FALSE, sketch based on ncells
#     2. subset_to_HVG=FALSE, sketch=FALSE  (final fallback)
#
# Usage:
#   Rscript 04_run_clustocell_concordance.R \
#     --ca_dir        "/path/to/3CA_seurat" \
#     --pancancer_dir "/path/to/Nature_Pancancer_seurat" \
#     --tisch_dir     "/path/to/TISCH2_seurat" \
#     --out_dir       "/path/to/output"
#
# Author: 
#    Natalia Pretel
# Date:   
#    June 2026
# ===============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(celliverse)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(optparse)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

# Configuration of the CLI Arguments
option_list <- list(
  make_option("--ca_dir",        type = "character", default = NULL,
              help = "Directory with 3CA Seurat RDS files"),
  make_option("--pancancer_dir", type = "character", default = NULL,
              help = "Directory with PanCancer Seurat RDS files"),
  make_option("--tisch_dir",     type = "character", default = NULL,
              help = "Directory with TISCH2 Seurat RDS files"),
  make_option("--out_dir",       type = "character", required = TRUE,
              help = "Output directory for results"),
  make_option("--dataset",       type = "character", default = NULL,
              help = "Run only this dataset (stem name, e.g. Brain_Choudhury2022)")
)
opt <- parse_args(OptionParser(option_list = option_list))
dir.create(opt$out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

#======================================
# STEP 0: Definition of Helper function
#======================================

detect_layer_content <- function(so, layer_name) {
  tryCatch({
    mat          <- LayerData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = layer_name)
    non_zero     <- mat@x[mat@x > 0]
    if (length(non_zero) == 0) return("EMPTY")

    sample_vals   <- head(non_zero, 10000)
    pct_integer   <- mean(sample_vals == round(sample_vals)) * 100
    max_val       <- max(non_zero)
    mean_val      <- mean(sample_vals)
    pct_above_20  <- mean(sample_vals > 20)  * 100
    pct_above_100 <- mean(sample_vals > 100) * 100

    if (pct_integer >= 99) return("RAW_COUNTS")
    if (max_val <= 20 && pct_above_20 < 1) return("LOG_NORMALIZED")
    if (max_val > 100 && pct_above_20 > 5 && pct_integer < 5) return("TPM_CPM")

    votes_tpm <- sum(c(max_val > 100, pct_above_20 > 5,
                       pct_above_100 > 1, mean_val > 50))
    votes_log <- sum(c(max_val <= 50, pct_above_20 < 5,
                       pct_above_100 == 0, mean_val <= 10))

    if (votes_tpm > votes_log) return("TPM_CPM")
    if (votes_log > votes_tpm) return("LOG_NORMALIZED")
    return("UNCERTAIN")

  }, error = function(e) "NOT_PRESENT")
}

#====================================================
# STEP 1: Correct identification of annotation column
#====================================================

ANNOT_PRIORITY <- list(
  "3CA"       = c("cell_type", "cell_subtype", "celltype", "annotation",
                  "cell_annotation", "author_cell_type", "authors_cell_type",
                  "CellType", "Celltype", "label", "cluster_annotation"),
  "PanCancer" = c("majorCluster", "subCluster", "ann1", "cellType1",
                  "cellType2", "Prediction"),
  "TISCH2"    = c("Celltype_major_lineage", "Celltype_minor_lineage",
                  "Celltype_malignancy", "Cluster")
)

detect_annotation_column <- function(so, source) {
  meta_cols     <- colnames(so@meta.data)
  pipeline_info <- if (!is.null(so@misc[["pipeline_info"]])) so@misc[["pipeline_info"]] else so@misc[["blscope"]]

  if (!is.null(pipeline_info)) {
    primary <- pipeline_info[["annot_col_primary"]]
    if (!is.null(primary) && !is.na(primary) &&
        primary %in% meta_cols && primary != "NONE_FOUND") {
      n_unique <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[primary]]))
      if (n_unique >= 2 && n_unique <= 500) {
        cat(sprintf("        Annotation from misc slot: %s (%d unique)\n",
                    primary, n_unique))
        return(primary)
      }
    }
  }

  candidates <- ANNOT_PRIORITY[[source]]
  if (is.null(candidates)) candidates <- unlist(ANNOT_PRIORITY)
  for (col in candidates) {
    if (col %in% meta_cols) {
      n_unique <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[col]]))
      if (n_unique >= 2 && n_unique <= 500) return(col)
    }
  }

  for (col in meta_cols) {
    if (grepl("type|annot|label|cluster|lineage|cell|subtype",
              col, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      n_unique <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[col]]))
      if (n_unique >= 2 && n_unique <= 500) return(col)
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
}

#==================================================================
# STEP 2: Definition of the processing pipeline for a single dataset
#==================================================================

run_dataset <- function(rds_path, source, out_dir) {

  dataset_name <- basename(rds_path)
  dataset_name <- sub("_seurat\\.rds$", "", dataset_name)
  dataset_name <- sub("\\.rds$",        "", dataset_name)

  out_rds <- file.path(out_dir, "seurat_objects",
                       paste0(dataset_name, "_clustocell.rds"))
  dir.create(dirname(out_rds), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  cat("\n", strrep("-", 60), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Dataset :", dataset_name, "\n")
  cat("  Source  :", source, "\n")

  result <- list(
    dataset           = dataset_name,
    source            = source,
    status            = "error",
    n_cells           = NA, n_genes           = NA,
    data_type         = NA, layer_used        = NA,
    log1p_applied     = NA,
    n_clusters        = NA, n_subclusters     = NA,
    annot_col         = NA, n_original_labels = NA,
    original_labels   = NA,
    concordance_major = NA, concordance_sub   = NA,
    error             = ""
  )

  tryCatch({

    # Step 1: Load Seurat object
    cat(" Step 1: Loading Seurat object...\n")
    so <- readRDS(rds_path)
    result$n_cells <- ncol(so)
    result$n_genes <- nrow(so)
    cat(sprintf("         %s cells x %s genes\n",
                format(ncol(so), big.mark = ","),
                format(nrow(so), big.mark = ",")))

    # Skip if already processed
    if (file.exists(out_rds)) {
      cat("  Already exists — skipping\n")
      result$status <- "skipped"
      return(result)
    }

    # Step 2: Detect data type
    cat(" Step 2: Detecting data type from matrix values...\n")
    available_layers   <- names(so@assays$RNA@layers)
    counts_type        <- if ("counts" %in% available_layers)
                           detect_layer_content(so, "counts") else "NOT_PRESENT"
    data_type_detected <- if ("data"   %in% available_layers)
                           detect_layer_content(so, "data")   else "NOT_PRESENT"

    cat("         counts layer:", counts_type, "\n")
    cat("         data layer  :", data_type_detected, "\n")

    if (counts_type == "RAW_COUNTS") {
      use_layer        <- "counts"
      use_log1p        <- TRUE
      result$data_type <- "raw_counts"
    } else if (data_type_detected == "LOG_NORMALIZED") {
      use_layer        <- "data"
      use_log1p        <- FALSE
      result$data_type <- "log_normalized"
    } else if (data_type_detected == "TPM_CPM") {
      use_layer        <- "data"
      use_log1p        <- TRUE
      result$data_type <- "tpm_cpm"
    } else if (data_type_detected == "UNCERTAIN") {
      use_layer        <- "data"
      use_log1p        <- TRUE
      result$data_type <- "uncertain"
      cat("         [IMPORTANT] Uncertain data type — applying log1p as safe default\n")
    } else {
      use_layer        <- if ("data" %in% available_layers) "data" else "counts"
      use_log1p        <- TRUE
      result$data_type <- "unknown"
    }

    result$layer_used    <- use_layer
    result$log1p_applied <- use_log1p
    cat(sprintf("         -> Layer: %s | log1p: %s\n", use_layer, use_log1p))

    # Cross-check stored vs detected data type
    pipeline_info <- if (!is.null(so@misc[["pipeline_info"]])) so@misc[["pipeline_info"]] else so@misc[["blscope"]]
    stored_type   <- pipeline_info[["data_type"]]
    if (!is.null(stored_type) && !is.na(stored_type)) {
      if (stored_type == result$data_type) {
        cat(sprintf("         [CHECK] Data type confirmed: %s\n", result$data_type))
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("         [WARN] Mismatch: stored='%s' detected='%s' → trusting detected\n",
                    stored_type, result$data_type))
      }
    }

    # Ensure data layer exists for HVG detection
    # Using names(so@assays$RNA@layers) instead of Layers() for Seurat v4/v5 compatibility
    if (!("data" %in% names(so@assays$RNA@layers))) {
      cat("         Normalizing data layer for HVG detection...\n")
      so <- NormalizeData(so, verbose = FALSE)
    }

    # Step 3: Detect annotation column
    cat(" Step 3: Detecting annotation column...\n")
    annot_col <- detect_annotation_column(so, source)
    if (is.null(annot_col)) stop("No suitable annotation column found")

    result$annot_col         <- annot_col
    result$n_original_labels <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[annot_col]]))
    result$original_labels   <- paste(sort(unique(so@meta.data[[annot_col]])),
                                      collapse = " | ")
    cat(sprintf("         Column: %s (%d unique labels)\n",
                annot_col, result$n_original_labels))

    # Step 4: Run clustoCell 
    # Large datasets (>100k cells) often fail with ClustoCell's internal HVG
    # marker frequency computation (dim(X) error). Retry with smaller sketch.
    # Small/medium datasets sometimes fail when HVG selection returns too few
    # genes. Final fallback: subset_to_HVG=FALSE bypasses HVG filtering entirely.
    cat(" Step 4: Running clustoCell...\n")

    n_cells    <- ncol(so)
    use_sketch <- n_cells > 40000
    mat_for_clustering <- LayerData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = use_layer)

    # Build retry configurations
    # Each entry: list(subset_to_HVG, sketch, sketch_ncells)
    if (n_cells > 100000) {
      # Large datasets — try progressively smaller sketches first
      retry_configs <- list(
        list(hvg = FALSE,  sketch = TRUE,  ncells = 20000L),
        list(hvg = FALSE,  sketch = TRUE,  ncells = 15000L),
        list(hvg = FALSE,  sketch = TRUE,  ncells = 10000L),
        list(hvg = FALSE, sketch = FALSE, ncells = NULL)
      )
    } else {
      # Small/medium datasets — try standard settings first
      std_ncells <- as.integer(min(40000L, max(10000L, n_cells * 0.2)))
      retry_configs <- list(
        list(hvg = FALSE,  sketch = use_sketch, ncells = std_ncells),
        list(hvg = FALSE, sketch = FALSE,      ncells = NULL)
      )
    }

    cc <- NULL
    for (cfg in retry_configs) {
      if (cfg$hvg) {
        if (cfg$sketch) {
          cat(sprintf("         Trying: subset_to_HVG=FALSE, sketch=TRUE, ncells=%d\n",
                      cfg$ncells))
        } else {
          cat("         Trying: subset_to_HVG=FALSE, sketch=FALSE\n")
        }
      } else {
        cat("         Trying: subset_to_HVG=FALSE, sketch=FALSE (final fallback)\n")
      }

      cc <- tryCatch(
        clustoCell(
          data                         = mat_for_clustering,
          assay                        = "RNA",
          layer                        = use_layer,
          norm_assay                   = "RNA",
          norm_layer                   = "data",
          log1p                        = use_log1p,
          subset_to_HVG                = cfg$hvg,
          identify_subclusters         = TRUE,
          leiden_resolution            = 1,
          leiden_n_iterations          = 5,
          subcluster_resolution_weight = 0.75,
          sketch                       = cfg$sketch,
          sketch_ncells                = if (!is.null(cfg$ncells)) cfg$ncells else 10000L,
          num_threads                  = -1,
          seed                         = 2025,
          verbose                      = FALSE
        ),
        error = function(e) {
          cat(sprintf("         [WARN] Failed: %s — retrying...\n",
                      conditionMessage(e)))
          NULL
        }
      )

      if (!is.null(cc)) {
        n_major <- length(unique(cc$clusters$major_clusters))
        cat(sprintf("         Success! n_major=%d | subset_to_HVG=%s | sketch=%s\n",
                    n_major, cfg$hvg, cfg$sketch))
        break
      }
    }

    if (is.null(cc)) stop("ClustoCell failed with all retry configurations")

    # Step 5: Add clusters to Seurat object
    cat(" Step 5: Adding cluster labels back to Seurat object...\n")
    so <- addClustoData(
      obj                = so,
      clustoCell         = cc,
      add_major_clusters = TRUE,
      add_sub_clusters   = TRUE,
      major_cluster_name = "ClustoCell",
      sub_cluster_name   = "ClustoCell_sub"
    )

    n_major <- length(unique(na.omit(so@meta.data[["ClustoCell"]])))
    n_sub   <- length(unique(na.omit(so@meta.data[["ClustoCell_sub"]])))
    result$n_clusters    <- n_major
    result$n_subclusters <- n_sub
    cat(sprintf("         Major clusters: %d | Sub-clusters: %d\n", n_major, n_sub))

    # Step 6: Concordance analysis
    cat(" Step 6: Computing the concordance...\n")

    labels         <- as.character(so@meta.data[[annot_col]])
    major_clusters <- as.character(so@meta.data[["ClustoCell"]])
    sub_clusters   <- as.character(so@meta.data[["ClustoCell_sub"]])
    valid_major    <- !is.na(labels) & !is.na(major_clusters)
    valid_sub      <- !is.na(labels) & !is.na(sub_clusters)

    contingency_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "contingency_tables")
    dir.create(contingency_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    # Major clusters
    labels_major   <- labels[valid_major]
    clusters_major <- major_clusters[valid_major]
    if (length(unique(labels_major)) > length(unique(clusters_major))) {
      ct_major <- table(`Manual Annotation` = labels_major,
                        ClustoCell          = clusters_major)
    } else {
      ct_major <- table(ClustoCell          = clusters_major,
                        `Manual Annotation` = labels_major)
    }
    concordance_major        <- round(
      (sum(apply(ct_major, 1, max)) / length(clusters_major)) * 100)
    result$concordance_major <- concordance_major
    cat(sprintf("         Major concordance: %d%%\n", concordance_major))

    ct_major_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(ct_major)
    ct_major_df <- cbind(Cluster = rownames(ct_major_df), ct_major_df)
    write.csv(ct_major_df,
              file.path(contingency_dir,
                        paste0(dataset_name, "_contingency_major.csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)

    # Sub-clusters
    labels_sub   <- labels[valid_sub]
    clusters_sub <- sub_clusters[valid_sub]
    if (length(unique(labels_sub)) > length(unique(clusters_sub))) {
      ct_sub <- table(`Manual Annotation` = labels_sub,
                      ClustoCell          = clusters_sub)
    } else {
      ct_sub <- table(ClustoCell          = clusters_sub,
                      `Manual Annotation` = labels_sub)
    }
    concordance_sub        <- round(
      (sum(apply(ct_sub, 1, max)) / length(clusters_sub)) * 100)
    result$concordance_sub <- concordance_sub
    cat(sprintf("         Sub concordance : %d%%\n", concordance_sub))

    ct_sub_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(ct_sub)
    ct_sub_df <- cbind(Cluster = rownames(ct_sub_df), ct_sub_df)
    write.csv(ct_sub_df,
              file.path(contingency_dir,
                        paste0(dataset_name, "_contingency_sub.csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)

    # Heatmaps
    plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")
    dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

    plot_contingency_heatmap <- function(ct, title, out_path) {
      ct_pct <- sweep(ct, 1, rowSums(ct), "/") * 100
      ct_df  <- as.data.frame(as.table(ct_pct))
      colnames(ct_df) <- c("Cluster", "Annotation", "Pct")
      ct_df$Annotation <- stringr::str_trunc(ct_df$Annotation, 30)
      p <- ggplot2::ggplot(ct_df,
               ggplot2::aes(x = Annotation, y = Cluster, fill = Pct)) +
        ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2166AC",
                                     name = "% cells\nin cluster") +
        ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(
          label = ifelse(Pct > 5, sprintf("%.0f%%", Pct), "")),
          size = 2.5, color = "black") +
        ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
        ggplot2::theme(
          axis.text.x     = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          axis.text.y     = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
          plot.title      = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "right"
        ) +
        ggplot2::labs(title = title, x = annot_col, y = "ClustoCell cluster")
      ggplot2::ggsave(out_path, plot = p,
                      width  = max(8, ncol(ct) * 0.6),
                      height = max(5, nrow(ct) * 0.5),
                      limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 150)
    }

    tryCatch({
      plot_contingency_heatmap(
        ct_major,
        paste0(dataset_name, " — major clusters vs ", annot_col,
               "\nConcordance: ", concordance_major, "%"),
        file.path(plot_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_heatmap_major.pdf"))
      )
      plot_contingency_heatmap(
        ct_sub,
        paste0(dataset_name, " — sub-clusters vs ", annot_col,
               "\nConcordance: ", concordance_sub, "%"),
        file.path(plot_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_heatmap_sub.pdf"))
      )
      cat(sprintf("         Heatmaps saved → %s_heatmap_major/sub.pdf\n", dataset_name))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("         [WARN] Heatmap failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    })

    # Save enriched Seurat object
    saveRDS(so, out_rds)
    cat(sprintf("         Saved → %s\n", basename(out_rds)))
    result$status <- "success"

  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  [ERROR]", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    result$error  <<- conditionMessage(e)
    result$status <<- "error"
  })

  return(result)
}

#=========================================================
# STEP 3: Collect all RDS files
#=========================================================

collect_rds <- function(dir_path, source_label) {
  if (is.null(dir_path) || !dir.exists(dir_path)) return(NULL)
  files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  files <- files[!grepl("_clustocell\\.rds$", files)]
  files <- files[!grepl("^\\._", basename(files))]
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.frame(path = files, source = source_label, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

all_datasets <- rbind(
  collect_rds(opt$ca_dir,        "3CA"),
  collect_rds(opt$pancancer_dir, "PanCancer"),
  collect_rds(opt$tisch_dir,     "TISCH2")
)

if (is.null(all_datasets) || nrow(all_datasets) == 0) {
  stop("No Seurat RDS files found in any of the provided directories.")
}

if (!is.null(opt$dataset)) {
  all_datasets <- all_datasets[grepl(opt$dataset, basename(all_datasets$path)), ]
  if (nrow(all_datasets) == 0) stop("No datasets matching: ", opt$dataset)
}

cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  Batch clustoCell + Max Overlap Concordance\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total datasets: %d\n", nrow(all_datasets)))
cat("  Sources:\n")
for (s in names(table(all_datasets$source))) {
  cat(sprintf("    %s : %d\n", s, sum(all_datasets$source == s)))
}
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")

#==================
# Step 4: Batch Run
#==================

results <- vector("list", nrow(all_datasets))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(all_datasets))) {
  cat(sprintf("\n[%d/%d]", i, nrow(all_datasets)))
  results[[i]] <- run_dataset(
    rds_path = all_datasets$path[i],
    source   = all_datasets$source[i],
    out_dir  = opt$out_dir
  )
}

#====================================================
# Step 5: Summary and Save
#====================================================

results_df <- bind_rows(lapply(results, as.data.frame))

col_order <- c("dataset", "source", "status", "n_cells", "n_genes",
               "data_type", "layer_used", "log1p_applied",
               "annot_col", "n_original_labels", "original_labels",
               "n_clusters", "n_subclusters",
               "concordance_major", "concordance_sub", "error")
col_order  <- col_order[col_order %in% colnames(results_df)]
results_df <- results_df[, col_order]

cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  DONE\n")
cat(sprintf("  Success : %d\n", sum(results_df$status == "success")))
cat(sprintf("  Skipped : %d\n", sum(results_df$status == "skipped")))
cat(sprintf("  Errors  : %d\n", sum(results_df$status == "error")))

success_df <- results_df[results_df$status == "success", ]
if (nrow(success_df) > 0) {
  cat("\n  Concordance summary (major clusters):\n")
  cat(sprintf("    Mean   : %.1f%%\n", mean(success_df$concordance_major,   na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("    Median : %.1f%%\n", median(success_df$concordance_major, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("    Min    : %.1f%%\n", min(success_df$concordance_major,    na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("    Max    : %.1f%%\n", max(success_df$concordance_major,    na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("\n  Data type breakdown:\n")
  print(table(success_df$data_type))
}

error_df <- results_df[results_df$status == "error", ]
if (nrow(error_df) > 0) {
  cat("\n  Failed datasets:\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(error_df))) {
    cat(sprintf("    %s — %s\n", error_df$dataset[i], error_df$error[i]))
  }
}

timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
out_csv   <- file.path(opt$out_dir, paste0("concordance_results_", timestamp, ".csv"))
write.csv(results_df, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\n  Results → %s\n", out_csv))
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")

session_path <- file.path(opt$out_dir, "session_info.txt")
sink(session_path)
cat("========================================\n")
cat("  ClustoCell Concordance — Session Info\n")
cat(sprintf("  Run date: %s\n", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")))
cat("========================================\n\n")
print(sessionInfo())
sink()
cat(sprintf("  Session info → %s\n", session_path))
```

#### Part 5 (hECA)

```{r}

# ==============================================================================
# 00_Normalized_h5ad_to_seurat.R
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Converts all Normalized database h5ad files to Seurat RDS objects.
#
# This data is already known/confirmed to be normalized.
#
# STORAGE BACKEND: most studies are converted to a standard in-memory
# dgCMatrix. A small number of the largest studies (millions of cells) exceed
# the 32-bit non-zero-count ceiling that dgCMatrix can represent
# (2^31 - 1 ~= 2.147 billion non-zero values). For those studies, zellkonverter's
# readH5AD() itself can hit this ceiling internally while building the SCE --
# in which case the script bypasses readH5AD() entirely for that file, using
# anndataR (backed mode) to read obs/var metadata cheaply and BPCells to read
# the expression matrix directly from the h5ad file on disk. IMPORTANT: for
# BPCells-backed studies, the saved .rds file does NOT contain the expression
# matrix itself -- it only references the on-disk directory under
# BPCELLS_DIR. That directory must be kept alongside the .rds file (e.g. when
# copying to Argos) or the counts layer will fail to load. Check
# seurat@misc$pipeline_info$storage_backend (or the log's storage_backend
# column) to see which studies use which backend.
#
# For each study:
#   1. Reads h5ad -> SingleCellExperiment via zellkonverter
#   2. Picks the best assay (counts > logcounts > data > X)
#   3. Converts to dgCMatrix, or to a BPCells on-disk matrix if too large
#   4. Transfers ALL obs columns into Seurat metadata
#   5. Identifies annotation column: cell_type
#   6. Stores provenance + storage backend in seurat@misc[["pipeline_info"]]
#   7. Saves as <dataset>.rds -- skips if already exists (safe to re-run)
#
# Output log: input/normalized_seurat/normalized_h5ad_to_seurat_log.tsv
#
# Usage:
#   Rscript 00_Normalized_h5ad_to_seurat.R
#
# Requirements:
#   BiocManager::install("zellkonverter")
#   BiocManager::install("anndataR")   # backed-mode metadata read for oversized files
#   install.packages(c("Seurat", "SeuratObject", "Matrix"))
#   install.packages("BPCells", repos = "https://bnprks.r-universe.dev")
#
# Author:
#   Natalia Pretel
#
# Date:
#   July 2026
# ==============================================================================


# Import required libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(zellkonverter)
  library(Seurat)
  library(SeuratObject)
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(Matrix)
})

# BPCells is only needed for the small number of oversized studies that
# exceed dgCMatrix's 32-bit non-zero-count ceiling (see header). 07355.or
BPCELLS_AVAILABLE <- requireNamespace("BPCells", quietly = TRUE)
if (BPCELLS_AVAILABLE) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(BPCells))
} else {
  cat("[NOTE] Package 'BPCells' not installed -- studies with matrices too large\n")
  cat("       for dgCMatrix will fail with a clear error instead of using the\n")
  cat("       on-disk fallback. Install with:\n")
  cat('       install.packages("BPCells", repos = "https://bnprks.r-universe.dev")\n\n')
}

# -- CONFIGURE PATHS ------------------------------------------------------------
H5AD_DIR    <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/data/NormalizedData"
OUT_DIR     <- file.path(H5AD_DIR, "Normalized_seurat_objects")
LOG_DIR     <- "/Volumes/Elements SE/DFCI/Clusto_Cell/data/NormalizedData"
# On-disk backend for studies whose non-zero count exceeds the 32-bit
# dgCMatrix ceiling (2^31 - 1 ~= 2.147 billion). Each such study gets its own
# subfolder here holding its BPCells on-disk matrix. IMPORTANT: the resulting
# .rds file for these studies does NOT contain the expression matrix -- it
# only references this directory. The two must be kept together; if this
# folder moves, the .rds file's counts layer will not load.
BPCELLS_DIR <- file.path(H5AD_DIR, "bpcells_backed")
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Only one annotation column is expected in this data -- no fallback needed.
ANNOT_COL <- "cell_type"

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(LOG_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(BPCELLS_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# HELPERS
# ==============================================================================

pick_assay <- function(sce) {
  available <- assayNames(sce)
  cat("    Available assays:", paste(available, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  # X first: confirmed via structural scan that every file checked so far has
  # NO separate layers -- the normalized matrix lives in X.
  for (candidate in c("X", "logcounts", "data", "counts")) {
    if (candidate %in% available) return(candidate)
  }
  return(available[1])
}

# Single expected annotation column -- no priority fallback needed.
pick_annot_col <- function(meta_cols) {
  if (ANNOT_COL %in% meta_cols) return(ANNOT_COL)
  return(NA_character_)
}

# ==============================================================================
# MAIN LOOP
# ==============================================================================

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) >= 1) {
  h5ad_files <- args[1]
  cat("Running in single-file mode:", basename(h5ad_files), "\n\n")
} else {
  h5ad_files <- sort(list.files(H5AD_DIR, pattern = "\\.h5ad$", full.names = TRUE))
  cat(sprintf("Found %d h5ad files in %s\n\n", length(h5ad_files), H5AD_DIR))
}

log_records <- list()
had_error <- FALSE

for (fpath in h5ad_files) {
  
  fname   <- basename(fpath)
  dataset <- sub("\\.h5ad$", "", fname)
  out_rds <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0(dataset, ".rds"))
  
  cat(sprintf("-- %s --\n", dataset))
  
  if (file.exists(out_rds)) {
    cat(sprintf("   [SKIP] RDS already exists: %s\n\n", out_rds))
    log_records[[dataset]] <- data.frame(
      dataset = dataset, status = "skipped",
      n_cells = NA, n_genes = NA, storage_backend = NA,
      annot_col_primary = NA, all_obs_cols = NA, error = NA,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    next
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    
    cat("   Reading h5ad...\n")
    
    read_attempt <- tryCatch({
      list(sce = readH5AD(fpath, use_hdf5 = FALSE, reader = "R"), oversized_at_read = FALSE)
    }, error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("too many nonzero values", conditionMessage(e))) {
        list(sce = NULL, oversized_at_read = TRUE)
      } else {
        stop(e)  
      }
    })
    
    sce <- read_attempt$sce
    
    if (read_attempt$oversized_at_read) {
      
      if (!BPCELLS_AVAILABLE) {
        stop("Matrix too large for zellkonverter/dgCMatrix and package 'BPCells' is not installed. ",
             'Install with: install.packages("BPCells", repos = "https://bnprks.r-universe.dev")')
      }
      if (!requireNamespace("anndataR", quietly = TRUE)) {
        stop("Matrix too large for zellkonverter's readH5AD() and package 'anndataR' is not installed ",
             "(needed to read obs/var metadata without touching X). ",
             'Install with: BiocManager::install("anndataR")')
      }
      
      storage_backend <- "BPCells"
      cat("   [INFO] readH5AD() itself hit the 32-bit matrix ceiling -- bypassing it entirely.\n")
      cat("   [INFO] Reading metadata via anndataR (backed) + matrix via BPCells...\n")
      
      ad       <- anndataR::read_h5ad(fpath, as = "HDF5AnnData")
      obs_df   <- as.data.frame(ad$obs)
      n_cells  <- nrow(obs_df)
      n_genes  <- nrow(ad$var)
      assay_name <- "X"  
      
      cat(sprintf("   %s cells | %s genes\n",
                  format(n_cells, big.mark = ","),
                  format(n_genes, big.mark = ",")))
      
      bp_dir <- file.path(BPCELLS_DIR, dataset)
      if (dir.exists(bp_dir)) unlink(bp_dir, recursive = TRUE)  # fresh write on re-run
      
      mat_bp <- open_matrix_anndata_hdf5(fpath, group = "X")
      if (nrow(mat_bp) != n_genes || ncol(mat_bp) != n_cells) {
        mat_bp <- Matrix::t(mat_bp)
      }
      stopifnot(nrow(mat_bp) == n_genes, ncol(mat_bp) == n_cells)
      
      write_matrix_dir(mat_bp, dir = bp_dir, overwrite = TRUE)
      mat <- open_matrix_dir(dir = bp_dir)
      cat(sprintf("   BPCells matrix written -> %s\n", bp_dir))
      
    } else {
      
      n_cells <- ncol(sce)
      n_genes <- nrow(sce)
      cat(sprintf("   %s cells | %s genes\n",
                  format(n_cells, big.mark = ","),
                  format(n_genes, big.mark = ",")))
      
      assay_name <- pick_assay(sce)
      mat_native <- assay(sce, assay_name)
      
      storage_backend <- "in_memory"
      mat <- tryCatch({
        if (inherits(mat_native, "dgCMatrix")) mat_native else as(mat_native, "dgCMatrix")
      }, error = function(e) {
        if (grepl("too many nonzero values", conditionMessage(e))) {
          NULL  # signal: fall through to BPCells below
        } else {
          stop(e)  # a different error -- don't swallow it
        }
      })
      
      if (is.null(mat)) {
        if (!BPCELLS_AVAILABLE) {
          stop("Matrix exceeds 32-bit dgCMatrix capacity and package 'BPCells' is not installed. ",
               'Install with: install.packages("BPCells", repos = "https://bnprks.r-universe.dev")')
        }
        
        storage_backend <- "BPCells"
        cat("   [INFO] Matrix exceeds 32-bit dgCMatrix capacity -- switching to BPCells on-disk backend...\n")
        
        bp_dir <- file.path(BPCELLS_DIR, dataset)
        if (dir.exists(bp_dir)) unlink(bp_dir, recursive = TRUE)  # fresh write on re-run
        
        # Read X directly from the h5ad file on disk -- bypasses R's in-memory
        # 32-bit sparse matrix ceiling entirely (BPCells has no such limit).
        mat_bp <- open_matrix_anndata_hdf5(fpath, group = "X")
        
        # h5ad stores obs (cells) x var (genes); BPCells reads that native
        # orientation as-is. Transpose to genes x cells to match the
        # Seurat/SCE convention already established by `sce` (n_genes, n_cells).
        if (nrow(mat_bp) != n_genes || ncol(mat_bp) != n_cells) {
          mat_bp <- Matrix::t(mat_bp)
        }
        stopifnot(nrow(mat_bp) == n_genes, ncol(mat_bp) == n_cells)
        
        write_matrix_dir(mat_bp, dir = bp_dir, overwrite = TRUE)
        mat <- open_matrix_dir(dir = bp_dir)
        cat(sprintf("   BPCells matrix written -> %s\n", bp_dir))
      }
      
      obs_df <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("   Assay        : %s\n",      assay_name))
    cat(sprintf("   Backend      : %s\n",      storage_backend))
    
    cat("   Building Seurat object...\n")
    seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, assay = "RNA", project = dataset)
    
    obs_cols <- colnames(obs_df)
    for (col in obs_cols) seurat_obj[[col]] <- obs_df[[col]]
    
    annot_primary <- pick_annot_col(obs_cols)
    if (is.na(annot_primary)) {
      warning(sprintf("[WARN] No annotation column found. Obs cols: %s",
                      paste(obs_cols, collapse = ", ")))
      cat("   [WARN] No annotation column found!\n")
    } else {
      cat(sprintf("   Primary annot   : %s  (%d unique)\n",
                  annot_primary,
                  length(unique(seurat_obj[[annot_primary, drop = TRUE]]))))
    }
    
    seurat_obj@misc[["pipeline_info"]] <- list(
      dataset            = dataset,
      source             = "STAMP_Malignant_cell_identification",
      annot_col_primary  = annot_primary,
      all_obs_cols       = obs_cols,
      storage_backend    = storage_backend
    )
    
    cat(sprintf("   Saving -> %s\n", out_rds))
    saveRDS(seurat_obj, file = out_rds)
    cat("   [DONE]\n\n")
    
    log_records[[dataset]] <- data.frame(
      dataset = dataset, status = "success",
      n_cells = n_cells, n_genes = n_genes,
      storage_backend = storage_backend,
      annot_col_primary = ifelse(is.na(annot_primary), "NONE_FOUND", annot_primary),
      all_obs_cols = paste(obs_cols, collapse = " | "),
      error = NA,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("   [ERROR] %s\n\n", conditionMessage(e)))
    had_error <<- TRUE
    log_records[[dataset]] <<- data.frame(
      dataset = dataset, status = "error",
      n_cells = NA, n_genes = NA, storage_backend = NA,
      annot_col_primary = NA, all_obs_cols = NA,
      error = conditionMessage(e),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
}

# ==============================================================================
# SAVE LOG + SUMMARY
# ==============================================================================

log_df   <- do.call(rbind, log_records)
log_path <- file.path(LOG_DIR, "STAMP_h5ad_to_seurat_log.tsv")
write.table(log_df, log_path, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE,
            append = file.exists(log_path))
cat(sprintf("\nLog saved -> %s\n", log_path))

cat("\n-- Run summary --\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total     : %d\n", nrow(log_df)))
cat(sprintf("  Success   : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "success", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Skipped   : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "skipped", na.rm = TRUE)))
cat(sprintf("  Errors    : %d\n", sum(log_df$status == "error",   na.rm = TRUE)))

n_bpcells <- sum(log_df$storage_backend == "BPCells", na.rm = TRUE)
if (n_bpcells > 0) {
  bpcells_names <- log_df[log_df$storage_backend %in% "BPCells" & !is.na(log_df$storage_backend), "dataset"]
  cat(sprintf("\n  BPCells backend used for %d oversized study/studies (see %s):\n", n_bpcells, BPCELLS_DIR))
  cat(paste0("    - ", bpcells_names, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
  cat("  Remember: these studies' .rds files depend on this folder -- keep them together.\n")
}

cat("\nDone.\n")

if (had_error && length(args) >= 1) {
  quit(save = "no", status = 1)
}
```
