```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# broad_category_mapping.R
# ==============================================================================
# Manually curated fine -> broad cell-type mapping for the hECA highly granualr
# datasets (RNA-Thymus, RNA-Skin, RNA-Kidney, RNA-Blood, RNA-Spleen,
# RNA-Bone_marrow).
# ==============================================================================

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared hematopoietic/immune lineage groupings (apply to all 6 datasets,
# since hECA uses consistent nomenclature across tissues)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
IMMUNE_MAP <- list(
  "T cell" = c(
    "T cell", "CD4 T cell", "CD8 T cell", "Naive CD4 T cell", "Naive CD8 T cell",
    "Memory CD4 T cell", "Memory CD8 T cell", "CD4 Treg", "CD8 Treg",
    "Helper T cell", "Cytotoxic CD8 T cell", "CD4 Tem", "CD8 Tem",
    "CD4 Trm", "CD8 Trm", "MAIT cell", "Double positive T cell",
    "Double negative T cell", "Early T-cell precursor", "Positive T cell"
  ),
  "NK/ILC" = c(
    "NK cell", "NK T cell", "ILC", "ILC2", "ILC3", "Mesodermal killer cell"
  ),
  "B cell" = c(
    "B cell", "Naive B cell", "Memory B cell", "Plasma B cell", "Plasmablast",
    "Pro-B cell", "Pre-B cell"
  ),
  "Myeloid cell" = c(
    "Monocyte", "Macrophage", "Tissue-resident macrophage", "Alveolar macrophage",
    "Monocyte-derived macrophage", "Myeloid cell",
    "Conventional dendritic cell", "Conventional dendritic cell 1",
    "Conventional dendritic cell 2", "Plasmacytoid dendritic cell",
    "Dendritic cell", "Monocyte derived dendritic cell", "Langerhans cell",
    "Macrophage dendritic cell progenitor", "Monocyte-dendritic progenitor (MDP)",
    "Pre conventional dendritic cell", "Mast cell", "Neutrophilic granulocyte",
    "Neutrophilic myelocyte", "Eosinophilic granulocyte", "Basophilic granulocyte",
    "Granulocyte"
  ),
  "Erythroid cell" = c(
    "Erythrocyte", "Erythroid progenitor cell",
    "Erythrocyte or its precursor cells",
    "Erythrocyte or its precursor cells but specific sub-type not listed"
  ),
  "Megakaryocyte" = c(
    "Megakaryocyte", "Megakaryocytic progenitor cell",
    "Megakaryocyte-erythrocyte progenitor (MEP)"
  ),
  "Progenitor/Stem cell" = c(
    "Haematopoietic stem cell", "Haematopoietic stem and progenitor cell",
    "Multipotent progenitor (MPP)", "Multipotent hematopoietic progenitor",
    "Common lymphoid progenitor (CLP)", "Common myeloid progenitor (CMP)",
    "Granulocyte-monocyte progenitor (GMP)", "Progenitor cell",
    "Not explicitly listed could be closer to 'Granulocyte-monocyte progenitor (GMP)'"
  )
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shared structural/stromal groupings
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
STRUCTURAL_MAP <- list(
  "Stromal/Mesenchymal cell" = c(
    "Fibroblast", "Myofibroblast", "Mesenchymal cell", "Stromal cell",
    "Interstitial cell", "Pericyte", "Smooth muscle cell",
    "Vascular smooth muscle cell", "Muscle satellite cell", "Muscle cell",
    "Skeletal muscle cell", "Fast skeletal muscle cell", "Chondrocyte",
    "Osteoclast", "Mesothelial cell"
  ),
  "Endothelial cell" = c(
    "Endothelial cell", "Vascular endothelial cell", "Capillary endothelial cell",
    "Lymphatic endothelial cell"
  ),
  "Neural/Glial cell" = c(
    "Neuron", "Schwann cell", "Enteric glial cell", "Neuroglial cell",
    "Oligodendrocyte precursor cell"
  ),
  "Melanocyte" = c("Melanocyte"),
  "Epithelial cell (other)" = c("Keratinocyte", "Epithelial cell"),
  "Other/Rare cell" = c("Enteroendocrine cell")
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Ambiguous / generic labels kept AS-IS (not merged -- no confident lineage
# assignment possible from the label alone)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
KEEP_AS_IS <- c("Lymphoid cell", "Unclassified", "Proliferating cell")

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dataset-specific tissue epithelium groupings
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
KIDNEY_EPITHELIUM <- c(
  "Proximal convoluted tubule", "Proximal convoluted tubule progenitor",
  "Distal convoluted tubule", "Loop of henle", "Loop of henle progenitor",
  "Collecting duct", "Principle cell", "Intercalated cell", "Podocyte",
  "Ureteric bud cell", "Ureteric epithelial cell", "Juxtaglomerular cell",
  "Mesangial cell", "Renal tubular epithelial cell", "Epithelial progenitor cell",
  "Epithelial cell"
)

SKIN_EPITHELIUM <- c(
  "Keratinocyte", "Follicular epithelial cell", "Sweat gland cell",
  "Epithelial stem cell", "Epithelial cell"
)

THYMUS_EPITHELIUM <- c(
  "Medullary thymic epithelial cell", "Cortical thymic epithelial cell",
  "Transitional epithelial cell", "TEC Ionocyte like", "Epithelial cell"
)

DATASET_EPITHELIUM <- list(
  "RNA-Kidney"      = list(label = "Kidney epithelial cell", cats = KIDNEY_EPITHELIUM),
  "RNA-Skin"        = list(label = "Skin epithelial cell",   cats = SKIN_EPITHELIUM),
  "RNA-Thymus"      = list(label = "Thymic epithelial cell", cats = THYMUS_EPITHELIUM)
)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# build_broad_map(all_labels, dataset_name) -> named character vector
#   names = fine label, values = broad label
#   Any fine label not explicitly covered falls back to itself (flagged).
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
build_broad_map <- function(all_labels, dataset_name) {
  map <- setNames(character(0), character(0))

  add_group <- function(map, group_list) {
    for (broad in names(group_list)) {
      fine_vals <- group_list[[broad]]
      map[fine_vals] <- broad
    }
    map
  }

  map <- add_group(map, IMMUNE_MAP)
  map <- add_group(map, STRUCTURAL_MAP)
  for (v in KEEP_AS_IS) map[v] <- v

  if (dataset_name %in% names(DATASET_EPITHELIUM)) {
    ep <- DATASET_EPITHELIUM[[dataset_name]]
    map[ep$cats] <- ep$label
  }

  # Any label present in the data but not yet mapped -> keep as-is, flag it
  unmapped <- setdiff(all_labels, names(map))
  unmapped <- unmapped[!is.na(unmapped) & unmapped != ""]
  if (length(unmapped) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  [NOTE] %d unmapped label(s) in %s kept as-is: %s\n",
                length(unmapped), dataset_name, paste(unmapped, collapse = "; ")))
    map[unmapped] <- unmapped
  }

  map
}
```

```{r}
# ===============================================================================
# 04_run_clustocell_concordance_3.R
# ===============================================================================
# Runs CluStoCell on all Seurat objects from the 3CA, PanCancer, and TISCH2
# databases, computes max overlap concordance between CluStoCell clusters and
# existing annotations, and saves a summary CSV with one row per dataset.
#
# Concordance metric: max overlap (%)
#   NA-labeled cells are excluded from both the contingency table and denominator.
#   For each cluster, the annotation label with the highest cell count is
#   identified. The sum of those maximums is divided by the number of valid
#   (non-NA) cells x 100. A score of 100% means every cluster is perfectly
#   dominated by one label.
#
# Annotation column priority per source:
#   3CA       -> cell_type > cell_subtype > celltype > annotation
#   PanCancer -> majorCluster > subCluster > ann1 > cellType1
#   TISCH2    -> Celltype_major_lineage > Celltype_minor_lineage > Celltype_malignancy
#
# CluStoCell strategy:
#   All datasets: subset_to_HVG=FALSE (default parameter)
#   Sketching: fixed parameters for reproducibility
#     > 100,000 cells → sketch=TRUE, ncells=20,000
#     40,000–100,000  → sketch=TRUE, ncells=40,000
#     ≤ 40,000 cells  → sketch=FALSE
#
# Changes vs v2:
#   - subset_to_HVG=FALSE for ALL datasets (not just fallback)
#   - Retry logic removed — single clean call with default parameters
#   - Concordance formula explicitly documents NA exclusion
#
# Usage:
#   Rscript 04_run_clustocell_concordance_3.R \
#     --ca_dir        "/path/to/3CA_seurat" \
#     --pancancer_dir "/path/to/Nature_Pancancer_seurat" \
#     --tisch_dir     "/path/to/TISCH2_seurat" \
#     --out_dir       "/path/to/output"
#
# Author: Natalia Pretel
# Date:   July 2026
# ===============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(celliverse)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(optparse)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

# Configuration of the CLI Arguments
option_list <- list(
  make_option("--ca_dir",        type = "character", default = NULL,
              help = "Directory with 3CA Seurat RDS files"),
  make_option("--pancancer_dir", type = "character", default = NULL,
              help = "Directory with PanCancer Seurat RDS files"),
  make_option("--tisch_dir",     type = "character", default = NULL,
              help = "Directory with TISCH2 Seurat RDS files"),
  make_option("--out_dir",       type = "character", required = TRUE,
              help = "Output directory for results"),
  make_option("--dataset",       type = "character", default = NULL,
              help = "Run only this dataset (stem name, e.g. Brain_Choudhury2022)")
)
opt <- parse_args(OptionParser(option_list = option_list))
dir.create(opt$out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 0: Helper Functions
# ==============================================================================

detect_layer_content <- function(so, layer_name) {
  tryCatch({
    mat          <- LayerData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = layer_name)
    non_zero     <- mat@x[mat@x > 0]
    if (length(non_zero) == 0) return("EMPTY")
    sample_vals   <- head(non_zero, 10000)
    pct_integer   <- mean(sample_vals == round(sample_vals)) * 100
    max_val       <- max(non_zero)
    mean_val      <- mean(sample_vals)
    pct_above_20  <- mean(sample_vals > 20)  * 100
    pct_above_100 <- mean(sample_vals > 100) * 100
    if (pct_integer >= 99) return("RAW_COUNTS")
    if (max_val <= 20 && pct_above_20 < 1) return("LOG_NORMALIZED")
    if (max_val > 100 && pct_above_20 > 5 && pct_integer < 5) return("TPM_CPM")
    votes_tpm <- sum(c(max_val > 100, pct_above_20 > 5, pct_above_100 > 1, mean_val > 50))
    votes_log <- sum(c(max_val <= 50, pct_above_20 < 5, pct_above_100 == 0, mean_val <= 10))
    if (votes_tpm > votes_log) return("TPM_CPM")
    if (votes_log > votes_tpm) return("LOG_NORMALIZED")
    return("UNCERTAIN")
  }, error = function(e) "NOT_PRESENT")
}

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 1: Annotation column detection
# ==============================================================================

ANNOT_PRIORITY <- list(
  "3CA"       = c("cell_type", "cell_subtype", "celltype", "annotation",
                  "cell_annotation", "author_cell_type", "authors_cell_type",
                  "CellType", "Celltype", "label", "cluster_annotation"),
  "PanCancer" = c("majorCluster", "subCluster", "ann1", "cellType1",
                  "cellType2", "Prediction"),
  "TISCH2"    = c("Celltype_major_lineage", "Celltype_minor_lineage",
                  "Celltype_malignancy", "Cluster")
)

detect_annotation_column <- function(so, source) {
  meta_cols     <- colnames(so@meta.data)
  pipeline_info <- if (!is.null(so@misc[["pipeline_info"]])) so@misc[["pipeline_info"]] else so@misc[["blscope"]]
  if (!is.null(pipeline_info)) {
    primary <- pipeline_info[["annot_col_primary"]]
    if (!is.null(primary) && !is.na(primary) &&
        primary %in% meta_cols && primary != "NONE_FOUND") {
      n_unique <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[primary]]))
      if (n_unique >= 2 && n_unique <= 500) {
        cat(sprintf("        Annotation from misc slot: %s (%d unique)\n", primary, n_unique))
        return(primary)
      }
    }
  }
  candidates <- ANNOT_PRIORITY[[source]]
  if (is.null(candidates)) candidates <- unlist(ANNOT_PRIORITY)
  for (col in candidates) {
    if (col %in% meta_cols) {
      n_unique <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[col]]))
      if (n_unique >= 2 && n_unique <= 500) return(col)
    }
  }
  for (col in meta_cols) {
    if (grepl("type|annot|label|cluster|lineage|cell|subtype", col, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      n_unique <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[col]]))
      if (n_unique >= 2 && n_unique <= 500) return(col)
    }
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 2: Per-dataset processing
# ==============================================================================

run_dataset <- function(rds_path, source, out_dir) {
  
  dataset_name <- sub("_seurat\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_path))
  dataset_name <- sub("\\.rds$",        "", dataset_name)
  out_rds      <- file.path(out_dir, "seurat_objects",
                            paste0(dataset_name, "_clustocell.rds"))
  dir.create(dirname(out_rds), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  cat("\n", strrep("-", 60), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Dataset :", dataset_name, "\n")
  cat("  Source  :", source, "\n")
  
  result <- list(
    dataset           = dataset_name,
    source            = source,
    status            = "error",
    n_cells           = NA, n_genes           = NA,
    data_type         = NA, layer_used        = NA,
    log1p_applied     = NA,
    n_clusters        = NA, n_subclusters     = NA,
    annot_col         = NA, n_original_labels = NA,
    original_labels   = NA,
    concordance_major = NA, concordance_sub   = NA,
    error             = ""
  )
  
  # Skip if already processed
  if (file.exists(out_rds)) {
    cat("  Already exists — skipping\n")
    result$status <- "skipped"
    return(result)
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    
    # Step 1: Load
    cat(" Step 1: Loading Seurat object...\n")
    so <- readRDS(rds_path)
    result$n_cells <- ncol(so)
    result$n_genes <- nrow(so)
    cat(sprintf("         %s cells x %s genes\n",
                format(ncol(so), big.mark = ","),
                format(nrow(so), big.mark = ",")))
    
    # Step 2: Detect data type
    cat(" Step 2: Detecting data type...\n")
    available_layers   <- names(so@assays$RNA@layers)
    counts_type        <- if ("counts" %in% available_layers) detect_layer_content(so, "counts") else "NOT_PRESENT"
    data_type_detected <- if ("data"   %in% available_layers) detect_layer_content(so, "data")   else "NOT_PRESENT"
    cat("         counts layer:", counts_type, "\n")
    cat("         data layer  :", data_type_detected, "\n")
    
    if (counts_type == "RAW_COUNTS") {
      use_layer <- "counts"; use_log1p <- TRUE;  result$data_type <- "raw_counts"
    } else if (data_type_detected == "LOG_NORMALIZED") {
      use_layer <- "data";   use_log1p <- FALSE; result$data_type <- "log_normalized"
    } else if (data_type_detected == "TPM_CPM") {
      use_layer <- "data";   use_log1p <- TRUE;  result$data_type <- "tpm_cpm"
    } else if (data_type_detected == "UNCERTAIN") {
      use_layer <- "data";   use_log1p <- TRUE;  result$data_type <- "uncertain"
      cat("         [IMPORTANT] Uncertain data type — applying log1p as safe default\n")
    } else {
      use_layer <- if ("data" %in% available_layers) "data" else "counts"
      use_log1p <- TRUE; result$data_type <- "unknown"
    }
    
    result$layer_used    <- use_layer
    result$log1p_applied <- use_log1p
    cat(sprintf("         -> Layer: %s | log1p: %s\n", use_layer, use_log1p))
    
    pipeline_info <- if (!is.null(so@misc[["pipeline_info"]])) so@misc[["pipeline_info"]] else so@misc[["blscope"]]
    stored_type   <- pipeline_info[["data_type"]]
    if (!is.null(stored_type) && !is.na(stored_type)) {
      if (stored_type == result$data_type) {
        cat(sprintf("         [CHECK] Data type confirmed: %s\n", result$data_type))
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("         [WARN] Mismatch: stored='%s' detected='%s' → trusting detected\n",
                    stored_type, result$data_type))
      }
    }
    
    if (!("data" %in% names(so@assays$RNA@layers))) {
      cat("         Normalizing data layer for HVG detection...\n")
      so <- NormalizeData(so, verbose = FALSE)
    }
    
    # Step 3: Annotation column
    cat(" Step 3: Detecting annotation column...\n")
    annot_col <- detect_annotation_column(so, source)
    if (is.null(annot_col)) stop("No suitable annotation column found")
    
    result$annot_col         <- annot_col
    result$n_original_labels <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[annot_col]]))
    result$original_labels   <- paste(sort(unique(so@meta.data[[annot_col]])), collapse = " | ")
    cat(sprintf("         Column: %s (%d unique labels)\n", annot_col, result$n_original_labels))
    
    # Step 4: Run CluStoCell 
    cat(" Step 4: Running CluStoCell (subset_to_HVG=FALSE)...\n")
    n_cells <- ncol(so)
    if (n_cells > 100000) {
      use_sketch    <- TRUE
      sketch_ncells <- 20000L
    } else if (n_cells > 40000) {
      use_sketch    <- TRUE
      sketch_ncells <- 40000L
    } else {
      use_sketch    <- FALSE
      sketch_ncells <- 10000L  # not used but required by clustoCell signature
    }
    mat_for_clustering <- LayerData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = use_layer)
    
    cat(sprintf("         subset_to_HVG=FALSE | sketch=%s%s\n",
                use_sketch,
                if (use_sketch) sprintf(" (ncells=%d)", sketch_ncells) else ""))
    
    cc <- tryCatch(
      clustoCell(
        data                         = mat_for_clustering,
        assay                        = "RNA",
        layer                        = use_layer,
        norm_assay                   = "RNA",
        norm_layer                   = "data",
        log1p                        = use_log1p,
        subset_to_HVG                = FALSE,
        identify_subclusters         = TRUE,
        leiden_resolution            = 1,
        leiden_n_iterations          = 5,
        subcluster_resolution_weight = 0.75,
        sketch                       = use_sketch,
        sketch_ncells                = sketch_ncells,
        num_threads                  = -1,
        seed                         = 2025,
        verbose                      = FALSE
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        cat(sprintf("         [ERROR] CluStoCell failed: %s\n", conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      }
    )
    
    if (is.null(cc)) stop("CluStoCell failed")
    
    # Step 5: Add clusters
    cat(" Step 5: Adding cluster labels to Seurat object...\n")
    so <- addClustoData(
      obj                = so,
      clustoCell         = cc,
      add_major_clusters = TRUE,
      add_sub_clusters   = TRUE,
      major_cluster_name = "ClustoCell",
      sub_cluster_name   = "ClustoCell_sub"
    )
    
    n_major <- length(unique(na.omit(so@meta.data[["ClustoCell"]])))
    n_sub   <- length(unique(na.omit(so@meta.data[["ClustoCell_sub"]])))
    result$n_clusters    <- n_major
    result$n_subclusters <- n_sub
    cat(sprintf("         Major clusters: %d | Sub-clusters: %d\n", n_major, n_sub))
    
    # Step 6: Concordance — NA cells excluded from both table and denominator
    cat(" Step 6: Computing concordance...\n")
    
    labels         <- as.character(so@meta.data[[annot_col]])
    major_clusters <- as.character(so@meta.data[["ClustoCell"]])
    sub_clusters   <- as.character(so@meta.data[["ClustoCell_sub"]])
    valid_major    <- !is.na(labels) & !is.na(major_clusters)
    valid_sub      <- !is.na(labels) & !is.na(sub_clusters)
    
    contingency_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "contingency_tables")
    dir.create(contingency_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    
    # Major clusters
    labels_major   <- labels[valid_major]
    clusters_major <- major_clusters[valid_major]
    if (length(unique(labels_major)) > length(unique(clusters_major))) {
      ct_major <- table(`Manual Annotation` = labels_major, ClustoCell = clusters_major)
    } else {
      ct_major <- table(ClustoCell = clusters_major, `Manual Annotation` = labels_major)
    }
    concordance_major        <- round((sum(apply(ct_major, 1, max)) / length(clusters_major)) * 100)
    result$concordance_major <- concordance_major
    cat(sprintf("         Major concordance: %d%%\n", concordance_major))
    
    ct_major_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(ct_major)
    ct_major_df <- cbind(Cluster = rownames(ct_major_df), ct_major_df)
    write.csv(ct_major_df,
              file.path(contingency_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_contingency_major.csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Sub-clusters
    labels_sub   <- labels[valid_sub]
    clusters_sub <- sub_clusters[valid_sub]
    if (length(unique(labels_sub)) > length(unique(clusters_sub))) {
      ct_sub <- table(`Manual Annotation` = labels_sub, ClustoCell = clusters_sub)
    } else {
      ct_sub <- table(ClustoCell = clusters_sub, `Manual Annotation` = labels_sub)
    }
    concordance_sub        <- round((sum(apply(ct_sub, 1, max)) / length(clusters_sub)) * 100)
    result$concordance_sub <- concordance_sub
    cat(sprintf("         Sub concordance : %d%%\n", concordance_sub))
    
    ct_sub_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(ct_sub)
    ct_sub_df <- cbind(Cluster = rownames(ct_sub_df), ct_sub_df)
    write.csv(ct_sub_df,
              file.path(contingency_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_contingency_sub.csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Heatmaps
    plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")
    dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    
    plot_contingency_heatmap <- function(ct, title, out_path) {
      ct_pct <- sweep(ct, 1, rowSums(ct), "/") * 100
      ct_df  <- as.data.frame(as.table(ct_pct))
      colnames(ct_df) <- c("Cluster", "Annotation", "Pct")
      ct_df$Annotation <- stringr::str_trunc(ct_df$Annotation, 30)
      p <- ggplot2::ggplot(ct_df, ggplot2::aes(x = Annotation, y = Cluster, fill = Pct)) +
        ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2166AC", name = "% cells\nin cluster") +
        ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = ifelse(Pct > 5, sprintf("%.0f%%", Pct), "")),
                           size = 2.5, color = "black") +
        ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
        ggplot2::theme(
          axis.text.x     = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          axis.text.y     = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
          plot.title      = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "right") +
        ggplot2::labs(title = title, x = annot_col, y = "CluStoCell cluster")
      ggplot2::ggsave(out_path, plot = p,
                      width  = max(8, ncol(ct) * 0.6),
                      height = max(5, nrow(ct) * 0.5),
                      limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 150)
    }
    
    tryCatch({
      plot_contingency_heatmap(
        ct_major,
        paste0(dataset_name, " \u2014 major clusters vs ", annot_col,
               "\nConcordance: ", concordance_major, "%"),
        file.path(plot_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_heatmap_major.pdf")))
      plot_contingency_heatmap(
        ct_sub,
        paste0(dataset_name, " \u2014 sub-clusters vs ", annot_col,
               "\nConcordance: ", concordance_sub, "%"),
        file.path(plot_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_heatmap_sub.pdf")))
      cat(sprintf("         Heatmaps saved \u2192 %s_heatmap_major/sub.pdf\n", dataset_name))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("         [WARN] Heatmap failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    })
    
    saveRDS(so, out_rds)
    cat(sprintf("         Saved \u2192 %s\n", basename(out_rds)))
    result$status <- "success"
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  [ERROR]", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    result$error  <<- conditionMessage(e)
    result$status <<- "error"
  })
  
  return(result)
}

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 3: Collect RDS files
# ==============================================================================

collect_rds <- function(dir_path, source_label) {
  if (is.null(dir_path) || !dir.exists(dir_path)) return(NULL)
  files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  files <- files[!grepl("_clustocell\\.rds$", files)]
  files <- files[!grepl("^\\._", basename(files))]
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NULL)
  data.frame(path = files, source = source_label, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

all_datasets <- rbind(
  collect_rds(opt$ca_dir,        "3CA"),
  collect_rds(opt$pancancer_dir, "PanCancer"),
  collect_rds(opt$tisch_dir,     "TISCH2")
)

if (is.null(all_datasets) || nrow(all_datasets) == 0)
  stop("No Seurat RDS files found in any of the provided directories.")

if (!is.null(opt$dataset)) {
  all_datasets <- all_datasets[grepl(opt$dataset, basename(all_datasets$path)), ]
  if (nrow(all_datasets) == 0) stop("No datasets matching: ", opt$dataset)
}

cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  CluStoCell Concordance v3\n")
cat(sprintf("  Total datasets  : %d\n", nrow(all_datasets)))
cat(sprintf("  subset_to_HVG   : FALSE (default)\n"))
cat(sprintf("  NA cells        : excluded from concordance\n"))
cat("  Sources:\n")
for (s in names(table(all_datasets$source))) {
  cat(sprintf("    %s : %d\n", s, sum(all_datasets$source == s)))
}
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 4: Batch run
# ==============================================================================

results <- vector("list", nrow(all_datasets))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(all_datasets))) {
  cat(sprintf("\n[%d/%d]", i, nrow(all_datasets)))
  results[[i]] <- run_dataset(all_datasets$path[i], all_datasets$source[i], opt$out_dir)
}

# ==============================================================================
# STEP 5: Summary and save
# ==============================================================================

results_df <- bind_rows(lapply(results, as.data.frame))
col_order  <- c("dataset", "source", "status", "n_cells", "n_genes",
                "data_type", "layer_used", "log1p_applied",
                "annot_col", "n_original_labels", "original_labels",
                "n_clusters", "n_subclusters",
                "concordance_major", "concordance_sub", "error")
col_order  <- col_order[col_order %in% colnames(results_df)]
results_df <- results_df[, col_order]

cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  DONE\n")
cat(sprintf("  Success : %d\n", sum(results_df$status == "success")))
cat(sprintf("  Skipped : %d\n", sum(results_df$status == "skipped")))
cat(sprintf("  Errors  : %d\n", sum(results_df$status == "error")))

success_df <- results_df[results_df$status == "success", ]
if (nrow(success_df) > 0) {
  cat("\n  Concordance summary (major clusters):\n")
  cat(sprintf("    Mean   : %.1f%%\n", mean(success_df$concordance_major,   na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("    Median : %.1f%%\n", median(success_df$concordance_major, na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("    Min    : %.1f%%\n", min(success_df$concordance_major,    na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat(sprintf("    Max    : %.1f%%\n", max(success_df$concordance_major,    na.rm = TRUE)))
  cat("\n  Data type breakdown:\n")
  print(table(success_df$data_type))
}

if (nrow(results_df[results_df$status == "error", ]) > 0) {
  cat("\n  Failed datasets:\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(results_df[results_df$status == "error", ]))) {
    err <- results_df[results_df$status == "error", ]
    cat(sprintf("    %s \u2014 %s\n", err$dataset[i], err$error[i]))
  }
}

timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
out_csv   <- file.path(opt$out_dir, paste0("concordance_results_", timestamp, ".csv"))
write.csv(results_df, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\n  Results \u2192 %s\n", out_csv))
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")

session_path <- file.path(opt$out_dir, "session_info.txt")
sink(session_path)
cat("========================================\n")
cat("  CluStoCell Concordance v3 \u2014 Session Info\n")
cat(sprintf("  Run date      : %s\n", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")))
cat(sprintf("  subset_to_HVG : FALSE\n"))
cat(sprintf("  NA exclusion  : yes (concordance denominator = valid non-NA cells)\n"))
cat("========================================\n\n")
print(sessionInfo())
sink()
cat(sprintf("  Session info \u2192 %s\n", session_path))

```

#### Part 7 (hECA)

```{r}

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
# ===============================================================================
# 04_run_clustocell_decoupled_large_studies.R
# ===============================================================================
# Runs the DECOUPLED sketching + label-transfer workflow for the Healthy Normalize
# studies that are too large for clustoCell's built-in sketch=TRUE to handle.
#
# Workflow per study:
#   1. SketchData()                -- sample a small assay by sketching the full data
#   2. clustoCell()                -- cluster the sketched dataset only
#   3. clustoCell_TransferLabel()  -- extend cluster labels to EVERY cell in
#                                      the full dataset
#   4. addClustoData()             -- write Sketched_ClustoCell / Sketched_ClustoCell_sub columns
#   5. Concordance vs "cell_type"  --  max-overlap formula
#

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(celliverse)
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(optparse)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

# Seurat's ProjectData()  parallelizes some steps via the future package,
# which caps how much data it will ship to parallel workers at 500MB by
# default -- too small for our sketch/full dataset sizes (confirmed: 892.51
# MiB needed for RNA-Spinal_cord alone). Raised generously here given
# available RAM.

options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)  # 8 GB

option_list <- list(
  make_option("--seurat_dir", type = "character", required = TRUE,
              help = "Directory with Seurat RDS files"),
  make_option("--out_dir",    type = "character", required = TRUE,
              help = "Output directory for results"),
  make_option("--datasets",   type = "character",
              default = "RNA-Heart,RNA-Lung,RNA-Spinal_cord",
              help = "Comma-separated dataset stems to process [default: the 3 known oversized studies]")
)
opt <- parse_args(OptionParser(option_list = option_list))
dir.create(opt$out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Determine required labels
ANNOT_COL <- "cell_type"
SKETCH_METHOD   <- "Uniform"        
TRANSFER_METHOD <- "count-project"  

# ==============================================================================
# Helper functions
# ==============================================================================

detect_annotation_column <- function(so) {
  meta_cols     <- colnames(so@meta.data)
  pipeline_info <- so@misc[["pipeline_info"]]
  if (!is.null(pipeline_info)) {
    primary <- pipeline_info[["annot_col_primary"]]
    if (!is.null(primary) && !is.na(primary) &&
        primary %in% meta_cols && primary != "NONE_FOUND") {
      n_unique <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[primary]]))
      if (n_unique >= 2 && n_unique <= 500) return(primary)
    }
  }
  if (ANNOT_COL %in% meta_cols) {
    n_unique <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[ANNOT_COL]]))
    if (n_unique >= 2 && n_unique <= 500) return(ANNOT_COL)
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Per-dataset processing (decoupled workflow)
# ==============================================================================

run_dataset_decoupled <- function(rds_path, out_dir) {
  
  dataset_name <- sub("\\.rds$", "", basename(rds_path))
  out_rds      <- file.path(out_dir, "seurat_objects", paste0(dataset_name, "_clustocell.rds"))
  dir.create(dirname(out_rds), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  
  cat("\n", strrep("-", 60), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Dataset :", dataset_name, "(DECOUPLED workflow)\n")
  
  result <- list(
    dataset = dataset_name, source = "Normalized", status = "error",
    n_cells = NA, n_genes = NA, data_type = NA, layer_used = NA,
    log1p_applied = NA, storage_backend = NA,
    sketch_method = SKETCH_METHOD, transfer_method = TRANSFER_METHOD,
    n_clusters = NA, n_subclusters = NA,
    annot_col = NA, n_original_labels = NA, original_labels = NA,
    n_cells_labeled = NA,
    concordance_major = NA, concordance_sub = NA, error = ""
  )
  
  if (file.exists(out_rds)) {
    cat("  Already exists -- skipping\n")
    result$status <- "skipped"
    return(result)
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    
    # Step 1: Load
    cat(" Step 1: Loading Seurat object...\n")
    so <- readRDS(rds_path)
    result$n_cells <- ncol(so)
    result$n_genes <- nrow(so)
    cat(sprintf("         %s cells x %s genes\n",
                format(ncol(so), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(so), big.mark = ",")))
    
    result$storage_backend <- if (!is.null(so@misc[["pipeline_info"]][["storage_backend"]])) {
      so@misc[["pipeline_info"]][["storage_backend"]]
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
    cat(sprintf("         Storage backend: %s\n", result$storage_backend))
    
    # Step 2: Layer/data type -- hardcoded, not detected. 
    use_layer <- "counts"
    result$layer_used <- use_layer
    result$data_type  <- "log_normalized"
    cat(sprintf("         Layer: %s (hardcoded log_normalized)\n", use_layer))
    
    # without a "data" layer, SketchData() silently fails to actually subsample (the
    # resulting "sketch" assay came back at full size, 961,284 cells, instead
    # of the requested 20,000). Restoring "data" here to test whether that's
    # the actual missing ingredient for correct sketching, isolated from any
    # BPCells-related confound (this is the in-memory study).
    if (!("data" %in% names(so@assays$RNA@layers))) {
      cat("         Copying to 'data' layer without re-normalizing (testing whether this\n")
      cat("         is required for SketchData() to actually subsample correctly)...\n")
      so <- SetAssayData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = "data",
                         new.data = LayerData(so, assay = "RNA", layer = use_layer))
    }
    
    # Step 3: Annotation column
    cat(" Step 3: Detecting annotation column...\n")
    annot_col <- detect_annotation_column(so)
    if (is.null(annot_col)) stop("No suitable annotation column found")
    result$annot_col         <- annot_col
    result$n_original_labels <- length(unique(so@meta.data[[annot_col]]))
    result$original_labels   <- paste(sort(unique(so@meta.data[[annot_col]])), collapse = " | ")
    cat(sprintf("         Column: %s (%d unique labels)\n", annot_col, result$n_original_labels))
    
    # Step 4: Decoupled workflow
    cat(" Step 4: Decoupled CluStoCell (SketchData + clustoCell + TransferLabel)...\n")
    n_cells       <- ncol(so)
    sketch_ncells <- if (n_cells > 100000) 20000L else if (n_cells > 40000) 40000L else 10000L
    
    cat(sprintf("         Step 4.1: Sketching the data to %d cells...\n", sketch_ncells))
    
    so <- SketchData(
      object         = so,
      assay          = "RNA",
      ncells         = sketch_ncells,
      method         = SKETCH_METHOD,
      sketched.assay = "sketch",
      seed           = 2025,
      features       = rownames(so),  # all genes -- matches subset_to_HVG=FALSE
      verbose        = FALSE
    )
    
    # Verify the sketch actually has the expected number of cells -
    sketch_assay_dims <- dim(so@assays[["sketch"]])
    cat(sprintf("         [CHECK] Sketch assay dimensions: %s genes x %s cells (expected %s cells)\n",
                format(sketch_assay_dims[1], big.mark = ","),
                format(sketch_assay_dims[2], big.mark = ","),
                format(sketch_ncells, big.mark = ",")))
    if (sketch_assay_dims[2] != sketch_ncells) {
      cat("         [WARN] Sketch cell count does NOT match the requested ncells --\n")
      cat("                subsetting may not have worked as expected.\n")
    }
    
  
    cat("         Step 4.2: Running CluStoCell on sketched data...\n")
    
    # Run Clustocell on sketched cells
    sketched_so_clustoCell <- tryCatch(
      clustoCell(so =  so,
                 assay = "sketch",
                 layer = "counts",
                 log1p = FALSE,
                 subset_to_HVG = FALSE,
                 seed = 2025,
                 verbose = FALSE),
      error = function(e) {
        cat(sprintf("         [ERROR] CluStoCell (sketch) failed: %s\n", conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      }
    )
    # the actual result is stored in `sketched_so_clustoCell`.
    if (is.null(sketched_so_clustoCell)) stop("CluStoCell failed on sketch")
    
    cat(sprintf("         Step 4.3: Transferring labels to entire object (%s cells)...\n",
                format(n_cells, big.mark = ",")))
    
    # TransferLabel projects the sketch's clusters ONTO the full dataset.
    sketched_so_clustoCell <- tryCatch(
      clustoCell_TransferLabel(
        clustoCell     = sketched_so_clustoCell,
        query_expr_mat = so,
        assay          = "RNA",
        method         = TRANSFER_METHOD,
        seed           = 2025
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        cat(sprintf("         [ERROR] clustoCell_TransferLabel failed: %s\n", conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (is.null(sketched_so_clustoCell)) stop("clustoCell_TransferLabel failed")
    
    # Step 5: Transferring the labels to the full dataset
    cat(" Step 5: Adding cluster labels to the full dataset...\n")
    
    so <- addClustoData(
      obj = so,
      clustoCell = sketched_so_clustoCell,
      add_major_clusters = TRUE,
      add_sub_clusters = TRUE,
      major_cluster_name = "Sketched_ClustoCell",
      sub_cluster_name = "Sketched_ClustoCell_sub"
    )
    
    n_major <- length(unique(na.omit(so@meta.data[["Sketched_ClustoCell"]])))
    n_sub   <- length(unique(na.omit(so@meta.data[["Sketched_ClustoCell_sub"]])))
    result$n_clusters      <- n_major
    result$n_subclusters   <- n_sub
    result$n_cells_labeled <- sum(!is.na(so@meta.data[["Sketched_ClustoCell"]]))
    cat(sprintf("         Major clusters: %d | Sub-clusters: %d\n", n_major, n_sub))
    cat(sprintf("         Cells with a ClustoCell label: %s / %s\n",
                format(result$n_cells_labeled, big.mark = ","), format(n_cells, big.mark = ",")))
    if (result$n_cells_labeled < n_cells) {
      cat("         [NOTE] Not every cell received a label -- check clustoCell_TransferLabel\n")
      cat("                output/warnings if this count looks unexpectedly low.\n")
    }
    
    # Step 6: Concordance
    cat(" Step 6: Computing concordance...\n")
    labels         <- as.character(so@meta.data[[annot_col]])
    major_clusters <- as.character(so@meta.data[["Sketched_ClustoCell"]])
    sub_clusters   <- as.character(so@meta.data[["Sketched_ClustoCell_sub"]])
    valid_major    <- !is.na(labels) & !is.na(major_clusters)
    valid_sub      <- !is.na(labels) & !is.na(sub_clusters)
    
    contingency_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "contingency_tables")
    dir.create(contingency_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    
    labels_major   <- labels[valid_major]
    clusters_major <- major_clusters[valid_major]
    if (length(unique(labels_major)) > length(unique(clusters_major))) {
      ct_major <- table(`Manual Annotation` = labels_major, ClustoCell = clusters_major)
    } else {
      ct_major <- table(ClustoCell = clusters_major, `Manual Annotation` = labels_major)
    }
    concordance_major        <- round((sum(apply(ct_major, 1, max)) / length(clusters_major)) * 100)
    result$concordance_major <- concordance_major
    cat(sprintf("         Major concordance: %d%%\n", concordance_major))
    
    ct_major_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(ct_major)
    ct_major_df <- cbind(Cluster = rownames(ct_major_df), ct_major_df)
    write.csv(ct_major_df,
              file.path(contingency_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_contingency_major.csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    labels_sub   <- labels[valid_sub]
    clusters_sub <- sub_clusters[valid_sub]
    if (length(unique(labels_sub)) > length(unique(clusters_sub))) {
      ct_sub <- table(`Manual Annotation` = labels_sub, ClustoCell = clusters_sub)
    } else {
      ct_sub <- table(ClustoCell = clusters_sub, `Manual Annotation` = labels_sub)
    }
    concordance_sub        <- round((sum(apply(ct_sub, 1, max)) / length(clusters_sub)) * 100)
    result$concordance_sub <- concordance_sub
    cat(sprintf("         Sub concordance : %d%%\n", concordance_sub))
    
    ct_sub_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(ct_sub)
    ct_sub_df <- cbind(Cluster = rownames(ct_sub_df), ct_sub_df)
    write.csv(ct_sub_df,
              file.path(contingency_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_contingency_sub.csv")),
              row.names = FALSE)
    
    # Heatmaps
    plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots")
    dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    
    plot_contingency_heatmap <- function(ct, title, out_path) {
      ct_pct <- sweep(ct, 1, rowSums(ct), "/") * 100
      ct_df  <- as.data.frame(as.table(ct_pct))
      colnames(ct_df) <- c("Cluster", "Annotation", "Pct")
      ct_df$Annotation <- stringr::str_trunc(ct_df$Annotation, 30)
      p <- ggplot2::ggplot(ct_df, ggplot2::aes(x = Annotation, y = Cluster, fill = Pct)) +
        ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
        ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#2166AC", name = "% cells\nin cluster") +
        ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = ifelse(Pct > 5, sprintf("%.0f%%", Pct), "")),
                           size = 2.5, color = "black") +
        ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
        ggplot2::theme(
          axis.text.x     = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          axis.text.y     = ggplot2::element_text(size = 8),
          plot.title      = ggplot2::element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "right") +
        ggplot2::labs(title = title, x = annot_col, y = "CluStoCell cluster")
      ggplot2::ggsave(out_path, plot = p,
                      width  = max(8, ncol(ct) * 0.6),
                      height = max(5, nrow(ct) * 0.5),
                      limitsize = FALSE, dpi = 150)
    }
    
    tryCatch({
      plot_contingency_heatmap(
        ct_major,
        paste0(dataset_name, " (decoupled) \u2014 major clusters vs ", annot_col,
               "\nConcordance: ", concordance_major, "%"),
        file.path(plot_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_heatmap_major.pdf")))
      plot_contingency_heatmap(
        ct_sub,
        paste0(dataset_name, " (decoupled) \u2014 sub-clusters vs ", annot_col,
               "\nConcordance: ", concordance_sub, "%"),
        file.path(plot_dir, paste0(dataset_name, "_heatmap_sub.pdf")))
      cat(sprintf("         Heatmaps saved -> %s_heatmap_major/sub.pdf\n", dataset_name))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("         [WARN] Heatmap failed:", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    })
    
    saveRDS(so, out_rds)
    cat(sprintf("         Saved -> %s\n", basename(out_rds)))
    result$status <- "success"
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("  [ERROR]", conditionMessage(e), "\n")
    result$error  <<- conditionMessage(e)
    result$status <<- "error"
  })
  
  return(result)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Collect only the requested large studies
# ==============================================================================

target_stems <- trimws(strsplit(opt$datasets, ",")[[1]])
cat(sprintf("Target studies: %s\n", paste(target_stems, collapse = ", ")))

rds_paths <- file.path(opt$seurat_dir, paste0(target_stems, ".rds"))
missing   <- !file.exists(rds_paths)
if (any(missing)) {
  cat("[WARN] The following expected files were not found and will be skipped:\n")
  cat(paste0("  - ", rds_paths[missing], collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}
rds_paths <- rds_paths[!missing]
if (length(rds_paths) == 0) stop("None of the target studies were found in: ", opt$seurat_dir)

cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  CluStoCell DECOUPLED workflow -- large STAMP studies\n")
cat(sprintf("  Studies to process : %d\n", length(rds_paths)))
cat(sprintf("  Sketch method       : %s\n", SKETCH_METHOD))
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# Batch run
# ==============================================================================

results <- vector("list", length(rds_paths))
for (i in seq_along(rds_paths)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n[%d/%d]", i, length(rds_paths)))
  results[[i]] <- run_dataset_decoupled(rds_paths[i], opt$out_dir)
  
  # Force cleanup between studies 
  gc(verbose = FALSE, full = TRUE)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Summary and save
# ==============================================================================

results_df <- bind_rows(lapply(results, as.data.frame))
col_order  <- c("dataset", "source", "status", "n_cells", "n_genes",
                "data_type", "layer_used", "log1p_applied", "storage_backend",
                "sketch_method", "transfer_method",
                "annot_col", "n_original_labels", "original_labels",
                "n_clusters", "n_subclusters", "n_cells_labeled",
                "concordance_major", "concordance_sub", "error")
col_order  <- col_order[col_order %in% colnames(results_df)]
results_df <- results_df[, col_order]

cat("\n", strrep("=", 60), "\n", sep = "")
cat("  DONE\n")
cat(sprintf("  Success : %d\n", sum(results_df$status == "success")))
cat(sprintf("  Skipped : %d\n", sum(results_df$status == "skipped")))
cat(sprintf("  Errors  : %d\n", sum(results_df$status == "error")))

if (nrow(results_df[results_df$status == "error", ]) > 0) {
  cat("\n  Failed datasets:\n")
  err <- results_df[results_df$status == "error", ]
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(err))) {
    cat(sprintf("    %s \u2014 %s\n", err$dataset[i], err$error[i]))
  }
}

timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
out_csv   <- file.path(opt$out_dir, paste0("concordance_results_STAMP_decoupled_", timestamp, ".csv"))
write.csv(results_df, out_csv, row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("\n  Results -> %s\n", out_csv))
cat(strrep("=", 60), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Scran vs Manual
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scran)
library(scater)

# Convert Seurat to SingleCellExperiment
pbmc_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(pbmc)

pbmc_bench_Scran_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    # Quick clustering for size factors
    pbmc_quickCluster <- quickCluster(pbmc_sce)
    
    # Normalization
    pbmc_sce <- computeSumFactors(pbmc_sce, clusters = pbmc_quickCluster)
    pbmc_sce <- logNormCounts(pbmc_sce)
    
    # Variance modeling
    pbmc_dec <- modelGeneVar(pbmc_sce)
    
    # Feature selection: Get top highly variable genes
    pbmc_top.hvgs <- getTopHVGs(pbmc_dec)
    
    # Dimensionality reduction: Fixed PCA on HVGs
    pbmc_sce <- fixedPCA(pbmc_sce, subset.row = pbmc_top.hvgs)
    
    # Automated PC choice using clustered PCs
    pbmc_sce_output <- getClusteredPCs(reducedDim(pbmc_sce))
    pbmc_npcs <- metadata(pbmc_sce_output)$chosen
    reducedDim(pbmc_sce, "PCAsub") <- reducedDim(pbmc_sce, "PCA")[, 1:pbmc_npcs, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Graph-based clustering
    pbmc_g <- buildSNNGraph(pbmc_sce, use.dimred = "PCAsub")
    pbmc_cluster <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(pbmc_g)$membership
    pbmc_cluster
  }
)

pbmc$Scran <- pbmc_bench_Scran_out$result
pbmc_bench_Scran_out$result <- NULL

if(length(unique(pbmc$manual_annot)) > length(unique(pbmc$Scran))) {
  pbmc_Scran_vs_manual <- table(`Manual Annotation` = as.character(pbmc$manual_annot), Scran = pbmc$Scran)
} else {
  pbmc_Scran_vs_manual <- table(Scran = pbmc$Scran, `Manual Annotation` = as.character(pbmc$manual_annot))
}
pbmc_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap <- round(((pbmc_Scran_vs_manual %>% apply(1, max) %>% sum())/ncol(pbmc))*100)

pbmc_bench_Scran_out$concordance <- pbmc_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap
```

##### Scanpy

Preparing the input data

```{r}

Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1",
NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS = "1")

options(future.globals.maxSize = 1e9)
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 131072 * 100)

library(SeuratDisk)

# Convert the Assay5 to a standard Assay to avoid compatibility issues with SeuratDisk
tmp_pbmc <- pbmc
tmp_pbmc[["RNA"]]$scale.data <- NULL
```

###### Function for running scanpy clustering

```{r}

# Function for running scanpy clustering

run_scanpy_clustering <- function(adata, n_pcs) {
  stopifnot(!missing(adata))
  stopifnot(!missing(n_pcs))
  
  sc <- reticulate::import("scanpy", convert = FALSE)
  leidenalg <- reticulate::import("leidenalg", convert = FALSE)
  igraph <- reticulate::import("igraph", convert = FALSE)
  
  # ------------------------
  # Preprocessing (adata.X assumed raw counts)
  # ------------------------
  sc$pp$normalize_total(adata, target_sum = 1e4)
  sc$pp$log1p(adata)
  
  sc$pp$highly_variable_genes(adata, n_top_genes = 2000L, subset = TRUE)
  sc$pp$scale(adata)
  sc$tl$pca(adata, svd_solver = "arpack")
  
  # ------------------------
  # Clustering
  # ------------------------
  sc$pp$neighbors(adata, n_pcs = as.integer(n_pcs))
  sc$tl$leiden(adata,
               flavor = "igraph",
               n_iterations = 2L,
               directed = FALSE,
               key_added = "leiden_scanpy")
  
  # ------------------------
  # Convert categorical to string for reticulate
  # ------------------------
  clusters_py <- adata$obs[["leiden_scanpy"]]$astype("str")
  clusters_r <- reticulate::py_to_r(clusters_py)
  
  return(clusters_r)
}

```

```{r}

pbmc_bench_Scanpy_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    
    pbmc_Scanpy_clusters <- run_scanpy_clustering(pbmc_adata, n_pcs = 10)
    
    pbmc_Scanpy_clusters
  }
)

pbmc$Scanpy <- pbmc_bench_Scanpy_out$result %>% as.vector()

pbmc_bench_Scanpy_out$result <- NULL

  pbmc_Scanpy_vs_manual <- table(`Manual Annotation` = as.character(pbmc$manual_annot), Scanpy = pbmc$Scanpy)
} else {
  pbmc_Scanpy_vs_manual <- table(Scanpy = pbmc$Scanpy, `Manual Annotation` = as.character(pbmc$manual_annot))
}
pbmc_Scanpy_vs_manual_maxOverlap <- round(((pbmc_Scanpy_vs_manual %>% apply(1, max) %>% sum())/ncol(pbmc))*100)

pbmc_bench_Scanpy_out$concordance <- pbmc_Scanpy_vs_manual_maxOverlap
```

##### scGPT

###### Function for running scGPT clustering

```{r}

# py_install("scgpt", envname = "scanpy_env", pip = TRUE) # Better to be done via terminal

run_scgpt_clustering <- function(
    adata,
    model_dir,
    gene_col = "index",
    batch_size = 64L,
    n_neighbors = 15L,
    resolution = 1.0,
    key_added = "leiden_scgpt"
) {

  stopifnot(!missing(adata))
  stopifnot(!missing(model_dir))

  sc <- reticulate::import("scanpy", convert = FALSE)

  # macOS patch:
  # scGPT uses len(os.sched_getaffinity(0)) to choose DataLoader workers.
  # Returning set() forces num_workers = 0, avoiding multiprocessing/pickling.
  reticulate::py_run_string("
import os

def sched_getaffinity(pid):
    return set()

os.sched_getaffinity = sched_getaffinity
")

  scg <- reticulate::import("scgpt", convert = FALSE)
  pathlib <- reticulate::import("pathlib", convert = FALSE)
  Path <- pathlib$Path

  # Basic preprocessing; modifies adata in-place
  sc$pp$normalize_total(adata, target_sum = 1e4)
  sc$pp$log1p(adata)

  emb_adata <- scg$tasks$embed_data(
    adata,
    Path(model_dir),
    gene_col = gene_col,
    batch_size = as.integer(batch_size),
    device = "cpu",
    use_fast_transformer = FALSE,
    return_new_adata = TRUE
  )

  sc$pp$neighbors(
    emb_adata,
    n_neighbors = as.integer(n_neighbors),
    use_rep = "X"
  )

  sc$tl$leiden(
    emb_adata,
    flavor = "igraph",
    n_iterations = 2L,
    directed = FALSE,
    resolution = resolution,
    key_added = key_added
  )

  clusters_py <- emb_adata$obs[[key_added]]$astype("str")
  clusters_r <- reticulate::py_to_r(clusters_py)

  return(clusters_r)
}

```

```{r}

  function() {
    run_scgpt_clustering(
      adata = pbmc_adata,
      model_dir = "../scGPT/scGPT_human/",
      gene_col = "index"
    )
  }
)
```

```{r}
# Scran vs Manual
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scran)
library(scater)

# Convert Seurat to SingleCellExperiment
pbmc10k_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(pbmc10k)

pbmc10k_bench_Scran_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    # Quick clustering for size factors
    pbmc10k_quickCluster <- quickCluster(pbmc10k_sce)
    
    # Normalization
    pbmc10k_sce <- computeSumFactors(pbmc10k_sce, clusters = pbmc10k_quickCluster)
    pbmc10k_sce <- logNormCounts(pbmc10k_sce)
    
    # Variance modeling
    pbmc10k_dec <- modelGeneVar(pbmc10k_sce)
    
    # Feature selection: Get top highly variable genes
    pbmc10k_top.hvgs <- getTopHVGs(pbmc10k_dec)
    
    # Dimensionality reduction: Fixed PCA on HVGs
    pbmc10k_sce <- fixedPCA(pbmc10k_sce, subset.row = pbmc10k_top.hvgs)
    
    # Automated PC choice using clustered PCs
    pbmc10k_sce_output <- getClusteredPCs(reducedDim(pbmc10k_sce))
    pbmc10k_npcs <- metadata(pbmc10k_sce_output)$chosen
    reducedDim(pbmc10k_sce, "PCAsub") <- reducedDim(pbmc10k_sce, "PCA")[, 1:pbmc10k_npcs, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Graph-based clustering
    pbmc10k_g <- buildSNNGraph(pbmc10k_sce, use.dimred = "PCAsub")
    pbmc10k_cluster <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(pbmc10k_g)$membership
    pbmc10k_cluster
  }
)

pbmc10k$Scran <- pbmc10k_bench_Scran_out$result
pbmc10k_bench_Scran_out$result <- NULL

if(length(unique(pbmc10k$manual_annot)) > length(unique(pbmc10k$Scran))) {
  pbmc10k_Scran_vs_manual <- table(`Manual Annotation` = as.character(pbmc10k$manual_annot), Scran = pbmc10k$Scran)
} else {
  pbmc10k_Scran_vs_manual <- table(Scran = pbmc10k$Scran, `Manual Annotation` = as.character(pbmc10k$manual_annot))
}
```

```{r}
# Scran vs Manual
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scran)
library(scater)

# Convert Seurat to SingleCellExperiment
liver_tumor_adj_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(liver_tumor_adj)

liver_tumor_adj_bench_Scran_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    # Quick clustering for size factors
    liver_tumor_adj_quickCluster <- quickCluster(liver_tumor_adj_sce)
    
    # Normalization
    liver_tumor_adj_sce <- computeSumFactors(liver_tumor_adj_sce, clusters = liver_tumor_adj_quickCluster)
    liver_tumor_adj_sce <- logNormCounts(liver_tumor_adj_sce)
    
    # Variance modeling
    liver_tumor_adj_dec <- modelGeneVar(liver_tumor_adj_sce)
    
    # Feature selection: Get top highly variable genes
    liver_tumor_adj_top.hvgs <- getTopHVGs(liver_tumor_adj_dec)
    
    # Dimensionality reduction: Fixed PCA on HVGs
    liver_tumor_adj_sce <- fixedPCA(liver_tumor_adj_sce, subset.row = liver_tumor_adj_top.hvgs)
    
    # Automated PC choice using clustered PCs
    liver_tumor_adj_sce_output <- getClusteredPCs(reducedDim(liver_tumor_adj_sce))
    liver_tumor_adj_npcs <- metadata(liver_tumor_adj_sce_output)$chosen
    reducedDim(liver_tumor_adj_sce, "PCAsub") <- reducedDim(liver_tumor_adj_sce, "PCA")[, 1:liver_tumor_adj_npcs, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Graph-based clustering
    liver_tumor_adj_g <- buildSNNGraph(liver_tumor_adj_sce, use.dimred = "PCAsub")
    liver_tumor_adj_cluster <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(liver_tumor_adj_g)$membership
    liver_tumor_adj_cluster
  }
)

liver_tumor_adj$Scran <- liver_tumor_adj_bench_Scran_out$result
liver_tumor_adj_bench_Scran_out$result <- NULL

if(length(unique(liver_tumor_adj$minor_manual_annot1)) > length(unique(liver_tumor_adj$Scran))) {
  liver_tumor_adj_Scran_vs_manual <- table(`Manual Annotation` = as.character(liver_tumor_adj$minor_manual_annot1), Scran = liver_tumor_adj$Scran)
} else {
  liver_tumor_adj_Scran_vs_manual <- table(Scran = liver_tumor_adj$Scran, `Manual Annotation` = as.character(liver_tumor_adj$minor_manual_annot1))
}
liver_tumor_adj_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap <- round(((liver_tumor_adj_Scran_vs_manual %>% apply(1, max) %>% sum())/ncol(liver_tumor_adj))*100)

liver_tumor_adj_bench_Scran_out$concordance <- liver_tumor_adj_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap
```

```{r}
library(scater)

# Convert Seurat to SingleCellExperiment
human_melanocyte_so_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(human_melanocyte_so)

human_melanocyte_so_bench_Scran_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    # Quick clustering for size factors
    human_melanocyte_so_quickCluster <- quickCluster(human_melanocyte_so_sce)
    
    # Normalization
    human_melanocyte_so_sce <- computeSumFactors(human_melanocyte_so_sce, clusters = human_melanocyte_so_quickCluster)
    human_melanocyte_so_sce <- logNormCounts(human_melanocyte_so_sce)
    
    # Variance modeling
    human_melanocyte_so_dec <- modelGeneVar(human_melanocyte_so_sce)
    
    # Feature selection: Get top highly variable genes
    human_melanocyte_so_top.hvgs <- getTopHVGs(human_melanocyte_so_dec)
    
    # Dimensionality reduction: Fixed PCA on HVGs
    human_melanocyte_so_sce <- fixedPCA(human_melanocyte_so_sce, subset.row = human_melanocyte_so_top.hvgs)
    
    # Automated PC choice using clustered PCs
    human_melanocyte_so_sce_output <- getClusteredPCs(reducedDim(human_melanocyte_so_sce))
    human_melanocyte_so_npcs <- metadata(human_melanocyte_so_sce_output)$chosen
    reducedDim(human_melanocyte_so_sce, "PCAsub") <- reducedDim(human_melanocyte_so_sce, "PCA")[, 1:human_melanocyte_so_npcs, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Graph-based clustering
    human_melanocyte_so_g <- buildSNNGraph(human_melanocyte_so_sce, use.dimred = "PCAsub")
    human_melanocyte_so_cluster <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(human_melanocyte_so_g)$membership
    human_melanocyte_so_cluster
  }
)

human_melanocyte_so$Scran <- human_melanocyte_so_bench_Scran_out$result
human_melanocyte_so_bench_Scran_out$result <- NULL

if(length(unique(human_melanocyte_so$class_1)) > length(unique(human_melanocyte_so$Scran))) {
  human_melanocyte_so_Scran_vs_manual <- table(`Manual Annotation` = as.character(human_melanocyte_so$class_1), Scran = human_melanocyte_so$Scran)
} else {
  human_melanocyte_so_Scran_vs_manual <- table(Scran = human_melanocyte_so$Scran, `Manual Annotation` = as.character(human_melanocyte_so$class_1))
}
human_melanocyte_so_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap <- round(((human_melanocyte_so_Scran_vs_manual %>% apply(1, max) %>% sum())/ncol(human_melanocyte_so))*100)

human_melanocyte_so_bench_Scran_out$concordance <- human_melanocyte_so_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap

```

```{r}
    bcc_so_tmp_UCell <- apply(bcc_so@meta.data[, bcc_so_sig_cols], 1,

      full.reduction = "pca.full",
      sketched.assay = "sketch",
      sketched.reduction = "pca",

      refdata = c(UCell = "UCell") , 
      verbose = F
    )
    bcc_so
```

```{r}
# Scran vs Manual
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scran)
library(scater)

# Convert Seurat to SingleCellExperiment
hcca_so_sce <- GetAssayData(hcca_so, assay="sketch", layer ='counts')
hcca_so_sce <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = hcca_so_sce)
hcca_so_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(hcca_so_sce)

hcca_so_bench_Scran_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    # Quick clustering for size factors
    hcca_so_quickCluster <- quickCluster(hcca_so_sce)
    
    # Normalization
    hcca_so_sce <- computeSumFactors(hcca_so_sce, clusters = hcca_so_quickCluster)
    hcca_so_sce <- logNormCounts(hcca_so_sce)
    
    # Variance modeling
    hcca_so_dec <- modelGeneVar(hcca_so_sce)
    
    # Feature selection: Get top highly variable genes
    hcca_so_top.hvgs <- getTopHVGs(hcca_so_dec)
    
    # Dimensionality reduction: Fixed PCA on HVGs
    hcca_so_sce <- fixedPCA(hcca_so_sce, subset.row = hcca_so_top.hvgs)
    
    # Automated PC choice using clustered PCs
    hcca_so_sce_output <- getClusteredPCs(reducedDim(hcca_so_sce))
    hcca_so_npcs <- metadata(hcca_so_sce_output)$chosen
    reducedDim(hcca_so_sce, "PCAsub") <- reducedDim(hcca_so_sce, "PCA")[, 1:hcca_so_npcs, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Graph-based clustering
    hcca_so_g <- buildSNNGraph(hcca_so_sce, use.dimred = "PCAsub")
    hcca_so_cluster <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(hcca_so_g)$membership
    
    hcca_so$Scran <- NA
    hcca_so$Scran[match(colnames(hcca_so[["sketch"]]), colnames(hcca_so))] <- hcca_so_cluster
    
    hcca_so <- ProjectData(
      object = hcca_so,
      assay = "RNA_dgCMatrix",
      full.reduction = "pca.full",
      sketched.assay = "sketch",
      sketched.reduction = "pca", 
      dims = 1:20,
      refdata = c(Scran = "Scran") , 
      verbose = F
    )
    hcca_so
  }
)

hcca_so <- hcca_so_bench_Scran_out$result
hcca_so_bench_Scran_out$result <- NULL

if(length(unique(hcca_so$ClusterTop)) > length(unique(hcca_so$Scran))) {
  hcca_so_Scran_vs_manual <- table(`Manual Annotation` = as.character(hcca_so$ClusterTop), Scran = hcca_so$Scran)
} else {
  hcca_so_Scran_vs_manual <- table(Scran = hcca_so$Scran, `Manual Annotation` = as.character(hcca_so$ClusterTop))
}
hcca_so_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap <- round(((hcca_so_Scran_vs_manual %>% apply(1, max) %>% sum())/ncol(hcca_so))*100)

hcca_so_bench_Scran_out$concordance <- hcca_so_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap
```

##### Scanpy

Preparing the input data

```{r}

Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
           OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
           MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
           VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1",
           NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS = "1")

options(future.globals.maxSize = 1e9)
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 131072 * 100)


library(SeuratDisk)

# Convert the Assay5 to a standard Assay to avoid compatibility issues with SeuratDisk
tmp_sketched_hcca_so <- GetAssayData(hcca_so, assay="sketch", layer ='counts')

rownames(tmp_sketched_hcca_so) <- sapply(rownames(tmp_sketched_hcca_so) %>% 
                                           as.character(), function(x) unlist(str_split(x, "\\\t"))[2]) %>% 
  unname() # Correcting gene names

tmp_sketched_hcca_so <- Matrix.utils::aggregate.Matrix( # Correcting gene names
  x = tmp_sketched_hcca_so,
  groupings = rownames(tmp_sketched_hcca_so),
  fun = "mean"
)

tmp_sketched_hcca_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = tmp_sketched_hcca_so)
tmp_sketched_hcca_so <- NormalizeData(tmp_sketched_hcca_so, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
tmp_sketched_hcca_so <- FindVariableFeatures(tmp_sketched_hcca_so, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
tmp_sketched_hcca_so <- ScaleData(tmp_sketched_hcca_so, features = VariableFeatures(tmp_sketched_hcca_so))
tmp_sketched_hcca_so[["RNA"]] <- as(object = tmp_sketched_hcca_so[["RNA"]], Class = "Assay")
tmp_sketched_hcca_so[["RNA"]]$scale.data <- NULL
tmp_sketched_hcca_so[["RNA"]]$data <- NULL

# Save the modified Seurat object as h5Seurat and convert to h5ad for Python compatibility
SaveH5Seurat(tmp_sketched_hcca_so, filename = "../Scanpy/hcca_sketched_so.h5Seurat", overwrite = TRUE)

rm(tmp_sketched_hcca_so)

Convert("../Scanpy/hcca_sketched_so.h5Seurat", dest = "../Scanpy/hcca_sketched_so.h5ad", overwrite = TRUE, assay = "RNA")
```

```{r}
# Scran vs Manual
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scran)
library(scater)

# Convert Seurat to SingleCellExperiment
luad_GSE131907_so_sce <- GetAssayData(luad_GSE131907_so, assay="sketch", layer ='counts')
luad_GSE131907_so_sce <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = luad_GSE131907_so_sce)
luad_GSE131907_so_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(luad_GSE131907_so_sce)

luad_GSE131907_so_bench_Scran_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    # Quick clustering for size factors
    luad_GSE131907_so_quickCluster <- quickCluster(luad_GSE131907_so_sce)
    
    # Normalization
    luad_GSE131907_so_sce <- computeSumFactors(luad_GSE131907_so_sce, clusters = luad_GSE131907_so_quickCluster)
    luad_GSE131907_so_sce <- logNormCounts(luad_GSE131907_so_sce)
    
    # Variance modeling
    luad_GSE131907_so_dec <- modelGeneVar(luad_GSE131907_so_sce)
    
    # Feature selection: Get top highly variable genes
    luad_GSE131907_so_top.hvgs <- getTopHVGs(luad_GSE131907_so_dec)
    
    # Dimensionality reduction: Fixed PCA on HVGs
    luad_GSE131907_so_sce <- fixedPCA(luad_GSE131907_so_sce, subset.row = luad_GSE131907_so_top.hvgs)
    
    # Automated PC choice using clustered PCs
    luad_GSE131907_so_sce_output <- getClusteredPCs(reducedDim(luad_GSE131907_so_sce))
    luad_GSE131907_so_npcs <- metadata(luad_GSE131907_so_sce_output)$chosen
    reducedDim(luad_GSE131907_so_sce, "PCAsub") <- reducedDim(luad_GSE131907_so_sce, "PCA")[, 1:luad_GSE131907_so_npcs, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Graph-based clustering
    luad_GSE131907_so_g <- buildSNNGraph(luad_GSE131907_so_sce, use.dimred = "PCAsub")
    luad_GSE131907_so_cluster <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(luad_GSE131907_so_g)$membership
    
    luad_GSE131907_so$Scran <- NA
    luad_GSE131907_so$Scran[match(colnames(luad_GSE131907_so[["sketch"]]), colnames(luad_GSE131907_so))] <- luad_GSE131907_so_cluster
    
    luad_GSE131907_so <- ProjectData(
      object = luad_GSE131907_so,
      assay = "RNA",
      full.reduction = "pca.full",
      sketched.assay = "sketch",
      sketched.reduction = "pca", 
      dims = 1:20,
      refdata = c(Scran = "Scran") , 
      verbose = F
    )
    luad_GSE131907_so
  }
)

luad_GSE131907_so <- luad_GSE131907_so_bench_Scran_out$result
luad_GSE131907_so_bench_Scran_out$result <- NULL

if(length(unique(luad_GSE131907_so$manual_final_annot)) > length(unique(luad_GSE131907_so$Scran))) {
  luad_GSE131907_so_Scran_vs_manual <- table(`Manual Annotation` = as.character(luad_GSE131907_so$manual_final_annot), Scran = luad_GSE131907_so$Scran)
} else {

}
```

##### Scanpy

Preparing the input data

```{r}

Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
           OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
           MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
           VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1",
           NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS = "1")

options(future.globals.maxSize = 1e9)
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 131072 * 100)

library(SeuratDisk)

# Convert the Assay5 to a standard Assay to avoid compatibility issues with SeuratDisk
tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so <- GetAssayData(luad_GSE131907_so, assay="sketch", layer ='counts') 
tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so)
tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so <- NormalizeData(tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so <- FindVariableFeatures(tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so <- ScaleData(tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so, features = VariableFeatures(tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so))
tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so[["RNA"]] <- as(object = tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so[["RNA"]], Class = "Assay")
tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so[["RNA"]]$scale.data <- NULL
tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so[["RNA"]]$data <- NULL

# Save the modified Seurat object as h5Seurat and convert to h5ad for Python compatibility
SaveH5Seurat(tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so, filename = "../Scanpy/luad_sketched_so.h5Seurat", overwrite = TRUE)

rm(tmp_sketched_luad_GSE131907_so)

Convert("../Scanpy/luad_sketched_so.h5Seurat", dest = "../Scanpy/luad_sketched_so.h5ad", overwrite = TRUE, assay = "RNA")
```

```{r}
    breast_atlas_so_tmp_UCell <- apply(breast_atlas_so@meta.data[, breast_atlas_so_sig_cols], 1,

    breast_atlas_so_tmp_UCell[which(sapply(breast_atlas_so_tmp_UCell, length) == 0)] <- NA
    breast_atlas_so_tmp_UCell <- unlist(breast_atlas_so_tmp_UCell)
    
    breast_atlas_so$UCell <- breast_atlas_so_tmp_UCell

      object = breast_atlas_so,

# Scran vs Manual
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scran)
library(scater)

# Convert Seurat to SingleCellExperiment
breast_atlas_so_sce <- GetAssayData(breast_atlas_so, assay="sketch", layer ='counts')
breast_atlas_so_sce <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = breast_atlas_so_sce)
breast_atlas_so_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(breast_atlas_so_sce)

breast_atlas_so_bench_Scran_out <- run_with_bench(
  function(x) {
    # Quick clustering for size factors
    breast_atlas_so_quickCluster <- quickCluster(breast_atlas_so_sce)
    
    # Normalization
    breast_atlas_so_sce <- computeSumFactors(breast_atlas_so_sce, clusters = breast_atlas_so_quickCluster)
    breast_atlas_so_sce <- logNormCounts(breast_atlas_so_sce)
    
    # Variance modeling
    breast_atlas_so_dec <- modelGeneVar(breast_atlas_so_sce)
    
    # Feature selection: Get top highly variable genes
    breast_atlas_so_top.hvgs <- getTopHVGs(breast_atlas_so_dec)
    
    # Dimensionality reduction: Fixed PCA on HVGs
    breast_atlas_so_sce <- fixedPCA(breast_atlas_so_sce, subset.row = breast_atlas_so_top.hvgs)
    
    # Automated PC choice using clustered PCs
    breast_atlas_so_sce_output <- getClusteredPCs(reducedDim(breast_atlas_so_sce))
    breast_atlas_so_npcs <- metadata(breast_atlas_so_sce_output)$chosen
    reducedDim(breast_atlas_so_sce, "PCAsub") <- reducedDim(breast_atlas_so_sce, "PCA")[, 1:breast_atlas_so_npcs, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Graph-based clustering
    breast_atlas_so_g <- buildSNNGraph(breast_atlas_so_sce, use.dimred = "PCAsub")
    breast_atlas_so_cluster <- igraph::cluster_walktrap(breast_atlas_so_g)$membership
    
    breast_atlas_so$Scran <- NA
    breast_atlas_so$Scran[match(colnames(breast_atlas_so[["sketch"]]), colnames(breast_atlas_so))] <- breast_atlas_so_cluster
    
    breast_atlas_so <- ProjectData(
      object = breast_atlas_so,
      assay = "RNA",
      full.reduction = "pca.full",
      sketched.assay = "sketch",
      sketched.reduction = "pca", 
      dims = 1:20,
      refdata = c(Scran = "Scran") , 
      verbose = F
    )
    breast_atlas_so
  }
)

breast_atlas_so <- breast_atlas_so_bench_Scran_out$result
breast_atlas_so_bench_Scran_out$result <- NULL

if(length(unique(breast_atlas_so$Cell.subtype)) > length(unique(breast_atlas_so$Scran))) {
  breast_atlas_so_Scran_vs_manual <- table(`Manual Annotation` = as.character(breast_atlas_so$Cell.subtype), Scran = breast_atlas_so$Scran)
} else {
  breast_atlas_so_Scran_vs_manual <- table(Scran = breast_atlas_so$Scran, `Manual Annotation` = as.character(breast_atlas_so$Cell.subtype))
}
breast_atlas_so_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap <- round(((breast_atlas_so_Scran_vs_manual %>% apply(1, max) %>% sum())/ncol(breast_atlas_so))*100)

breast_atlas_so_bench_Scran_out$concordance <- breast_atlas_so_Scran_vs_manual_maxOverlap
```

##### Scanpy

Preparing the input data

```{r}

Sys.setenv(OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1",
           OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1",
           MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
           VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1",
           NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS = "1")

options(future.globals.maxSize = 1e9)
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 131072 * 100)

library(SeuratDisk)

# Convert the Assay5 to a standard Assay to avoid compatibility issues with SeuratDisk
tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so <- GetAssayData(breast_atlas_so, assay="sketch", layer ='counts') 
tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so)
tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so <- NormalizeData(tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)
tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so <- FindVariableFeatures(tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)
tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so <- ScaleData(tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so, features = VariableFeatures(tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so))
tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so[["RNA"]] <- as(object = tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so[["RNA"]], Class = "Assay")
tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so[["RNA"]]$scale.data <- NULL
tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so[["RNA"]]$data <- NULL

# Save the modified Seurat object as h5Seurat and convert to h5ad for Python compatibility
SaveH5Seurat(tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so, filename = "../Scanpy/breast_atlas_sketched_so.h5Seurat", overwrite = TRUE)

rm(tmp_sketched_breast_atlas_so)

Convert("../Scanpy/breast_atlas_sketched_so.h5Seurat", dest = "../Scanpy/breast_atlas_sketched_so.h5ad", overwrite = TRUE, assay = "RNA")
```

# Third row

Preparing other benchmarking metrics

## Required functions

```{r}

# Required functions

## Required packages
library(mclust) 
library(purrr)
library(aricode) 
library(entropy) 

#_________________

# Cell-type fragmentation score

celltype_fragmentation <- function(clusters, celltypes, min_fraction = 0.10) {
  clusters  <- droplevels(as.factor(clusters))
  celltypes <- droplevels(as.factor(celltypes))
  
  tab <- table(celltypes, clusters)
  prop <- prop.table(tab, margin = 2)
  
  fragmentation_per_ct <- rowSums(prop >= min_fraction, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  data.frame(
    mean_fragmentation   = mean(fragmentation_per_ct),
    median_fragmentation = median(fragmentation_per_ct),
    max_fragmentation    = max(fragmentation_per_ct)
  )
}

#___________________________________________________

# Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) with an explicit entropy penalty

entropy <- function(labels) {
  p <- table(labels) / length(labels)
  -sum(p * log(p))
}

#_________

mutual_information <- function(x, y) {
  tab <- table(x, y)
  n <- sum(tab)
  
  px <- rowSums(tab) / n
  py <- colSums(tab) / n
  pxy <- tab / n
  
  mi <- 0
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(tab))) {
    for (j in seq_len(ncol(tab))) {
      if (pxy[i, j] > 0) {
        mi <- mi + pxy[i, j] * log(pxy[i, j] / (px[i] * py[j]))
      }
    }
  }
  mi
}

#_________

nmi <- function(x, y) {
  mi <- mutual_information(x, y)
  hx <- entropy(x)
  hy <- entropy(y)
  
  mi / sqrt(hx * hy)
}

#_________

nmi_entropy_penalized <- function(clusters, celltypes) {
  nmi_val <- nmi(clusters, celltypes)
  h_clusters <- entropy(clusters)
  
  data.frame(
    NMI = nmi_val,
    cluster_entropy = h_clusters,
    NMI_entropy_penalized = nmi_val / (1 + h_clusters)
  )
}


```

## Computing the Stats

### PBMC3k

```{r}

## Manual annotations
pbmc_manual <- pbmc$manual_annot

## Clustering methods
pbmc_clusterings <- list(
  Seurat      = pbmc$seurat_clusters,
  ClustoCell  = pbmc$ClustoCell,
  Accordion   = pbmc$accordion,
  scType      = pbmc$scType,
  Scanpy      = pbmc$Scanpy,
  Scran       = pbmc$Scran,
  scGPT       = pbmc$scGPT
)

#________________________

# Adjusted Rand Index (ARI)

set.seed(1234)
pbmc_ari_df <- map_dfr(pbmc_clusterings, function(clust) {
  data.frame(
    ARI = mclust::adjustedRandIndex(clust, pbmc_manual)
  )
}, .id = "Method")

#__________________________________________________________

# Cell-type fragmentation score

set.seed(1234)
pbmc_fragmentation_df <- map_dfr(pbmc_clusterings, function(clust) {
  celltype_fragmentation(clust, pbmc_manual)
}, .id = "Method")

#__________________________________________________________

# Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) with an explicit entropy penalty

set.seed(1234)
pbmc_nmi_df <- map_dfr(pbmc_clusterings, function(clust) {
  nmi_entropy_penalized(clust, pbmc_manual)
}, .id = "Method")

rownames(pbmc_nmi_df) <- NULL

#__________________________________________________________

# Adjusted Mutual Information (AMI)

set.seed(1234)
pbmc_ami_df <- map_dfr(pbmc_clusterings, function(clust) {
  keep <- !is.na(pbmc_manual) & !is.na(clust)
  aricode::AMI(clust[keep] %>% factor(), pbmc_manual[keep] %>% factor())
  }, .id = "Method") %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Method", values_to = "AMI")

rownames(pbmc_ami_df) <- NULL

#__________________________________________________________
#__________________________________________________________

pbmc_other_benchmark_combined <- pbmc_ari_df %>%
  left_join(pbmc_fragmentation_df, by = "Method") %>%
  left_join(pbmc_nmi_df, by = "Method") %>% 
  left_join(pbmc_ami_df, by = "Method")

pbmc_other_benchmark_combined$Dataset <- "PBMC3k"

```

```{r}
bcc_so_ari_df <- map_dfr(bcc_so_clusterings, function(clust) {
  data.frame(
    ARI = mclust::adjustedRandIndex(clust, bcc_so_manual)
  )
}, .id = "Method")

#__________________________________________________________

# Cell-type fragmentation score

set.seed(1234)
bcc_so_fragmentation_df <- map_dfr(bcc_so_clusterings, function(clust) {
  celltype_fragmentation(clust, bcc_so_manual)
}, .id = "Method")

#__________________________________________________________

# Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) with an explicit entropy penalty

set.seed(1234)
bcc_so_nmi_df <- map_dfr(bcc_so_clusterings, function(clust) {
  nmi_entropy_penalized(clust, bcc_so_manual)
}, .id = "Method")

rownames(bcc_so_nmi_df) <- NULL

#__________________________________________________________

# Adjusted Mutual Information (AMI)

set.seed(1234)
bcc_so_ami_df <- map_dfr(bcc_so_clusterings, function(clust) {
  keep <- !is.na(bcc_so_manual) & !is.na(clust)
  aricode::AMI(clust[keep] %>% factor(), bcc_so_manual[keep] %>% factor())
}, .id = "Method") %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Method", values_to = "AMI")

rownames(bcc_so_ami_df) <- NULL

#__________________________________________________________
#__________________________________________________________

bcc_so_other_benchmark_combined <- bcc_so_ari_df %>%
  left_join(bcc_so_fragmentation_df, by = "Method") %>%
  left_join(bcc_so_nmi_df, by = "Method") %>% 
  left_join(bcc_so_ami_df, by = "Method")

bcc_so_other_benchmark_combined$Dataset <- "Basal Cell Carcinoma"

```

```{r}

library(ggrain)

all_other_benchmark_combined$Dataset <- 
  dplyr::recode(as.character(all_other_benchmark_combined$Dataset),
                PBMC3k = "PBMC3K\n(n cells = 2700)",
                PBMC10K = "PBMC10K\n(n cells = 10412)",
                `Peritumoral Normal Liver` = "Peritumoral Normal Liver\n(n cells = 13083)",
                `Melanocyte-Melanoma` = "Melanocyte-Melanoma\n(n cells = 9719)",
                `Basal Cell Carcinoma` = "Basal Cell Carcinoma\n(n cells = 53030)",
                `Colon Cancer Atlas` = "Colon Cancer Atlas\n(n cells = 371223)",
                `LUAD Cell Atlas` = "LUAD Cell Atlas\n(n cells = 208506)",
                `Human Breast Atlas` = "Human Breast Atlas\n(n cells = 52681)"
                )
  
# Adjusted Rand Index

ARI_combined_plt <- ggplot(
  all_other_benchmark_combined %>% 
  mutate(plot_title_strip = rep("Adjusted Rand Index", nrow(all_other_benchmark_combined))) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Method = factor(Method,
    levels = all_other_benchmark_combined %>% 
      dplyr::select(Method, ARI) %>% 
      group_by(Method) %>% 
      summarise(median_ARI = median(ARI)) %>% 
      arrange(median_ARI) %>% 
      dplyr::pull(Method) %>% 
      rev())),
  aes(Method, ARI)) +
  geom_rain(alpha = .75, cov = "Dataset",
            point.args = list(size = 1),
            boxplot.args.pos = list(
              width = 0.2, position = position_nudge(x = 0.15)),
            violin.args.pos = list(
              side = "r",
              width = 0.6, position = position_nudge(x = 0.3))) +
  coord_flip() +
  ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
  paletteer::scale_fill_paletteer_d("khroma::sunset", direction = -1) +
  guides(fill = 'none') +
  labs(tag = "d", subtitle = NULL, y = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~ plot_title_strip) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.background = element_rect(
    color = "black", 
    fill = "#F2F2F2", 
    size = 0.5, 
    linetype = "solid"
  ),    text = element_text(size = 7),
    title = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, vjust = 0),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 6,
      margin = margin(b = 10)
    ),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 5),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2)))
```
