## Visualizing the speed

```{r}

bench_out_time_final <- bench_out_time
bench_out_time_final[bench_out_time_final > 200] <- 200

bench_out_time_long <- bench_out_time_final %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c("ClustoCell", "Seurat", "Scanpy", "scGPT", "Scran", "Accordion", "scType", "SCINA", "AUCell", "UCell"), 
               names_to = "Method", values_to = "Time")

library(tidytext)

bench_out_time_long <- bench_out_time_long %>%
  mutate(
    Time_label = ifelse(Time == 200, ">200", sprintf("%.1f", Time)),
    Method_reord = reorder_within(Method, Time, Dataset)
  )

bench_out_time_plt <- ggplot(bench_out_time_long, aes(x = Time, y = Method_reord)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = Time, y = Method_reord, yend = Method_reord,
        color = Method == "ClustoCell"),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Method == "ClustoCell"), size = 2) +
  # Add text labels next to the dots
  geom_text(aes(label = Time_label, color = Method == "ClustoCell"),
            hjust = -0.4, nudge_x = 3, fontface = "plain", size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Dataset, ncol = 4, scales = "free") +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#8B2323", "FALSE" = "grey50")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.45))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(tag = "h", subtitle = NULL, x = "Time (second)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.background = element_rect(
    color = "black", 
    fill = "#F2F2F2", 
    size = 0.5, 
    linetype = "solid"
  ),
    text = element_text(size = 7),
    title = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, vjust = 0),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )

    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 6,
      margin = margin(b = 10)
    ),
  legend.position = "none",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 5),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0, "pt"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2))) 

#_______________

# Avg of times

bench_out_time_long_summarized <- 
  apply(bench_out_time[,-1], 2, mean, drop = F) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("Method") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(Time = ".") %>%  
  cbind(Dataset = "Average Performance")

bench_out_time_long_summarized$Raw_Time <- bench_out_time_long_summarized$Time

bench_out_time_long_summarized$Time[bench_out_time_long_summarized$Time > 200] <- 200

bench_out_time_long_summarized <- bench_out_time_long_summarized %>%
  mutate(
    Time_label =  sprintf("%1.f", Raw_Time),
    Method_reord = reorder_within(Method, Raw_Time, Dataset)
  )

bench_out_time_summarized_plt <- ggplot(bench_out_time_long_summarized %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(Method = factor(Method,
    levels = bench_out_time_long_summarized %>% 
      dplyr::select(Method, Time) %>% 
      group_by(Method) %>% 
      summarise(median_time = median(Time)) %>% 
      arrange(median_time) %>% 
      dplyr::pull(Method))), 
    aes(x = Time, y = Method)) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x = 0, xend = Time, y = Method, yend = Method,
        color = Method == "ClustoCell"),
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Method == "ClustoCell"), size = 2) +
  # Add text labels next to the dots
  geom_text(aes(label = Time_label, color = Method == "ClustoCell"),
            hjust = -0.8, nudge_x = 3, fontface = "plain", size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Dataset) +
  scale_y_reordered() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#8B2323", "FALSE" = "grey50")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.45))) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(tag = NULL, subtitle = NULL, x = "Time (second)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6),
    strip.background = element_rect(
    color = "black", 
    fill = "#F2F2F2", 
    size = 0.5, 
    linetype = "solid"
  ),
    text = element_text(size = 7),
    title = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, vjust = 0),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    axis.title.y = element_blank()
  )

```

## Fourth row figure

```{r}

fourth_row_combined <- wrap_plots(
    bench_out_time_box_plt,
    bench_out_time_summarized_plt,
    widths = c(6.5,2)
  )
```
